Released in celebration of Abloh’s career retrospective exhibit at the Museum of Contemporary Art in Chicago, the “MCA” colorway features the same leather construction of the coveted “ComplexCon” and “MoMA” versions of the Off-White x Air Force 1. This time the silhouette receives an eye-catching bright blue hue across the upper and sole, highlighted by metallic silver Swooshes and a red tab and zip tie. The Off-White x Nike Air Force 1 “MCA” released in very limited quantities in June 2019.

Large white Swooshes, bright orange accents, and a light blue zip-tie accessory round out the 2018 Off-White x Nike Air Force 1 Low “Black.”

With a ribbed heel and gel insert sole, these sneakers offer superior comfort for a seamless transition from the office to the weekend.

With a comfortable gel insert sole and a timeless low top profile, these sneakers are the perfect companion for everyday wear.

A Jumpman logo is embroidered on the tongue and a tonal wings logo is found on the heel. A “23” lace loop adds the final touch. The Air Jordan 1 Low “Black Toe” released on April 1, 2019.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Zion Williamson - Voodoo Alternate"
products.description: Step into a world of mystic flair with the Air Jordan 1 Low "Voodoo". This unique sneaker, inspired by Zion Williamson's collaboration, features a complex, patchwork design with exposed stitching and earthy tones. Experience comfortable Air cushioning and a versatile look, perfect for making a bold, sophisticated statement with an exclusive edge.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Summit White Rattan"
products.description: Elevate your rotation with the Air Jordan 1 Low "Summit White Rattan." This low-cut version of Michael Jordan's first signature shoe keeps the classic silhouette while offering a clean, nature-inspired palette of Summit White and Rattan. It features a premium construction and a cushioned sole, delivering all-day comfort and a timeless, versatile aesthetic. The perfect everyday sneaker for a fresh, understated look.

products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low "Obisidian" is a 2025 lowtop colorway of Michael Jordan's first signature shoe. The AJ1 Low OG "Obisidian" has a leather upper that combines shades of navy and light blue with off-white. The lowtop Jordan 1 has a Wings logo on the heel and a navy Swoosh.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Cool Grey"
products.description: Step out in timeless style with the Air Jordan 1 Low "Cool Grey." Featuring the product code HF3148 011, this classic low-top sneaker offers a sleek and versatile look, perfect for any occasion.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Black Toe Medium Olive"
products.description: Own a sophisticated take on a classic with the Air Jordan 1 Low 'Black Toe Medium Olive,' the "Earthy Essential." This instant classic kick reinterprets the iconic Black Toe color blocking by introducing a rich, understated Medium Olive hue to the Swoosh, collar, and heel. Crafted with a premium leather and suede upper, the low-top silhouette blends sharp black overlays with crisp white panels. The tasteful, earthy tones make this shoe incredibly versatile for your lifestyle collection, providing durable comfort and effortless style for any day.

Featuring high-quality leather and breathable textiles, it offers a secure fit and a sleek look that pairs effortlessly with your favorite seasonal wardrobe. The iconic architecture of the silhouette is emphasized by the high-contrast tones, providing a sophisticated aesthetic that stands out in any collection. Perfect for the modern trendsetter, this pair bridges the gap between heritage performance and fashion-forward elegance.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Light Brown"
products.description: Elevate your style with the Air Jordan 1 Low "Light Brown" (HF1567 200). This classic silhouette features a versatile light brown hue, perfect for a refined and understated look.

The print appears on the black Swoosh logo on either side of the shoe, on the heel, and on the collar. The rest of the shoe features a black leather construction and a black nylon tongue. A black Jumpman is embroidered on the tongue. Underfoot, a white midsole and black outsole completes the look. Release date: October 20, 2023

An old school “Wings” logo is embroidered on the heel and blue Jumpman is found on the tongue. The laces and inner lining have an Industrial Blue finish. Underfoot, a Sail rubber midsole and a grey rubber outsole complete the look. Release date: April 20, 2024

The shoe has University Blue leather on the perforated toe, collar, heel, and Swoosh. Contrasting black leather appears on the toe cap, forefoot, and mid-panel. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Yellow Orche"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Yellow Ochre” is a black and yellow colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in low-top form. A yellow leather Swoosh is located on both sides, and a black “Wings” logo is embroidered on the heel. Additional details include a Yellow Ochre-colored Jumpman on the black nylon tongue, a white midsole, and yellow outsole. Release date: December 18, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "White/Black"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low "White/Black" is a clean two-tone colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in low-top form. A unique look for the Jordan 1, the “White/Black” features white perforated leather toe and mid-panel, and white leather overlays on the toe cap, forefoot, and eyelets. Contrasting black leather can be found on the Swoosh, collar, and heel. A white “Wings” logo is embroidered on the heel, and classic “Nike Air” detailing can be found on the tongue tag. Underfoot, a white rubber midsole and black rubber midsole complete the look. Release date: December 12, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Philippines"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low "Philippines" is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe designed in the colors of the Philippines’ flag. The colorway features a white leather construction with Game Royal leather on the toe and forefoot. A University Red leather Swoosh is found on either side. The white rubber midsole and icy blue translucent rubber outsole complete the ode to the Philippines. Release date: July 20, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Chinese New Year"
products.description: Ring in the holiday with the ultra-limited Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Chinese New Year." This special edition, commemorating the Year of the Ox, is limited to just 8,500 pairs worldwide. It boasts a classic Black and University Red "Bred" color-block on a textile and satin upper with rich jacquard print. Metallic Gold embroidery featuring florals and Ox designs, along with an elegant tasseled rope bracelet, brings heritage and festive symbolism to the iconic low-top silhouette.

products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low "Royal Toe" is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe inspired by two of the model’s original releases. The Jordan 1 “Black Toe” and “Royal” editions serve as the inspiration behind the Jordan 1 Low “Royal Toe.” More specifically, the shoe has a Royal Blue leather toe box with contrasting black leather on the toe cap, forefoot, and eyelets. The mid-panel is designed in white leather while a Royal Blue leather Swoosh is seen on either side. Classic “Wings” branding is embroidered on the heel and a Jumpman is found on the tongue. Release date: September 15, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Lucky Green"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Lucky Green” is a two-tone, black-and-green colorway of the popular sneaker from Jordan Brand’s Spring 2023 collection. The “Lucky Green” Jordan 1 Low features a Lucky Green perforated leather on the toe and smooth green leather on the Swoosh and heel. Black leather is found on the overlays and on the mid-panel. A black “Wings” logo is embroidered on the heel and black Jumpman branding is stitched onto the green nylon tongue. Release date: April 11, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Vivid Orange"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low "Vivid Orange" is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe that stands out with eye-catching orange accents. The upper features a black synthetic nubuck base with Light Graphite overlays. A leather Vivid Orange Swoosh is located on either side of the shoe, matching font found on the “Wings” logo on the heel. More Vivid Orange accenting is seen on the collar and Jumpman logo on the tongue. A white rubber midsole and black rubber outsole complete the look. Release date: August 29, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Aquatone"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Aquatone” is a colorway of the low-top lifestyle shoe with a warm-weather-inspired look. The “Aquatone” features aqua blue leather on its perforated toe, heel, Swoosh, and collar. The eye-catching shade of blue can also be found on the nylon tongue. White leather appears on the toe cap, forefoot, eyelets, and on the mid-panel. A Celestial Gold Jumpman is embroidered on the tongue and a matching “Wings’ logo is stitched onto the heel.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Black Elephant"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low OG “Black Elephant” is a colorway of the vintage basketball shoe that incorporates a classic patterning of the Air Jordan 3. From Jordan Brand’s “Elephant” collection, the “Black Elephant” iteration of the Jordan 1 Low OG nods to the Air Jordan 3 by featuring its iconic elephant print on its overlay panels. The shoe’s base is designed in black leather. A white leather Swoosh is found on either side. Classic “Wings” and “Nike Air” logos appear on the heel and tongue tag, respectively. Release date: June 23, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Year Of The Rabbit"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Year of the Rabbit” is a limited edition colorway of the classic sneaker that is inspired by Lunar New Year 2023. The “Year of the Rabbit” is the 2023 version of the popular colorway theme by Jordan Brand that has appeared on several Air Jordans in the past. This Jordan 1 Low OG “Year of the Rabbit” was limited to just 5,000 pairs. The shoe features a Sail leather base with contrasting hairy brown suede overlays on the toe, forefoot, and eyelets. A cream suede Swoosh appears on either side of the sneaker while a tonal “Wings” logo is found on the brown leather heel tab. A grey suede overlay is located on the back of the shoe. Nods to rabbits include graphics on the inso

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Eastside Golf"
products.description: The Eastside Golf x Air Jordan 1 Low is a collaboration on the retro basketball shoe by the inspirational golf brand. Eastside Golf is a lifestyle golf brand that aims to raise awareness of golf with a younger generation of athletes. Here, Eastside Golf looks to do just that with an appealing Air Jordan 1 Low collaboration dubbed “Out the Mud.” The shoe features a premium look and build with a Midnight Navy synthetic nubuck construction with a tonal Swoosh on the sides. Mismatched “Eastside Golf” and the brand’s logo appear on the back of the left and right shoe, respectively. Additional “Eastside Golf” detailing can be found on the tongue, as well. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Purple Mocha"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Purple/Mocha” is a colorway of the low-top retro basketball shoe with a unique appearance. Keeping things clean and versatile, the shoe is equipped with a white leather base that gives way to contrasting Palomino (brown) leather overlays. A purple leather Swoosh is found on either side of the shoe. Purple “Wings” branding is embroidered on the heel. Underfoot, a white rubber midsole and brown rubber outsole complete the look. Release date: March 1, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "True Blue"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “True Blue” is a colorway of the vintage basketball shoe that draws inspiration from an original Air Jordan 3 style. The shoe we’re referring to is the Jordan 3 “True Blue,” a popular colorway of Michael Jordan’s third signature shoe that debuted in 1988. Here, Jordan Brand gives the Jordan 1 the same blue accenting as the Jordan 3 “True Blue.” The shoe features a white leather base with True Blue leather overlays. A Cement Grey leather Swoosh logo appears on the sides and a grey “Wings” emblem is embroidered on the heel. A True Blue Jumpman is found on the grey nylon tongue. Release date: January 17, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Dark Concord"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Dark Concord” is a colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in the low-top style that is loosely inspired by the Los Angeles Lakers. In spite of its color scheme that mimics the team uniform colors of the Lakers, the “Dark Concord” nonetheless is only a wink-and-nod to the popular basketball team, as no official “Lakers” branding is found on the design. The shoe features black leather on its overlays, mid-panel, and heel. Contrasting Dark Concord leather appears on the perforated toe and on the Swoosh. A Taxi-colored “Wings” logo is embroidered on the heel while a yellow Jumpman is found on the tongue. Release date: December 6, 2022

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Bordeaux"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Bordeaux” succeeds the colorway of the same nickname that was originally released on the Air Jordan 1 High OG in 2021. Like that shoe, the Jordan 1 Low “Bordeaux” features maroon-colored leather overlays and a white leather base. A Metallic Silver leather Swoosh logo is found on both sides of the shoe. Classic silver “Wings” branding is embroidered on the heel and a silver Jumpman is stitched onto the white nylon tongue. A two-tone, white rubber midsole and Bordeaux outsole complete the look.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Vintage Grey"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low ”Vintage Grey” is a neutral colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in the low-top variation with a vintage look. From Jordan Brand’s Fall 2022 collection, the “Vintage Grey” excels in versatility, as it features a white leather base with contrasting grey leather overlays and Swoosh branding. A white “Wings” logo is embroidered on the heel. A grey Jumpman is stitched onto the white nylon tongue. The shoe’s retro appearance is enhanced with a cream-colored rubber midsole that’s contrasted with a grey outsole.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Triple Black"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Triple Black” is a monochromatic black colorway of the popular low-top sneaker. Certainly one of the most versatile shoes in Jordan Brand’s footwear line, the “Triple Black” edition of the Jordan 1 Low features an all-black-everything design, beginning with a black leather upper. The perforated toe, as well as the mid-panel, overlays, and Swoosh branding on the sides, all appear in black leather. A tonal “Wings” logo is embroidered on the heel. A black Jumpman is stitched onto the black leather tongue. Underfoot, a black rubber sole completes the look.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Shadow Toe"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Shadow Toe” is a modern low-top Jordan 1 that nods to an original 1985 colorway. Designed in a “Light Smoke Grey,” white and black color scheme, this colorway’s nickname references the original “Shadow” Air Jordan 1 High from 1985 in black and grey. This low-top features black and grey on the toe box, hence the name “Shadow Toe,” with more of the two hues throughout. Unlike the original “Shadow,” this edition adds panels of white leather, as well. The heel of the sneaker is complemented with an embroidered Wings logo in black.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "White Toe"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “White Toe” is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe that features the Chicago Bulls’ black, white, and red team uniform colors on its design. The “White Toe” isn’t affiliated with the Bulls, but still draws favorably from Michael Jordan’s former team by applying its uniform colors on its leather panels. The perforated toe is designed in white leather. The rest of the upper, sans the red leather Swoosh, appears in black leather. A fiery red “Wings” logo is embroidered on the heel and a red Jumpman is stitched onto the black nylon tongue. Underfoot, a white midsole and black rubber outsole complete the look.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Triple White"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Triple White” is a crisp, monochromatic white colorway of the classic low-top sneaker. The design features a white leather construction with tonal leather overlays and Swoosh branding on the sides. A white embroidered “Wings” logo is found on the heel and a white Jumpman is stitched on the tonal leather tongue. A white rubber sole completes the all-white-everything look. Release date: September 1, 2022

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Pollen"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Pollen” is a scorching hot colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in the popular low-top silhouette. Released by Jordan Brand in 2021, this “Pollen” colorway features white leather on the perforated toe and mid-panel. The forefoot, eyelets, collar, heel, and Swoosh are designed in Pollen yellow leather. A white “Wings” logo is embroidered on the back and a Pollen-colored Jumpman appears on the white nylon tongue. White “23” embroidery is stitched onto the lace overlay to complete the look.

Where many “UNC” inspired Air Jordans feature University Blue accents, the Jordan 1 Low seen here opts for Powder Blue detailing. products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Bred Toe” looks both the Chicago Bulls and an original colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe for design inspiration. Dressed in the team uniform colors of Jordan’s former basketball team, this low-top variation of the vintage basketball shoe replicates the color block of the original “Black Toe” Jordan 1 worn by Jordan during his rookie season, with a twist. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Black / Particle Grey"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Black/Particle Grey” is a versatile look for the low-top version of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe. The transcendent Air Jordan 1 is one of the greatest performance and lifestyle sneakers ever created by Nike and Jordan Brand due to its casual design, comfort and, of course, connection to the greatest basketball player of all time. The “Black/Particle Grey” features white leather on the perforated toe and mid-panel. Contrasting black leather can be found on the forefoot, eyelets, collar, and heel. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Laser Blue"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Laser Blue” is an intriguing colorway of Michael Jordan’s iconic first signature shoe in the versatile low-top silhouette. Released in Fall 2020, this Jordan 1 follows a similar color block to the “Bred” colorway of the Jordan 1 in that it features a black leather base, but instead of red, “Laser Blue” accenting appears in its place. The bright shade of blue can be found on the forefoot, eyelets, and heel. It also appears on the Swoosh insignia found on either side, and on the mini Jumpman emblem on the black nylon tongue. Black “Wings” embroidery is located on the heel.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "White Camo"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “White Camo” is a versatile and desirable low-top version of Michael Jordan’s signature shoe with a subtle camouflage pattern. This refined look for the Jordan 1 Low features light grey tumbled leather overlays on the forefoot and eyelets. Contrasting white perforated leather appears on the toe and a smooth variant of the material covers the mid-panel. Branding, like the “White Camo” leather Swoosh located on either side, as well as the mini black Jumpman embroidery the tongue and “Wings” emblem on the heel, add classic styling to the Air Jordan 1.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Light Smoke Grey"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Light Smoke Grey” features a neutral look that highlights the versatility of Michael Jordan’s iconic first signature shoe in low-top form. The Jordan 1, one of streetwear’s most popular sneakers of choice, adds a vintage flair to your collection with a timeless design. The same ethos underpins this “Light Smoke Grey” edition. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "University Gold / Black"

The Jordan 1 Low, along with the high-cut iteration of the shoe, originally released in 1985. Today, the shoe is one of the most popular footwear options on the market, and it's easy to see why on this “University Gold/Black” style. A combination of attention-grabbing University Gold leather can be found on the perforated toe and on the forefoot, mid-panel, and heel. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Mocha"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Mocha” is a autumn-ready look for Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe that compares favorably to the brown-based design of Travis Scott’s Air Jordan 1 Low from 2019. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Pine Green"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Pine Green” channels the team uniform colors of one of Michael Jordan’s closest rivals during his playing career: the Boston Celtics. Seen here in versatile low-top form, Jordan’s first signature shoe is equipped with green leather overlays on the forefoot, collar, and eyelets. The hue reappears on the heel and nylon tongue. Both the toe and midfoot are finished off with a crisp with leather. Black Swoosh detailing covers the mid-panel, a black Wings logo can be found on the heel, and a mini Jumpman emblem dots the tongue to complete the look.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Diamond"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Diamond” is a February 2022 release of the low-top retro basketball shoe in a colorway inspired by Air Jordan diamond basketball shorts. Versatile in a black-and-white color block, the “Diamond” features black synthetic nubuck on the toe cap, forefoot, eyelets, mid-panel, and collar. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Laser Blue"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Laser Blue” is the low-top version of Michael Jordan’s signature shoe in an eye-catching colorway that was released during summer 2020. Laser Blue dotted suede detailing can be found on the collar and heel. The suede construction contrasts the white leather base that is visible on the perforated toe and mid-panel. The forefoot, eyelets, and Swoosh on the mid-panel are finished off in smooth black leather. Jordan Brand adds light blue shoelaces that pop against the black nylon tongue. products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Noble Red” remixes the beloved “Chicago” colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in a slightly darker hue that warrants attention everywhere it goes. Slimmed down in wearable low-top form, the “Noble Red” features red leather overlays on the forefoot, collar, and heel. White leather appears on the mid-panel and perforated toe. products.description: The Nike Air Jordan 1 Low brings new meaning to the classic white sneaker. Originally debuted in 1985, this version takes on a more modern, sleek appeal. The upper consists of genuine leather with splash/color detailing on the neon pink, orange, green, and blue Swooshes that flank the sides of the shoe. The Air Sole unit is an added feature that provides a lightweight cushioning to the style, and the rubber outsole ensures a high level of traction on most surfaces.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Gym Red"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Gym Red” is a Chicago Bulls inspired colorway of Michael Jordan’s iconic first signature shoe in its low-top silhouette. The “Gym Red” shade of red has appeared on countless great Jordan models over the years, with this versatile Jordan 1 Low being one of our favorite looks to date. The colorway makes use of the Bulls’ legendary black and red color scheme by featuring red leather overlays on the mid-panel, eyelets, forefoot, and heel. A black leather Swoosh on either side of the shoe balances out the look. Black leather appears on the perforated toe and around the collar playing up the Bulls inspired theme. A classic black “Wings” logo is stitched onto the heel and a re

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Gold Toe"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Gold Toe” is a special release of the low-top Jordan 1 that borrows a popular colorway from the original high-top. The metallic gold, white, and black patent leather construction that first appeared on the Jordan 1 High in 2018 is mirrored on this Jordan 1 Low from 2019. Unlike the high-top’s asymmetrical color blocking, this low features the same look on the lateral and medial sides. Each pair is completed with a tonal Jumpman logo embroidered on the tongue and the classic “wings” logo on the heel. The Air Jordan 1 Low “Gold Toe” released during the summer of 2019.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Travis Scott- Mocha"
products.description: The Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Low is the low-top version of the world famous rapper’s Jordan 1 collaboration. Following the standard high-top Jordan 1 from spring 2019, this Jordan 1 Low by Travis Scott released in July in very limited quantities and achieved the same hype and coveted status as the first design. Scott once again displayed his affinity for earthy tones while also utilizing the same backwards Swoosh design as the initial high-top. The upper is constructed in premium nubuck with black and brown tones, while the large reversed Swoosh contrasts in white leather. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "University Blue / Black"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “University Blue/Black” is a collegiate inspired look for the low-top version of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe. The “University Blue/Black” undoubtedly references the UNC Tar Heels by employing the school’s shade of light blue in its design. The Carolina Blue hue appears on the leather overlays on the forefoot, eyelets, mid-panel, and heel. Black leather can be found on the toe, collar, and Swoosh branding on either side of the shoe. Elsewhere, a black embroidered “Wings” emblem is stitched onto the heel and a University Blue Jumpman appears on the black nylon tongue. Jordan Brand finishes off the look with a white midsole and contrasting black outsole.

Given the low-top treatment, this shoe features an identical color blocking as its high-top relative. Smooth red leather overlays cover the forefoot, collar, and heel. products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “White/Lucky Green” unofficially honors a longtime rival of Michael Jordan’s Chicago Bulls: the Boston Celtics. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Triple Black"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Triple Black” is a versatile option for collectors who appreciate the timeless styling of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in the alternate low-top height. A reliable everyday shoe, the “Triple Black” Air Jordan 1 Low hides dirt easily due to its black monochromatic appearance. Details include black tumbled leather overlays on the forefoot, eyelets, collar, and heel. A variety of smooth black leather can be found on the perforated toe and mid-panel. Black tumbled leather Swoosh branding is located on either side of the shoe. products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Triple White” is a super clean monochromatic colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in low-top height. Premium white tumbled leather appears on the perforated toe, forefoot panels, collar, and heel. Additional design elements include a white nylon tongue with mini Jumpman branding, tonal cotton laces, and a white rubber sole. Release date: Summer 2020.

Additional details include a smooth black leather Swoosh on either side, black laces, and a black nylon tongue with a Court Purple Jumpman on the top of its design. A black embroidered “Wings” emblem can be found on the back of the shoe. Release date: November 4, 2020.

This Jordan 1 Low has a premium suede construction in yellow, white, and black. A red Jumpman is embroidered on the tongue, while a tonal wings logo is found on the heel. A “23” lace loop adds the final touch. The Air Jordan 1 Low “University Gold” released on April 1, 2019.

products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Shattered Backboard” is the low top version of the extremely popular high-top colorway. The Air Jordan 1 “Shattered Backboard” is inspired by an overseas exhibition game Michael Jordan participated in during his rookie 1985 season. During the game, Jordan famously broke the glass of the backboard after a dunk. One of the most sought after non-original Air Jordan 1 models ever, the “Shattered Backboard” returns, this time in low top form. In line with the high-top, the slimmed down low sports premium Starfish-colored tumbled leather on the toe, mid panel, Swoosh, and ankle collar. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low "Court Purple"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Court Purple” is the low-top version of Michael Jordan’s transcendent footwear design with Nike. Chopped down to low-top form, the Air Jordan 1 remains every bit as stylish as its high-top relative. Here, the “Court Purple” Air Jordan 1 Low dons a white leather mid-panel with a contrasting black leather Swoosh layered on top. Rich purple nubuck covers the toe and heel with black nubuck overlays appearing along the toe cap and eyelets. An early 2021 release by Jordan Brand, the “University Blue” Jordan 1 comes in the desirable high-top silhouette and recruits a mixture of materials and “UNC” flavored colors for an appealing design. Full-grain white leather appears on the mid-panel and perforated toe. University Blue nubuck leather overlays on the forefoot, eyelets, collar, and heel contrast the crisp white base. Jordan Brand adds a black leather Swoosh on either side and a black “Wings” logo to the collar. Additional details include black laces on a white nylon tongue, a light blue “Nike Air” logo on the bl

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Light Smoke Grey"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 “Light Smoke Grey” is a Summer 2020 release that captures the attention of sneaker fans and collectors for its ultra wearable color scheme. Both original and non-original Jordan 1 designs are fueling the shoe’s popularity decades after it was first introduced by Nike and Michael Jordan, and this “Light Smoke Grey” look is full proof of that sentiment. The upper combines a clean white leather base that is visible on the perforated toe and mid-panel with Light Smoke Grey suede overlays on the forefoot, eyelets, and heel. Neutral undertones continue on the black leather Swoosh on the mid-panel and black cotton laces. A black Wings logo appears on the red leather overlay sits ab

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "J Balvin"
products.description: The J Balvin x Air Jordan 1 High OG “Colores Y Vibras” is a Holiday 2020 collaboration between the popular Latin artist and Jordan Brand on Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe. With the release of the “Colores Y Vibras,” which translates to “Colors and Vibes” in English, the Colombia native becomes the first Latin musician to collaborate with Jordan Brand, a monumental achievement. As for the design, the upper features a canvas construction with a rainbow-like assortment of colors baked into its look. Jagged panels on the collar, eyelets, heel, and forefoot further the singular look of J Balvin’s design. Other details include multicolor sewn-on Swooshes on either side, a black “Wings” embl

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Dark Mocha"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 “Dark Mocha” progresses the timeless silhouette’s association with wearable earth tones. Inspiration for the “Dark Mocha,” a Fall 2020 release, is culled from one of the most popular sneaker collaborations of 2019—Travis Scott’s Air Jordan 1 collection. Though unlike the rapper’s take on the Jordan 1, this “Dark Mocha” iteration features smooth black leather overlays on the forefoot, eyelets, and toe cap. White leather appears on the mid-panel, collar, and perforated toe. Classic black leather Swoosh branding dots the mid-panel and a black “Wings” logo is placed on the brown suede collar. Additional brown suede detailing is located on the heel. A white nylon tongue, black co

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Defiant Yellow"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High “Defiant” is a unique colorway of the iconic model featuring “unstitched” Swooshes on the lateral sides. The eye-catching construction features a black and white leather upper with red contrast stitching throughout, including for the deconstructed stitching that makes the shape of the Swoosh, intended to appear as if the leather Swoosh was cut off. Intact yellow leather Swooshes are found on each medial side. A black leather tongue and Air Jordan “wings” logo patches complete the distinct colorway. The Air Jordan 1 High “Defiant” with unstitched Swooshes released in July 2019.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Gym Red"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 “Gym Red” is yet another stylish look for the iconic silhouette. This 2019 release features a new take on the classic red, white, and black Chicago Bulls color palette on the Jordan 1. All new yet familiar at the same time, the “Gym Red” colorway is practically a remix of the legendary “Chicago” colorway, opting for more black and less red than the OG version. The colorway also features the black leather with a semi-glossy finish for a touch of flash. The look is completed with a Sail midsole for a vintage effect. The Air Jordan 1 “Gym Red” released on June 29, 2019.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "LA to Chicago"
products.description: The Nike SB x Air Jordan 1 Defiant "LA to Chicago" AKA “Court Purple” is one of two collaborative colorways released by Nike's skateboarding division and Jordan Brand in 2019. The unique editions of the Jordan 1 have the leather on the upper painted in one color combination, while a second colorway is hidden underneath. The bottom layer can be revealed as the top layer of paint is worn away. This “Court Purple” edition of the Air Jordan 1 features a purple, white, and yellow combination that is inspired by a rare original sample of the shoe from 1985 in Los Angeles Lakers team colors. When the top layer is worn off, the original “Chicago” colorway is revealed underneath. The limited edition

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Volt Gold"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High “Volt Gold” is a “do-it-yourself” inspired colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe that was released by Jordan Brand in early 2021. Crafted in the spirit of Off-White and Virgil Abloh’s deconstructed Air Jordan 1s from the coveted “The 10” collection, the “Volt Gold” features contrasting hues of neon yellow and gold on its design, as well as "overcut" leather panels that extend past the stitching. White leather can be found on the perforated toe and mid-panel. Contrasting black leather appears on the forefoot, toe cap, and eyelets. A black “Wings” logo can be found on the Volt collar overlay and a black Swoosh appears on either side of the shoe. Additional det

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Hyper Royal"
products.description: During the summer of 2018 the Air Jordan 1 High OG got updated with a clean "Hyper Royal" look. The striking colorway features the rich blue hue across the leather upper with white accents. The colorway of the Air Jordan 1 "Hyper Royal" is said to be inspired by the classic film He Got Game, referencing the blue and white uniforms of Jesus Shuttlesworth's Lincoln High School in Coney Island.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Black Metallic Gold"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High OG “Black/Metallic Gold” is one of several exciting colorways from Jordan Brand’s Holiday 2020 collection. A luxurious take on Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in the coveted high-top silhouette, the “Black/Metallic Gold” employs premium black patent leather on the entire upper, including the perforated toe, mid-panel, and heel. The look is reminiscent of the Jordan 1 Mid from 2003 that featured the same black leather upper with Metallic Gold accenting. Like that release, the modern look displays a gold leather Swoosh on either side and a gold “Wings” emblem on the collar. Additional Metallic Gold detailing appears beneath the collar overlay and on the “Nike Air” i

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "2017 Royal"
products.description: Once again back is the incredible Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG “Royal”, an original colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe. Like the Remastered “Banned” release, the 2017 Air Jordan Retro High OG receives an upgrade in regards to the quality of materials used and its shape, which is truer to the actual 1985 release. The Varsity Royal blue paneling appears in tumbled leather on the toe box, Swooshes, heel, and ankle. Black premium leather colors the remainder of the upper to complete the classic color blocking. A clean, white midsole balances out the shoe, maintaining the iconic motif along with the Varsity Royal outsole.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Hyper Royal"
products.description: Blue/light grey/white leather Air Jordan 1 Retro High "Hyper Royal" sneakers from JORDAN featuring signature Air Jordan Wings logo, signature Swoosh logo detail, contrasting panel detail, round toe, front lace-up fastening, logo patch at the tongue, ankle-length and rubber sole. These styles are supplied by a premium sneaker marketplace. Stocking only the most sought-after footwear, they source and curate some of the most hard to find sneakers from around the world..

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Trophy Room - Chicago"
products.description: The Trophy Room x Air Jordan 1 High “Chicago” is a limited edition collaboration between Marcus Jordan’s sneaker boutique and Jordan Brand on Michael Jordan’s iconic first signature shoe. Michael’s son Marcus’s Trophy Room boutique adds a vintage look to the classic “Chicago” colorway as an ode to Michael’s wearing of the shoe during the 1985 NBA All-Star Game. Memorably, Jordan was “frozen out” at one point in the game by fellow stars Isiah Thomas and Julius Erving, who refused to pass him the ball as part of a “lesson” to teach Jordan, then an up-and-coming rookie. Several subtle nods to the “freeze out” appear on the shoe, beginning with the icy texture covering the red leather overlays f

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Storm Blue"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High OG “Storm Blue” is an original colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe that was re-released in 2016. The “Storm Blue” is one of multiple designs of the retro basketball shoe to originally release back in 1985. A popular look that draws similarities to the Nike Dunk’s “Kentucky” colorway, the “Storm Blue” was never worn by Jordan in the NBA, and didn’t receive a retro release until 2016. The modern “Storm Blue” is nearly identical to the first version of the white-and-blue colorway, as it features white tumbled leather on the perforated toe, mid-panel, collar, and heel. Contrasting Storm Blue leather appears on the overlays and Swoosh branding. A white “Wings”

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Blue Moon"
products.description: One of the four sneakers in the 2018 “Best Hand in the Game” collection, the Air Jordan 1 “Blue Moon” pays homage to Michael Jordan’s NBA All-Star performances. Jordan was a 14-time All-Star and won the game's MVP award three times. A soft blue nubuck is used on the heel and ankle of the Air Jordan 1 "Blue Moon," and the "Best Hand" collection's playing card theme is incorporated into the insole graphics of the shoes.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Yellow Ochre"
products.description: The "Best Hand in the Game" collection of Air Jordan 1s pays tribute to Michael Jordan’s many career accolades. Each sneaker in the pack, which was released in 2018, has a playing card theme. This Air Jordan 1 “Yellow Ochre” represents Jordan's five NBA MVP awards and shows a royal flush of MVP cards on the insole. The premium sneaker is constructed with soft Yellow Ochre nubuck wrapping the heel of the shoe. The rest of the upper is crafted from white and black leather.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Crimson Tint"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 “Crimson Tint” is another outstanding look for the iconic Jordan 1. Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe is presented in classic color blocking with a Crimson Tint and black color combination. The 2019 Jordan release also features a premium full-grain leather upper with more texture than most Air Jordan 1 constructions. The Crimson Tint panels are a light orange shade, appropriate for the colorway’s spring launch. As an Air Jordan 1 High OG release, this Jordan 1 features Nike Air branding on the tongue to replicate the model’s original 1985 release. The Air Jordan 1 "Crimson Tint" released on April 13, 2019.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Premium Essentials"
products.description: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG 555088 102

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Phantom"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High OG “Phantom” is another outstanding look for Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe. The unique construction for the iconic silhouette features a “crinkled” leather base in Sail with Phantom (light grey) leather overlays and University Red accents on the contrast stitching and double Swoosh. The sole unit matches the Sail color on the upper. Metal lace grommets add another unique touch to this colorway, while black details for the “wings” Air Jordan logo and Nike Air logo on the tongue complete the clean look. The Air Jordan 1 High OG “Phantom” released in March 2019.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Turbo Green"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High “Turbo Green” is a unique colorway for the classic Michael Jordan signature shoe that released as part of the 2019 NBA All-Star collection from Nike and Jordan Brand. The washed leather upper in Turbo Green and white pays tribute to the classic Charlotte Hornets team colors, the host team for the 2019 All-Star game, and gives the shoe a vintage look. A gold and purple Nike logo is found on the tongue, and alternate purple laces are included to add to the Hornets vibe. The upper also features a new detail that appeared on select pairs of Air Jordan 1's in 2019: text of the model name and season of release printed on the midfoot. The Air Jordan 1 High “Turbo Green” releas

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Clay Green"
products.description: From the 2018 “Best Hand in the Game” collection, the Air Jordan 1 “Clay Green” pays tribute to the staggering sum of Michael Jordan’s many achievements and awards during his career, from Offensive and Defensive Player of the Year awards to NBA titles to his Hall of Fame induction . The sneaker features soft green nubuck around the heel and ankle to accent the white and black leather upper.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Black Toe 2016"
products.description: Overshadowed by other original Air Jordan 1 colorways like “Bred”, “Chicago” and “Royal”, this “Black Toe” edition is no less important when it comes to the history of the legendary shoe. Worn on court by Michael Jordan during his rookie season, the Air Jordan 1 Black Toe features a similar look to the Chicago colorway, but takes away some of the red from the upper in favor of black on the eyestay and toe panels. This listing is for the 2016 release of the Black Toe Jordan 1, which disappeared from stock immediately wherever it was released. Grab a pair now before they disappear again.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Bred Banned 2016"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High in the iconic black and red colorway returned once again in 2016 as part of the “Banned” campaign celebrating the history of the shoe. The legendary silhouette is presented in its "OG" iteration featuring an accurate shape and materials to compare to its original release. Simply put, the Air Jordan 1 "Bred" is an essential piece of any sneaker collection.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Neutral Grey/Hyper Crimson"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 “Neutral Grey/Hyper Crimson” is a unique colorway and construction for the iconic silhouette. Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe retains its original shape, but received this updated look in early 2019 with a soft black leather base, grey brushed suede panels, and a bright hit of Hyper Crimson suede around the collar. The inner lining also features the bright red hue. This marks the debut release for the Jordan 1 High OG with added text printed on the midfoot panel that denotes its Spring ‘19 release and model name, which is a detail likely inspired by Virgil Abloh’s Off-White collaborations with Nike. The Air Jordan 1 “Neutral Grey/Hyper Crimson” released in January 2019

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Reverse Shattered Backboard"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High OG “Reverse Shattered Backboard” released in 2016 as a follow up to the original color concept. This Jordan 1 takes inspiration from the colors of a uniform that Michael Jordan wore while participating in an exhibition game in Italy in 1985. In the game, Jordan broke a plexiglass backboard after a dunk. The black, orange, and white color scheme was first used on the Air Jordan 1 "Shattered Backboard" in 2015, and then returned in this second "Reverse Shattered Backboard" iteration, which features more orange and less black on the leather paneling. The colorway is also known as “Shattered Backboard Away.” Just like the original, the Air Jordan 1 High OG “Reverse Shattere

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Ying-Yang"
products.description: Half of what is being dubbed the “Yin Yang Pack”, this Air Jordan 1 High features a clean and simple black leather upper with white accents and a pop of red for the Nike Air tongue tag.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Shadow 2018"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 "Shadow" is one of the most versatile versions of Michael Jordan's first signature sneaker. The combination of black and dark grey can be worn with just about anything, which is why these shoes have been an essential part of sneaker rotations for many years. The Air Jordan 1 "Shadow" was re-released in 2018 and was faithful to the original standards, with a premium leather upper and Nike Air branding on the tongue.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Game Royal"
products.description: Jordan Brand did an experiment to see what would happen when it combined two of the most iconic colorways of the Air Jordan 1. The result is another amazing colorway. The Air Jordan 1 High “Game Royal” brings together the popular “Royal” and “Chicago” versions of the classic sneaker. The color blocking on this Air Jordan 1 is similar to the “Chicago” edition, but the traditional red leather paneling is replaced with royal blue.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Bio Hack"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High “Bio Hack” is a daring new colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe that loosely resembles a special collaboration in Jordan Brand’s history. The “Bio Hack” pulls inspiration from Undefeated’s mid-2000s Nike SB Dunk colorway in which various contrasting colors were joined together to form one of the most daring Jordan 1s of the era. Differing slightly from the “OG” look it draws favorably from, the “Bio Hack” nonetheless displays a totally mixed-up appearance, beginning with a Baroque Brown collar and heel that looks to have been used on Travis Scott’s Air Jordan 1 from 2019. Elsewhere, a Metallic Silver leather Swoosh appears on the black nubuck mid-panel, and

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "DAVID LETTERMAN"
products.description: Inspired by the warm-up suit a young Michael Jordan wore during his appearance on the Late Show with David Letterman in 1985, where he discussed his first signature shoe, this Air Jordan 1 features a bright red upper with navy accents. Special “On Air” graphics are found on the insole.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Black Satin/Gym Red"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 “Black Satin” continues Jordan Brand’s dedicated focus of shifting Michael Jordan’s first signature model toward the lifestyle footwear category. The stealthy Air Jordan 1 “Black Satin” makes for an easy plug-in to your daily rotation thanks to its versatile, predominantly black makeup. Emanating a subtle sheen, a black satin finish is applied to the toe, mid-panel and collar. Soft black leather overlays cover the toe, forefoot and eyelets. Jordan Brand equips the “Black Satin” Jordan 1 with tonal Swoosh branding, while a red Wings logo and tonal cotton laces add contrasting accents. A white midsole and black outsole put the finishing touches on the design. Release date: Jan

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "RE2PECT"
products.description: One of the greatest living baseball players gets honored by Jordan Brand once again with this special Derek Jeter RE2PECT edition of the Air Jordan 1. In a colorway that will quickly call to mind the OG “Shadow” Air Jordan 1 in black and grey, look closer and you’ll see that the upper is covered with a tonal text print in reflective material, with inspirational words including “RE2SPECT”, “FEARLESS”, “DISCIPLINE”, and “FOCUS”. The Air Jordan 1 RE2PECT is no doubt a home run for Derek Jeter fans, and its limited release has left it harder to come by than a triple play.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Royal Toe"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 “Royal Toe” employs a remixed color scheme that incorporates one of the model’s most essential colorways. The Spring 2020 release features the beloved Jordan 1 “Royal” hue on the perforated toe and ankle collar. A buttery smooth white leather base covers the mid-panel and Wings logo on the collar. Elsewhere, black leather overlays cover the forefoot, eyelets and heel. Jordan Brand opts for a black leather Swoosh and black nylon tongue to finish off the look reminiscent of the coveted fragment x Air Jordan 1. Release date: Spring 2020.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Court Purple 2.0"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 “Court Purple” features a positively regal color scheme as part of Jordan Brand’s continuous efforts in producing coveted non-original Jordan 1 colorways. The Air Jordan 1 “Court Purple” uses a familiar formula in the line’s design history, as purple leather overlays across the upper contrast a clean white leather base. A black Swoosh hit on the mid-panel and black Wings logo on the collar are standard-issue Jordan 1 design elements. Jordan Brand completes the look with a white midsole and Court Purple outsole. Release date: April 2020.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Solefly"
products.description: The SoleFly x Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG is a limited edition colorway by the sneaker boutique that released during Miami's renowned art festival in 2018. Dressed in a premium leather construction with tones of orange, Sail, and dark green, the colorway is inspired by the colors of Miami. The iconic “Wings” logo is embossed for a tonal look on each ankle, while an embossed SoleFly logo is present on each heel. Additional “MIA” and “305" callouts to the south Florida city are found on the interior of each tongue. Every pair comes with three sets of gold-tipped laces in colors that match the upper, and a metallic gold Jumpman keychain is also included. The SoleFly x Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Spider-Man: Origin Story"
products.description: The Spider-Man x Air Jordan 1 “Origin Story” is a special edition of Michael Jordan's first signature shoe that celebrates the 2018 release of the Marvel movie “Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.” Using the blueprint of the original “Chicago” colorway that is worn by the character Miles Morales in the film, the design features a white and and red leather upper with a few modifications inspired by Spider-Man. The red leather panels on the upper feature a tonal dot print that is also reflective, referencing Spider-Man’s suit. The “Nike Air” tongue tag is presented in blue and red as another nod to the superhero, while an icy clear outsole completes the colorway. Released on December 14, 2018 t

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Shattered Backboard 3.0"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 OG “Shattered Backboard 3.0” is the third release of the immensely sought-after “Shattered Backboard” colorway of the Air Jordan 1. The “Shattered Backboard” theme draws inspiration from an exhibition game in Italy in which Michael Jordan played during his rookie season. During the game, Jordan famously broke the glass of the backboard following a monstrous dunk. The first two iterations of the “Shattered Backboard” were a success due to their use of premium materials and eye-catching orange and black colorways. The “Shattered Backboard 3.0” falls in line with previous versions of the sneaker and adds new design features to stand out on its own. One noticeable difference is
