products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Sports Illustrated / A Star Is Born"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 “Sports Illustrated” is a special edition colorway of the iconic model inspired by the first cover of Sports Illustrated that Michael Jordan appeared on as a member of the Chicago Bulls. After appearing on the SI cover in college, Jordan quickly made the cover as a Bulls rookie in December 1984 with the headline “A Star Is Born.” The magazine showed Jordan in action against the Milwaukee Bucks, and that image inspired this Jordan 1 colorway. The shoe features a black and white leather upper. The green and white embroidered Swooshes with a red border are a reference to the Bucks’ uniforms. Each pair also comes with three sets of laces in black, red, and green. The Air Jordan

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Obsidian/University Blue"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High “Obsidian/University Blue” is a 2019 release of the legendary silhouette in a colorway inspired by Michael Jordan’s college career at the University of North Carolina. Similar to the women’s exclusive “UNC Patent Leather” colorway that released in February 2019, this fall release in men’s sizing replaces the glossy patent leather construction with full-grain leather for the Sail, Obsidian, and University Blue color blocking. The clean look became an instant hit, and the Air Jordan 1 High “Obsidian/University Blue” is now yet another coveted colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Rookie of the Year"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 “Rookie of the Year” is a unique colorway commemorating Michael Jordan’s Rookie of the Year honors in 1985. When Jordan won the award after his debut NBA season in 1984-85, the Chicago Bulls star accepted the trophy wearing a tan-colored jacket, which inspires the primary color on this shoe. The construction features a white full-grain leather base with tan nubuck overlays and black accents. This Jordan 1 colorway also has hidden details under the detached ankle panels, including MJ's rookie season statistics and a quote from his acceptance speech. The Air Jordan 1 “Rookie of the Year” released in November 2018.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Cyber Monday"
products.description: Nicknamed after its drop date on Cyber Monday 2015, this stylish version of the Air Jordan 1 High OG features a tonal black leather upper contrasted with a solid white sole. The clean and simple colorway makes for one of the most wearable and versatile looks for the timeless silhouette ever.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Pine Green"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High “Pine Green” released during fall 2018 and become an instant classic. The “Pine Green” Jordan 1 has the same color blocking as the popular “Bred Toe” colorway, but replaces the red accents with a dark green shade to go along with black and white leather paneling across the upper. The colorway is understandably compared to the “Celtics” colorway released as part of the Air Jordan 1 Defining Moments Pack in 2009. It provides a great alternative for those that missed out on the now-rare release.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "UNC"
products.description: Returning for the first time ever in the Air Jordan 1's original high-top silhouette, the "North Carolina" colorway returned in 2015 for the first time since the shoe's initial 1985 release. Inspired by Michael Jordan's alma mater, the shoe features a University of North Carolina color scheme in Carolina Blue with white accents, completed with original "Nike Air" branding on the tongue.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Sail"
products.description: Once again, Jordan Brand dresses the Air Jordan 1 High in a tonal look. The second ever “Premium Essentials” release sees MJ’s first signature sneaker return in Sail, a clean off-white colorway. The result is a simple shoe that you can dress up or wear casually. A textured tumbled leather appears throughout the upper. The famous “Wings” logo maintains its usual resting place on the ankle. Nike branding on the tongue features a hit of red, the lone deviation from the monochromatic color scheme. We’d say this is the perfect AJ 1 for summer ’17 and beyond.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Metallic Red"
products.description: Similar to how the “Midnight Navy” retro from 2016 was approached, Jordan Brand provides a history lesson on the iconic Air Jordan 1 silhouette with the rerelease of a less familiar original colorway from 1985. Enter the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Metallic Red”. This shoe features a premium white leather upper with Varsity Red accents appearing throughout. Patent leather with a metallic look coats the ankle collar and Swoosh. The traditional "Wings" logo has its traditional resting place on the ankle. The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Metallic Red" is also accompanied by an extra set of red laces.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Shattered Backboard"
products.description: Released in 2015, the “Shattered Backboard” Air Jordan 1 High is inspired by an exhibition game Michael Jordan participated in back in 1985 in Trieste, Italy where he broke the glass backboard after a dunk. Constructed in high quality tumbled leather in the original high­top silhouette of the Air Jordan 1, the orange, black, and white colorway is taken from the team uniform MJ wore during the game and modeled after the OG “Black Toe” AJ1 color block. Highly limited upon its initial release, the “Shattered Backboard” Air Jordan 1 disappeared quickly and is now one of the most sought after non­original colorways of the legendary shoe.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Black Toe"
products.description: One of the celebrated original colorways of the Air Jordan 1 from 1985, the “Black Toe” edition features a look similar to the “Chicago” colorway but with a different take on the color blocking. This 2013 release was the first time that the “Black Toe” colorway was retroed in the Jordan 1 High's OG construction complete with an accurate shape and Nike Air branding on the tongue.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Royal 2013"
products.description: The 2013 release of the "Royal" Air Jordan 1 High, these feature the shoe in its original high-top construction complete with "Nike Air" branding on the tongue. A favorite colorway of one of the greatest sneakers of all time, the iconic "Royal" Air Jordan 1 is a must-have in any collection.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Fragment"
products.description: In 2015 Hiroshi Fujiwara’s renowned fragment design label got their very own edition of the Air Jordan 1, based off the colorway of an original unreleased sample. Basically the OG “Black Toe” and “Royal” colorways put together, the appealing look for the Air Jordan 1 was released in very limited quantities, and is now one of the most sought after versions of the silhouette ever.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Bred 2013"
products.description: One of the most iconic and important sneakers of all time, the original black and red Air Jordan 1 was worn by Michael Jordan in 1985 and will be forever legendary. Here we have the 2013 release, which returned the shoe to its truest form with the Air Jordan 1's original high-top cut and Nike Air branding on the tongue.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Carmine"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 borrows the iconic “Carmine” color scheme from the Air Jordan 6, featuring a black and red upper with black accents and an icy clear sole.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Chicago"
products.description: Perhaps the most iconic sneaker of all-time, this original “Chicago” colorway is the cornerstone to any sneaker collection. Made famous in 1985 by Michael Jordan, the shoe has stood the test of time, becoming the most famous colorway of the Air Jordan 1. This 2015 release saw the Chicago colorway return to its most accurate construction since the first retro in 1994, complete with Nike Air branding on the tongue.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Midnight Navy"
products.description: Step into a timeless classic with the Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Midnight Navy." This beloved silhouette features a deep navy and white colorway, offering a versatile and sophisticated look. Experience comfortable cushioning and a design celebrated for its enduring appeal, perfect for any occasion.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Team Red"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High OG “Team Red” is a colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in a two-tone, white-and-red color block. The “Team Red” was released as part of Jordan Brand’s Spring 2024 footwear line, and features a white leather base contrasted with Team Red leather overlays and Swoosh branding. A “Wings” logo appears on the collar and “Nike Air” detailing is seen on the tongue tag. Underfoot, a white rubber midsole and Team Red rubber outsole complete the look. Release date: April 27, 2024

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Earth Tone"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Earth Tone” is a rugged update to Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in the popular mid-top style that features earth tones on its design. Living up to its nickname, the “Earth Tone” colorway of the retro basketball shoe is assembled in neutral, earth tones like brown and tan for an autumnal look. Dark Chocolate-colored suede appears on the overlays. The perforated toe, mid-panel, and collar appear in a lighter brown shade of synthetic nubuck. A black Swoosh with brown contrast stitching appears on both sides of the shoe and a black “Wings” logo is located on the collar. Classic Jumpman and “Air” branding in tan contrast the look of the black nylon tongue tag foun

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Night Stadium"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Night Stadium" is a colorway of the alternate mid-top silhouette of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe inspired by Halloween. While no Halloween branding or decorations are seen on the “Night Stadium,” the sneaker nonetheless sources inspiration from the spooky holiday with its black, grey, and orange color scheme—the colors most commonly associated with Halloween. The base is designed in grey suede while the overlays are seen in a darker shade of grey nubuck. A black leather Swoosh with Total Orange contrast stitching appears on both sides. Black “Wings” branding is found on the collar while an orange Jumpman is paired with an “Air” logo on the tongue tag. The wh

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Off White University Red"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Off White University Red" delivers a fresh, expressive take on the classic mid-top silhouette. Crafted with premium full-grain leather and rich textured overlays, this iteration pairs an Off-White base with striking University Red and Fire Pink accents. A stitched-down Swoosh, iconic Wings logo on the collar, and encapsulated Nike Air cushioning complete this bold, streetwear-ready colorway.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Hellfire"
products.description: Ignite your street style with the Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Hellfire". This fiery mid top sneaker brings a bold edge to your everyday rotation, featuring a sleek black upper sharply contrasted by vibrant Tough Red details and laces. Crafted with premium materials for lasting durability and reliable ankle support, it delivers the ultimate mix of classic heritage and fierce energy. Step out with total confidence and make a powerful statement wherever your day takes you.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "World Tour"
products.description: Step out in global style with the Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "World Tour." Reimagining the legendary AJ1 blueprint into a lifestyle standout, this mid-top iteration pairs crisp Sail leather with bold black overlays. Eye-catching pops of color take over the design, highlighted by a vibrant Pinksicle Swoosh and sharp University Gold accents on the Wings logo and Jumpman. Anchored by responsive Air cushioning in the heel and a classic rubber cupsole, it delivers premium comfort and a timeless, vintage-inspired look.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Crimson Tint/Hyper Pink"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Crimson Tint” is a unique and vibrant look for the classic mid-top Jordan 1. The premium edition features a white leather base with Crimson Tint suede overlays. Black nylon is utilized for the paneling around the ankle and the Swooshes. Hyper Pink hits are found on the laces and outsole to complete the eye-catching mix of pastel, dark, and bright shades across the silhouette. The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Crimson Tint” released in spring 2019.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Mismatch Swoosh"
products.description: Make a statement with the Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Mismatch Swoosh. This special edition sneaker injects bold energy into a classic mid-top silhouette, showcasing a crisp white and black leather base accented by striking Court Purple and Bright Mango tones. The asymmetrical, mismatched Swoosh logos provide an eye-catching, playful twist on traditional Jordan heritage. Complete with a padded collar and a classic encapsulated Air-sole unit, it delivers premium street style and all-day comfort.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Chutney / Green"
products.description: Make a bold impression on the streets with the Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Chutney / Green". Featuring a vibrant mix of smooth green leather and warm Chutney yellow tan overlays, this eye catching mid top sneaker brings dynamic color contrast to a legendary profile. Bright pink swooshes and matching collar lining pop against the earthy tones, while encapsulated Air sole cushioning provides responsive, all day comfort. Complete with the iconic Wings logo, it is the ultimate lifestyle upgrade.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Medium Olive"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Medium Olive" delivers a clinical, high-status execution of the 1985 court legend, masterfully blending its basketball heritage with a radical, utilitarian technicality. This iteration features a premium tumbled sail leather base paired with lush charcoal grey suede overlays, providing a sophisticated, multi-dimensional foundation for the model’s iconic profile. The design is defined by its explosive, "Tactical-Luxe" strike, utilizing specialized "Medium Olive" canvas-like textile on the collar that injects a layer of high-octane durability against the muted suede. Grounded by a vintage-aged "Sail" midsole and finished with a dark charcoal Swoosh and Wings logo for a

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Blue Chill"
products.description: Refresh your rotation with the frosty aesthetic of the Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Blue Chill." This 2025 Special Edition release captures the essence of the "UNC" legacy with a modern, high-contrast palette of Summit White, Black, and the titular Blue Chill.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Team Orange"
products.description: Orange Air Jordan 1 Mid SE team orange from jordan featuring a contrasting blue front lace-up fastening, perforations at the toes, a contrast black Swoosh applique to the side walls and a black Air Jordan motif to the side of the heel.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Black/Beige"
products.description: Elevate your rotation with the sophisticated palette of the Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Black/Beige." This 2025 release redefines the mid-top silhouette with a luxurious blend of materials, featuring a deep black leather base contrasted by Pale Vanilla and Sanddrift overlays. The subtle beige tones extend to the iconic Wings logo and tongue branding, creating a versatile, "coffee-and-cream" aesthetic that transitions effortlessly from the street to more refined settings. It's a masterclass in neutral color-blocking for the modern collector.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Phantom Iridescent"
products.description: Step into a shimmering, sophisticated aesthetic with the Air Jordan 1 Mid SE. "Phantom / Iridescent". This celebrated sneaker features a neutral Phantom base complemented by striking, color-shifting Iridescent accents. Enjoy superior Air cushioning and a design that’s perfect for making a stylish statement with a subtle, futuristic gleam.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "White Sea Glass"
products.description: Step up your game with the Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "White Sea Glass." This Special Edition refresh of the classic silhouette blends premium genuine leather and velvety nubuck for a sophisticated look. Featuring a clean White base complemented by soft Sea Glass and Guava Ice accents, it delivers a uniquely elegant style. Signature Air-Sole cushioning in the heel provides all-day comfort, finished with a metal Wings logo for a truly premium feel.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Stain Gold"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid "Stain Gold" presents a special edition colorway that looks and feels luxe. Gold satin lays the foundation, while smooth navy blue nubuck covers the overlays throughout the sophisticated style. A white sole grounds the shoe, while a hot pink Jumpman logo tops off the branding on the tongue.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Pine Green"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Pine Green” was part of the “Rivals Pack” that featured versions of the Jordan 1 in color schemes inspired by rivals of Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls. This colorway references the Boston Celtics in Pine Green with Sail and black accents that calls to mind Jordan and the Bulls' heated contests with the Larry Bird-led squad. The shoe is constructed with soft full-grain leather for a premium look. The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Pine Green” released in December 2018.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "South Beach"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid “South Beach” from 2018 gives a tropical look to the iconic silhouette. This version of the mid-top Jordan 1 adds some Miami vibes to the classic model with a Turbo Green and white leather upper that is accented with black and hot pink. A striped Jumpman logo tag on each tongue adds the finishing touch to the colorful Air Jordan 1 Mid “South Beach.”

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Flight Club"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Flight Club” is a colorway of the popular lifestyle shoe with multi-color overlay panels. The “Flight Club” Jordan 1 Mid features a white leather base with contrasting faded pink suede on the toe cap, forefoot, and eyelets. Faded tan suede is found on the collar and heel. A black leather Swoosh logo is located on the sides. Classic “Wings” branding is located on the collar. A yellow Jumpman is embroidered on the black nylon tongue. Release date: May 22, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Space Jam"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Space Jam” is a head-turning colorway of the popular lifestyle shoe that is inspired by a classic Air Jordan design. The design we’re referring to is the Air Jordan 11’s “Space Jam” colorway that was worn by Michael Jordan in the movie of the same name. The Jordan 1 Mid “Space Jam” draws favorably from the Jordan 11 in that it is constructed with black patent leather on its design, here on its overlay panels and on the “Wings” branding on the collar and the Swoosh branding found on either side. The shoe’s base is designed in tonal black leather. A white rubber midsole and icy blue translucent rubber outsole completes the “Space Jam” theme.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Wear-Away - Infrared"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Wear-Away - Infrared” is a colorway of the mid-top sneaker with wear-away overlays. Very loosely inspired by the Air Jordan 1’s original “Chicago” colorway, the “Wear-Away - Infrared” features a similar color block to the iconic shoe, but with a few noticeable modifications. The shoe has a white leather base that’s contrasted with Infrared-colored leather overlays with a wear-away black pattern. A black leather Swoosh is found on the sides and a black “Wings” logo appears on the collar. An Infrared Jumpman appears on the tongue.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Ice Blue"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Ice Blue” is a colorway of the lifestyle shoe that calls to mind the popular “UNC” theme. Originally appearing on the Jordan 1 in 1985, the “UNC” color story, inspired by Michael Jordan’s alma mater, has since been featured on many other Jordan shoes, and it seems to loosely inspire this Jordan 1 Mid “Ice Blue” colorway. The upper features an Ice Blue leather perforated toe and white leather mid-panel, toe cap, forefoot, and eyelet overlay. A black leather Swoosh appears on either side of the shoe. Black “Wings” branding is found on the collar and Ice Blue Jumpman detailing is found on the tongue. Underfoot, a white rubber midsole and Ice Blue outsole complete the lo

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Tartan Swoosh"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Tartan Swoosh” is a unique colorway of the popular lifestyle shoe with a tartan plaid Swoosh. Like its name suggests, the “Tartan Swoosh” updates the Jordan 1 Mid with a plaid Swoosh that gives the shoe a decidedly casual look. The upper features a Sesame-colored leather base with black leather overlays. A red “Wings” logo appears on the collar and a white Jumpman logo is found on the tartan tongue tag. The white rubber midsole is paired with a black outsole.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Tie-Dye"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Tie-Dye” is a clean look for the mid-top sneaker that calls to mind warm weather style. The aptly named “Tie-Dye” features a purple based tie-dye pattern on the collar and heel overlays. The perforated toe and mid-panel are designed in white leather. Contrasting black leather overlays and Swoosh branding balance the look. A black “Wings” logo is found on the collar and a pink Jumpman with “Air” detailing can be found on the black nylon tongue tag.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Orange Wear Away"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Orange Wear-Away” is a colorway of the casual sneaker with wear-away panels. The “Orange Wear-Away” Jordan 1 Mid has a white leather base with orange leather overlays that have a painted-black effect. A solid black leather Swoosh is found on either side of the shoe and a black “Wings” logo is seen on the heel. A classic Jumpman is embroidered on the black nylon tongue. Release date: December 1, 2022

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "University Blue / Grey"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “University Blue/Grey” is a colorway of the lifestyle shoe with a “UNC” inspired appearance. In no way affiliated with the University of North Carolina, the “University Blue/Grey” nonetheless shows appreciation for the school with its use of the school’s sports team’s uniform colors on its design. The shoe is complete with a white leather base with University Blue leather overlays and Swoosh branding. Grey suede can be found on the collar and heel. A classic “Wings” logo resides on the aforementioned ankle collar panel. University Blue Jumpman and “Air” logos appear on the tongue tag on the white mesh tongue.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Brushstroke"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Brushstroke” is a Spring 2021 release of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in a colorway imagined through the lens of an artist. Appearing on the popular mid-top version of the classic basketball shoe, the “Brushstroke” is yet another creative offering by Jordan Brand that progresses the Jordan 1 Mid’s association with casual, lifestyle colorways. On the upper, a crisp white canvas material is found on the perforated toe, mid-panel, and collar. Cider suede panels contrast the look. A black brushstroke-style Swoosh logo appears on the lateral side of the shoe and a Cider-colored Swoosh is found on the medial side. Multicolor paint splatters appear on the beige suede

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Heat Reactive"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Heat Reactive” is an intriguing colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe with a color changing finish. Appearing on the popular mid-top version of the retro basketball shoe, the “Heat Reactive” features a familiar color block with a twist. The white leather found on the perforated toe and the black leather on the toe cap, forefoot, and eyelets mimics the styling cadence of the Air Jordan 1’s original “Black Toe” colorway from 1985. The collar, heel, and tongue tag feature a heat-reactive finish that changes colors after a few minutes of wear and activity. When room temperature, the overlays appear in a black leather finish. A black leather Swoosh resides on eit

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Metallic Gold"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Metallic Gold” is a flashy colorway of Michael Jordan’s legendary first signature shoe in its mid-top version. Released in November 2020, the Special Edition (SE) “Metallic Gold” continues both Nike and Jordan Brand’s love for the luxurious metallic theme, having previously been used on iconic models such as the Air Force 1, Air Max 1, and Jordan 1. As for the design of this shoe, smooth white leather panels on the perforated toe and mid-panel form the base of the upper. Metallic Gold leather overlays come into play on the forefoot, eyelets, collar, and heel, cutting a premium look for the Jordan 1 Mid. Elsewhere, a black leather Swoosh appears on either side and a b

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Siempre Familia"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Siempre Familia” is a special edition of the classic basketball shoe released as part of Nike’s “Dia de los Muertos” collection honoring the traditional Mexican holiday. A creative look for the Air Jordan 1 Mid, the “Siempre Familia” is a colorway inspired by Mictlán, the underworld of Aztec mythology that spans nine levels. Details include animal-inspired graphics and prints that reference those that usher one into the afterlife. The upper features a predominantly black appearance with unique details such as textured overlays and a modified bow-and-arrow-style Swoosh. The “Wings” logo is designed in a multicolor look inspired by “Dia de los Muertos.” Jaguar-inspired

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Electro Orange"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Electro Orange” is a bold colorway of the mid-top version of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe. Despite never appearing on Michael’s feet during his time in the NBA (the Air Jordan 1 Mid debuted in the mid-2000s after he had retired from basketball), the mid-top silhouette is one of the more popular Air Jordans in Jordan’s collection, and it’s easy to see why on the “Electro Orange.” The white-and-orange color block brings to mind the classic Nike Dunk “Syracuse” from the “Be True to Your School” pack from 1985. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Diamond"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Diamond” is the alternate mid-top version of the colorway inspired by Air Jordan diamond basketball shorts. Released in February 2022, the “Diamond” style also appeared on the Jordan 1 Low. Design elements include a black synthetic nubuck toe cap, forefoot, eyelets, mid-panel, and collar. The perforated toe, mid-panel, collar, and heel are designed in white leather. A black “Wings” logo is embroidered on the back of the shoe. The unique “diamond” logo found on the tongue tag mimics the design of the same detailing found on the sides of Jordan Brand’s mesh basketball shorts, which are inspired by classic Chicago Bulls shorts. A white rubber midsole and milky translucent

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Grey / Pine Green / White"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Grey/Pine Green/White” is clean look for the lifestyle shoe that combines suede and leather materials. From Jordan Brand’s 2021 collection, the “Grey/Pine Green/White” variation of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe makes use of a Boston Celtics-esque team color palette of green and white, and also adds grey. The perforated toe and mid-panel appear in white leather. Light Smoke Grey suede overlays can be found on the forefoot, eyelets, and heel. A Pine Green leather Swoosh graces either side and a green “Wings” logo is located on the collar. Additional Pine Green detailing comes into play on the leather collar and on the Jumpman and “Air” branding on the white nyl

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Coconut Milk"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Coconut Milk” is a versatile look for the mid-top version of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe that combines a cream-colored base with grey suede overlays. From Jordan Brand’s Spring 2022 collection, the “Coconut Milk” colorway features a coconut-colored canvas base with contrasting Particle Grey suede overlay panels and Swoosh branding. A classic “Wings” logo appears on the collar. A Particle Grey Jumpman with “Air” branding is embroidered on the top of the Coconut Milk canvas tongue. Both the laces and interior lining are designed in grey. Underfoot, the white rubber midsole is matched to a gum-colored outsole to complete the look.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Amarillo Orange"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Amarillo Orange” gives the alternate mid-top version of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe a decidedly off court look. Over the years, few silhouettes in Jordan Brand’s footwear collection have been released in more exciting and bold colorways than the Air Jordan 1 Mid. The “Amarillo Orange” is a testament to the notion. A black synthetic nubuck material is applied to the mid-panel, forefoot, and collar. Team Orange leather detailing appears on the perforated toe and bright shade of yellow leather is used on the eyelets and collar. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Cyber / Active Fuchsia"
products.description: The Women’s Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Cyber/Active Fuchsia” is a vivacious colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in its mid-top silhouette. Fitted in women’s sizing, the “Cyber/Active Fuchsia” Jordan 1 Mid evokes summer’s casual and carefree vibes thanks to its eccentric design that combines materials, textures, and colors in a unique new way. Glossy black patent leather overlays appear on the forefoot, toe cap, and eyelets. The same premium patent leather detailing is used again on the Active Fuchsia collar and heel overlays. A variety of smooth white leather forms the base of the upper. Elsewhere, a dark neon green patent leather Swoosh logo can be found on each lateral side while b

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Signal Blue"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Signal Blue” dresses the mid-top version of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in a clean and casual look reminiscent of the popular original “UNC” colorway. Appearing slightly darker in shade, the glossy Signal Blue leather panels on this Jordan 1 Mid nonetheless evoke the primary team uniform color of Michael Jordan’s alma mater, the UNC Tar Heels. Smooth white leather detailing can be found on the perforated toe and on the mid-panel and collar. Jordan Brand adds blue contrast stitching to the border of the black leather Swoosh branding on either side and places a black “Wings” logo on the collar. Black laces are layered on top of the blue nylon tongue. A black

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Nylon - Black/Grey"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE Nylon is a remixed version of the Air Jordan 1 Mid design. Neutral palettes on Air Jordan 1 models let the sneaker’s classic silhouette do the talking, and the same can be said with this Air Jordan 1 Mid SE. Reminiscent of the Aleali May Air Jordan 1 released in 2017, the Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Nylon” relies heavily on Oakland Raiders-esque vibes, and features a silver nylon material on the toe, Swoosh logo, and collar. Black nubuck overlays, laces, and tongue further adds to the shadowy appeal of the sneaker. The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Nylon” released Summer 2019.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Turf Orange"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Turf Orange” is yet another great look for the alternate mid-top version of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe. The Air Jordan 1 Mid is one of the most popular models in the Jordan line due to its heritage and lifestyle based colorways, like the “Turf Orange.” Glossy Turf Orange leather overlays appear on the forefoot, eyelets, collar, and heel. White leather can be found on the perforated toe, mid-panel, and collar. Jordan Brand places a black patent leather Swoosh with orange contrast stitching on either side of the shoe. A black “Wings” logo appears on the collar and a black Jumpman dots the orange tag stitched onto the tonal nylon tongue.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Oakland"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Oakland” features a color scheme that calls to mind the Oakland Athletics baseball team. In no way a collaborative effort between the major league baseball team and Jordan Brand, the color scheme of this design nonetheless mirrors that of the Athletics’ team uniform colors. The upper features white leather detailing on the perforated toe, mid-panel, and collar overlay. Contrasting black nylon paneling can be found on the forefoot, eyelets, and Swoosh branding on either side. A black nylon tongue with Laser Orange exposed stitching on the top and Jumpman insignia on the tongue tag add to the unique appearance of this Jordan 1 Mid. Green suede is located around the collar

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Yellow Toe"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Yellow Toe” is a fresh look for the classic mid-top edition of the Jordan 1. The design follows the popular color block blueprint of models like the “Bred Toe” Jordan 1 High, but with vibrant yellow accents to go along with the black and white base. The construction features a blend of leather and synthetic nubuck across the upper with the standard Jordan 1 sole unit below. The design is completed with a Jumpman logo tongue tag. The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Yellow Toe” released in spring 2019.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Satin Grey"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Satin” is a premium colorway of one of Michael Jordan’s most iconic shoes. Reminiscent of the Aleali May x Air Jordan 1 High of 2017, the “Satin” Air Jordan 1 Mid features a grey satin finish to the perforated toe and ankle collar. A white leather base on the mid-panel contrasts the black nubuck overlays on the forefoot and heel. An embroidered Smoke Grey Swoosh is included for a premium touch, while a white Wings logo covers the collar. Completing the neutral-based design is a white nylon tongue, white script Jumpman branding printed on the insole, and a white rubber midsole. Release date: December 2019.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Game Royal Black Toe"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Game Royal Black Toe” combines two of the most recognizable colorways of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in the popular mid-top silhouette. The “Bred Toe” Jordan 1, which was an original colorway of the shoe from 1985, inspires the color block of the white perforated leather toe and black leather overlays on the forefoot. Branding appears in the form of a black leather Swoosh on the mid-panel and Game Royal “Wings” detailing on the white leather collar. Grey suede is located on the collar and royal blue suede dots the heel. A black nylon tongue with blue “Nike Air” branding on the black leather tongue tab completes the look of yet another stately Jordan 1 Mid. Rel

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Olympic - USA"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid “USA” is a special colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in mid-top form dedicated to Independence Day. The festive design features a color scheme of red, white, and blue for a decidedly patriotic look. Smooth white leather appears on the perforated toe, mid-panel, and heel. Contrasting navy blue nubuck overlays can be found on the forefoot, toe cap, eyelets, and collar. The hue reappears on the Swoosh detailing on the mid-panel. A white “Wings” logo dots the collar and red Jumpman branding covers the navy nylon tongue tag. Below, a white rubber midsole and contrasting red outsole finish off the “USA” Jordan 1 Mid.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Maison Chateau Rouge Fearless"
products.description: The Maison Chateau Rouge x Air Jordan 1 Mid “Fearless” is the Paris-based brand’s vision of the mid-top version of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe. Maison Chateau Rouge is known for their African-inspired apparel for men and women and the collective applies its trademark designs liberally to the upper of the silhouette, via textured leather paneling. A tan leather base can be found on the mid-panel, perforated toe, and ankle collar, while dark brown textured leather covers the forefoot panel and Swoosh. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Court Purple Suede"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid SE “Court Purple Suede” is yet another desirable colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe that mixes colors and materials in a unique way. The Jordan 1 Mid has become something of a blank canvas for Jordan Brand ever since the brand positioned the model as an inclusive, more widely accessible alternative to the model’s more historic high-top relative. Here, the “Court Purple Suede” continues the sentiment of experimentation by pairing hairy black suede panels and Swoosh branding with a white leather base on the upper. A purple “Wings” logo appears on the collar and purple Jumpman graphic dots the branding patch on the top of the black nylon tongue. A plush Court

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Lakers"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Lakers” is a special edition of the mid-top Jordan 1 inspired by the Los Angeles Lakers. The Jordan 1 Mid is outfitted in the team colors of the team Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls defeated in the 1991 NBA Finals. The Air Jordan 1 features a white leather base with University Gold full-grain leather overlays and a black Swoosh and inner lining. Purple laces are added to complete the Lakers look. The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Lakers” released in early 2019.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Black History Month"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Black History Month 2019” is a special edition of the mid-top Air Jordan 1 celebrating African American heritage. The impressive look features a Sail leather base with black suede overlays and a graphic print on the Swoosh that is inspired by traditional African textile prints. The heel features an “EQUALITY” graphic promoting an equal and inclusive world for all athletes. The design is finished with Carmelo Anthony’s logo on the tongue patch. The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Black History Month 2019” released in February 2019.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Mid SE "Black Gold Patent Leather"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Black/Gold Patent Leather” is a premium edition of the classic model featuring a striking patent leather upper in black, white, and metallic gold. The mid-top Jordan 1 receives this refined look in the always-stylish color combination that is reminiscent of the Air Jordan 1 High “Gold Top 3,” but with the color blocking remixed for a fresh new appearance and feel. The Air Jordan 1 Mid “Black/Gold Patent Leather” released in early 2019.

As classic a look as any for the popular Jordan 1 Mid model, the “Dune Red” features a white leather upper with Dune Red Swoosh branding on either side, and Dune Red “Wings” detailing on the collar. The deep red hue also appears on the collar underlay, as well as on the Jumpman and “Air” branding on the Sail-colored tongue tag. Underfoot, a Sail rubber midsole and a red rubber outsole complete the design. Release date: January 20, 2024

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "J Balvin - Amazonas"
products.description: Illuminate your sneaker rotation with the vibrant Air Jordan 4 Retro "J Balvin Amazonas". Created in collaboration with the global Latin music icon, this standout shoe features a soft lemonade tonal upper crafted from rich nubuck and suede textures. Molded quarter panel netting, signature lace wings, and heel to toe Air cushioning bring classic AJ4 DNA into a playful new light. Perfect for summer, this eye catching pair delivers effortless flair and energetic style to any streetwear fit.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Fear Pack"
products.description: From the Air Jordan Retro “Fear Pack” of 2013, this neutral-colored Air Jordan 4 in shades of grey and black nubuck has since become one of the most popular non-OG colorways of the silhouette ever.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Comic"
products.description: Channel vintage graphic art with the Air Jordan 4 Retro "Comic." Inspired by an iconic 1985 Nike T-shirt, this pair features a premium off-white leather upper contrasted by a striking pink, yellow, and lavender gradient across the mesh netting. Playful Ben-Day dot patterns and a graffiti-style "Nike Air" heel logo capture classic comic vibes, while hot pink starburst eyelets add a bold pop. Complete with classic visible Air cushioning, it perfectly fuses hardwood heritage with animated streetwear expression.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Military Blue (2006)"
products.description: The most unique original colorway of the Air Jordan 4 because it’s the only one not to come in a Chicago Bulls color scheme, the “Military Blue” version features a white upper with blue and grey accents.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "White Cement"
products.description: Forever one of the most popular Air Jordans ever, the “White/Cement” Air Jordan 4 is a very welcome sight any time it’s brought back. This 2012 edition was no different, selling out instantly at retail to become one of the most coveted sneaker releases of the year.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Mars Blackmon"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 received with remake of the original ”Fire Red” colorway in 2006 with a twist: a graphic on each heel depicting Spike Lee’s Mars Blackmon.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Cavs"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro gets a colorway inspired by the victims of “The Shot”, Michael Jordan’s famous game-winning jump shot against the Cleveland Cavs in the 1989 playoffs. With a black nubuck base, the accents come in Cleveland’s team colors at the time of royal blue and orange.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Metallic Pack - Pine Green"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Metallic Pack - Green” is one of several colorways that salute Jordan Brand’s storied history. The “Metallic Pack” of Air Jordan 4s from 2020 honor the Air Jordan 1 “Metallic” colorways, which were original makeups of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe from 1985. Like the other designs in the Jordan 4 “Metallic Pack,” this “Green” variant features an appealing two-toned look with a white leather upper and tonal netting on the mid-panel and tongue. Contrasting metallic Pine Green hits on the lace eyelets and Jumpman insignia on the heel pop against the crisp white base. Green Jumpman branding can be found on the nylon tongue tab and inner lining of the tongue. Staying tru

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Black Cat 2025"
products.description: Unleash a stealthy legend with the Air Jordan 4 "Black Cat". This highly anticipated sneaker features a rich, all-black nubuck upper with subtle tonal details. Enjoy superior Air cushioning and a versatile look, perfect for making a powerful, monochromatic statement with a sophisticated edge.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Tattoo (2018)"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Tattoo” is a special edition of the silhouette released on China’s Singles Day holiday in 2018. The “Tattoo” Jordan 4 gets its nickname from the tattoo-style basketball artwork covering the white leather upper. Accents come in a traditional Chicago Bulls color palette of black and red, which are reminiscent of the original “Fire Red” colorway of the Air Jordan 4. The limited edition Air Jordan 4 “Tattoo” released on Singles Day, November 11, in China, followed by a global launch in December 2018.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Royalty"
products.description: You know that you’re in for something special when Nike uses the word Royalty, and these are no exception; Crisp matte black suede is layered on top of one another, and carefully propped on top of that iconic curvy white sole. Playing into that sophisticated feel, there are metallic gold accents on the laces and heel logo.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Teal"
products.description: One of the first "Remastered" Air Jordan retro releases, this all-new colorway of the famous Air Jordan 4 from 2015 features a dark teal leather upper with black accents and highlights in bright teal. A release for Jordan Brand's 30th anniversary, the shoes come with special "30" Jumpman logos on each insole.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Alternate"
products.description: Imagining a colorway that wasn’t released in 1989 but could have been, the “Alternate” Air Jordan 4 creates a Bulls-friendly color scheme in white with red accents.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Military Black"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Military Black” is a neutral colorway of the retro basketball shoe designed in the same color block as the model’s popular, original “Military Blue” style from 1989. The Jordan 4 “Black Military” is undoubtedly inspired by the Jordan 4 “Military” from 1989 as it features the same color design as the throwback colorway, just with black accents instead of blue. The shoe’s upper is constructed with a white leather base with grey suede on the forefoot overlay. The TPU eyelets and heel counter are accented in black. As are the underlays beneath the netting on the sides and on the tongue. Classic Jumpman logo detailing can be found on the heel and on the tongue tag. Release date:

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Thunder 2023"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Thunder 2023” is the modern re-release of the popular, non-original colorway of the retro basketball shoe that debuted in 2006’s “Thunder & Lightning” collection. Released alongside the Jordan 4 “Lightning” in super limited quantities on Jordan Brand’s former Jumpman23.com website in the mid-aughts, the “Thunder” was brought back in 2012 before it received another highly anticipated release in 2023. As for its design, the black-and-yellow shoe features a black synthetic nubuck base with Tour Yellow detailing beneath the mesh on the sides and tongue. Yellow “wings” lace holders contrast the black upper. A white Jumpman appears on the heel and on the tongue. A visible Air uni

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Zen Master"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Zen Master” is a Spring 2021 release of Michael Jordan’s fourth signature shoe in a colorway that honors Jordan’s head coach with the Chicago Bulls, Phil Jackson. Inspired by Jackson’s “Zen Master” nickname, thus Jordan 4 is complete with design elements inspired by Jackson and his unique coaching philosophy, which included elements of various spiritual traditions. The shoe’s upper features a celestial, starry appearance with details such as “Zen Master” printed on the underside of the tongue. Translucent eyelets and black netting on the sides and tongue contrasts the look. A translucent heel tab with black Jumpman branding gives the shoe a contemporary appearance. Addition

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Infrared"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Infrared” is a February 2021 release of the vintage basketball shoe in a colorway loosely inspired by the Chicago Bulls, Michael Jordan’s former basketball team. The “Infrared” Jordan 4 also mimics the color block of the model’s “Green Glow” colorway from 2013, trading the latter’s green accents for Infrared. The shoe features a synthetic nubuck upper in light and dark grey. Black accenting can be found on the netting found on the tongue and mid-panel, on the “wings,” and inner lining. Lighter shades of grey appear on the toe and outsole. A light grey Jumpman is located on the black heel counter and an Infrared Jumpman is printed on the black nylon tongue tag on the tongue.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Red Thunder"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Red Thunder” is an October 2021 release of Michael Jordan’s fourth signature shoe that draws comparisons to a popular look in the Air Jordan 4’s line. The shoe we’re referring to is the Jordan 4’s “Thunder” colorway from 2006’s “Thunder & Lightning” pack that was released in limited quantities exclusively on Jumpman23.com, Jordan Brand’s former website. On the “Red Thunder,” the look mimics the original Thunder by substituting the latter’s yellow accents for red. The upper features a black synthetic nubuck base with red detailing beneath the mesh on the sides and tongue. Red “wings” lace holders contrast the neutral-colored upper. A white Jumpman appears on the heel. The lo

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "White Oreo"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “White Oreo” is a Summer 2021 release by Jordan Brand that combines two popular colorways of Michael Jordan’s fourth signature shoe into one design. The styles we’re referring to are the Jordan 4 “Oreo” and “White/Cement,” which are fused together to create the predominantly monochromatic white design of the “White Oreo.” Like the “White/Cement,” the “White Oreo” shares a white tumbled leather construction with cement grey speckling on the eyelets and on the painted midsole. White netting can be found on both the mid-panel and tongue. Jordan Brand paints the model’s signature “wings” white and adds a Fire Red embroidered Jumpman to the white leather tongue. A metallic silver

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Fire Red 2020"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Fire Red 2020” is a November 2020 release of an original colorway of Michael Jordan’s fourth signature shoe. This reissue of the “Fire Red” marks the first time the design has featured the iconic “Nike Air” branding on the heel since the original release way back in 1989. The rest of the shoe is also as close to the original as possible, which includes a return to the “OG” shape and color scheme. The upper features smooth white leather on the toe, collar, and heel. White netting can be found on both the throat and mid-panel. The eyelets, liner, and outsole are done up in Fire Red as a salute to the original look. Branding appears in the form of a red Jumpman on the tongue t

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Lightning 2021"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Lightning 2021” is a modern re-issue of the desirable colorway of Michael Jordan’s fourth signature shoe that was originally released in August 2006. Without question one of the most sought-after non-original Air Jordan shoes ever, the first “Lightning” was released in hyper-limited quantities exclusively on Jumpman23.com (the former Jordan Brand website) alongside a "reverse" black and yellow “Thunder” Jordan 4, together creating the “Thunder & Lightning” pack. The “Lightning” was accompanied by an Air Jordan “Flight” T-shirt and the “Thunder” was paired with a varsity jacket. In 2012, Jordan Brand brought back the “Thunder,” but curiously decided against releasing the “Li

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Metallic Pack - University Red"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Metallic Pack - Red” is another clean colorway with roots in Jordan Brand’s storied history. Part of the “Metallic Pack” of Air Jordan 4s that were released in 2020, the “University Red” edition honors the Air Jordan 1 “Metallic Red,” an original makeup of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe from 1985. The two-toned appearance is pulled off by a white leather upper with tonal netting on the mid-panel and throat. Contrasting metallic University Red on the lace eyelets and Jumpman insignia on the heel provide a burst of color against the crisp white base. Red Jumpman detailing dots the nylon tongue tab and inner lining of the tongue. A small visible Air window in the heel c

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Metallic Pack - Purple"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 "Metallic Pack - Purple" one of four special edition colorways of the iconic model released for summer 2020. Inspired by the original “Metallic” colorways of the Air Jordan 1, the white and metallic-colored scheme is translated to four editions of the Air Jordan 4, including red, orange, green, and purple. Each colorway was released in specific regions of the world, with the US receiving this purple version. The construction features a full-grain leather upper with a metallic purple finish on the TPU lace eyelets and heel Jumpman logo. A matching purple hue is found on the inner lining, tongue logo, and visible Air unit. The “Metallic Purple” Air Jordan 4 released on May 20,

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Raptors/Drake OVO"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Raptors” with Drake’s signature is a special limited edition re-release of the colorway featuring the rapper’s signature on the tongue patch. Initially released in August 2018, the “Raptors” colorway of the Jordan 4 in black nubuck with red and purple accents returned in June of 2019 as a special release in light of the Toronto Raptors playing in the NBA Finals. The re-release includes the signature of Drake, the team’s most famous cheerleader, on each tongue tag. The Air Jordan 4 “Raptors” with Drake’s signature released on June 2, 2019 in a surprise launch on Nike SNKRS and sold out quickly. Now it is a rare and coveted sneaker for Air Jordan, Drake, and Toronto Raptors f

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Cool Grey"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Cool Grey” is the 2019 retro of the classic colorway. Originally released in 2004 as one of the first non-original colorways of the iconic Air Jordan 4, the “Cool Grey” edition became a rare and coveted sneaker throughout the years. Jordan collectors welcomed it back in 2019 with open arms. This 2019 version features the exact same look as the original release, constructed with a grey nubuck upper with black accents and a white midsole. Hits of yellow are found on the “Flight” logo on the tongue, the “Air Jordan” patch on the inside of the tongue, the visible Air unit, and outsole accents. Chrome Jumpman logos on each heel complete the classic look. The Air Jordan 4 “Cool G

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "University Blue"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “UNC” is an April 2021 colorway of Michael Jordan’s fourth signature shoe that honors Michael’s alma mater, the University of North Carolina. The first-ever Jordan 4 in a “UNC” makeup, this collegiate design follows previous Air Jordans to employ the popular theme—the Air Jordan 3 “UNC” and the Women’s Air Jordan 1 Mid “UNC” from 2020. Jordan Brand adds several athletic inspired touches to the look, including adding a “removable” name tag to the nylon Jumpman branding on the suede tongue in reference to the product tag on the bottom of basketball jerseys. The upper is constructed from supple University Blue suede, save for the tongue and mid-panel which feature tonal mesh de

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Taupe Haze"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Taupe Haze” is a lifestyle colorway of Michael Jordan’s fourth signature shoe that was released by Jordan Brand in January 2021. The “Taupe Haze” is highlighted by its neutral based, earth tone color palette. Black plastic “Wings” eyestay holders match the tonal shoelaces and mesh detailing on the tongue and mid-panel. Jordan Brand places a taupe Jumpman logo on the back of the shoe and a blazing red Jumpman on the branding tag stitched onto the tongue. The same bright shade of red appears on the underside of the tongue and on the Jumpman-branded insole. A visible Air unit can be found in the heel of the Air Jordan 4 “Taupe Haze” to finish off the look. Release date: Februa

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Bred 2019"
products.description: This Air Jordan 4 “Bred” is the 2019 retro of the iconic colorway of Michael Jordan’s fourth signature shoe. The famous black and red version of the Jordan 4 returned in the spring of 2019 with its original “Nike Air” branding on the heel for the first time since its first retro release in 1999. Now 20 years after that first retro and 30 years after its initial 1989 release, the “Bred” Air Jordan 4 looks just as outstanding as ever. This true-to-OG retro features a black Durabuck (synthetic nubuck) upper with grey, red, and white accents throughout. In addition to the large Nike Air logo on the heel tab, the original Nike branding is also present on the outsole and sockliner. The Air Jordan

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Kaws"
products.description: Famed artist KAWS has been rather reclusive since discontinuing his streetwear brand OriginalFake, only showing face for the occasional high art project or worthwhile collaboration. Jordan Brand commission him for the latter; his canvas: the Air Jordan 4. The result, magnificent. The KAWS x Air Jordan 4 features a buttery premium suede upper in smooth and heathered textures, all drenched in a tonal grey colorway. KAWS hand graphics are etched into the upper as well, along with the matching hang tag. The midsole and upper “Wings” are also wrapped in suede. Finally, a glow in the dark sole completes the look.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Travis Scott - Cactus Jack"
products.description: Following his popular Nike Air Force 1 collaboration with mix-and-match Swooshes, Travis Scott continued his reign as one of the sneaker world's hottest collaborators in 2018 with the Air Jordan 4 "Cactus Jack". The bright blue nubuck construction with black and red accents takes inspiration from the team colors of the now defunct Houston Oilers football team, a reference to the rapper's Texas roots. Speckled detailing and Scott's "Cactus Jack" logo on the left heel tab add more personal touches to the shoe.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Motorsports"
products.description: Jordan Brand wastes no time delivering heat in 2017, as the famed Air Jordan 4 "Motorsports" colorway returns. Save for the missing Mars Blackmon logo on the heel, the rest of the shoe is true to the original, with a vibrant white leather upper and Varsity Blue accents on the midsole, inner lining, and branding. Black also accents the midsole, heel, and mesh insert to complete the look.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "PSG - Paris Saint Germain"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 PSG “Paris Saint Germain” is a desirable collaboration between the European football club and Jordan Brand on Michael Jordan’s fourth signature shoe. Paris Saint Germain, or simply “PSG,” has received special colorways of classic Air Jordans since inking a sponsorship deal with Jordan Brand in 2018. The upper features smooth white leather on the mudguard, which spans from the heel to the toe. Tumbled white leather can be found around the eyelets, collar, and heel. Subtle light grey nubuck detailing is located on the toe. White netting is layered over a black synthetic material on the tongue and mid-panel. Bordeaux accenting comes into play on the plastic lace holders and mid

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Winterized Loyal Blue"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 Winter “Loyal Blue” receives a winter-ready makeover for the iconic silhouette. The premium iteration of the “Loyal Blue” Air Jordan 4 sports a colorway reminiscent of rapper Eminem’s “Encore” Jordan 4, as covetable a sneaker as any within the Air Jordan scope. Notable changes applied to the design include swapping out the traditional throat and mid-panel netting for a rubberized synthetic material. The tongue also utilizes the rubberized construction while the inner lining sports a fleece-like fabric for added warmth and comfort. A tonal heel plate with black Jumpman branding and black Wings on the lateral panel put the finishing touches on the Air Jordan 4 WNTR “Loyal Blue

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Metallic Pack - Orange"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Metallic Pack - Orange” is part of Jordan Brand’s 2020 collection of “Metallic” colorways inspired by an original design from the 1980s. One of several “Metallic Pack” Jordan 4s, this “Orange” design is reminiscent of the Air Jordan 1 of the same nickname from 1985, which was an original makeup of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe. The two-toned appearance features a white leather upper with tonal netting on the mid-panel and throat. Metallic Orange hits on the lace eyelets and Jumpman detailing on the heel provide a stark contrast to the neutral base. Additional orange Jumpman branding can be found on the nylon tongue tab. The hue also appears on the inner lining of th

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Black Cat 2020"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Black Cat 2020” marks only the second release of the highly versatile colorway inspired by one of Michael Jordan’s many nicknames. The first version of the model was released back in Spring 2006 and is lauded by sneaker collectors and fans as one of the greatest non-original colorways of the Air Jordan 4. The upper of the “Black Cat” Jordan 4 features a matte black nubuck finish. The netting found on the model’s mid-panel and throat follows suit in with a stealthy appearance of its own. Both the mudguard and tongue are black, while the heel features a blacked-out metallic Jumpman logo. The Jumpman and Flight logos on the tonal nylon tongue are done up in a light grey shade

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Dunk From Above"
products.description: Part of the “Dunk From Above” collection from Jordan Brand in 2016, this Air Jordan 4 features a unique colorway in navy blue leather with yellow and white accents, all finished with a gum rubber outsole.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Kaws - Black"
products.description: If you thought the original grey KAWS x Air Jordan 4 was hard to get, it was nothing compared to this second colorway in black. The black KAWS Air Jordan 4 released in even more limited quantities, appearing first as a friends and family edition, then later releasing at retail only on the famous artist’s own webstore in November 2017 via a raffle system. If you took the L on the release like most of us, here’s your chance to finally score a pair of the elusive Air Jordan 4 by KAWS in black.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Alternate Motorsports"
products.description: A highlight of Jordan Brand’s spring/summer 2017 campaign looks quite familiar. The Air Jordan 4 Retro silhouette returns, this time in an “Alternate Motorsports” colorway. The versions sees the original White, Game Royal, and Black motif replaced by a mostly black shoe with Game Royal, Matte Silver, and White accents. Like the 2017 “Motorsports” retro, this release does not feature a Mars Blackmon logo on the heel. The upper is constructed with premium tumbled leather. Actor Mark Wahlberg gave the world an advanced look at this Jordan 4 during a meeting with Jordan Brand that was televised on his Wahlburgers reality show.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Pure Money"
products.description: Talk about pristine! Jordan Brand reintroduces fans to the Air Jordan 4 in the icy all-white “Pure Money” rendition. Originally released in 2005, and again in 2010 under the 25th anniversary moniker, this colorway further proves that simple is often better. Released just in time for spring/summer 2017, the AJ 4 sports a clean leather upper in white, with mesh netting and Air Jordan branding on the tongue to match. Metallic Silver appears on the lace eyelets, along with a bold Jumpman logo on the heel to complete the look. This listing is in adult sizes.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Thunder"
products.description: Originally released in 2006, the popular “Thunder” colorway of the Air Jordan 4 was back in 2012 for a refresh. Reversing its accompanying “Lightning” colorway, the shoe features a black upper with Tour Yellow accents.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Fire Red"
products.description: A celebrated original colorway, this “Fire Red” Air Jordan 4 from 2012 features the same look as the pairs Michael Jordan wore on court for much of 1988-89 NBA season.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Green Glow"
products.description: One of the more popular non-OG Air Jordan 4 colorways ever, in 2013 the iconic silhouette was given this “Green Glow” edition featuring a nubuck upper in two shades of grey with black and bright green accents.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 Retro "Toro Bravo"
products.description: Flipping around the original Chicago Bulls color schemes of the Air Jordan 4, this 2013 release features a predominantly red upper with with black, white, and grey accents. Thanks to it OG color palette, the “Toro Bravo” Air Jordan 4 has become one of the most popular non-OG colorways of the shoe ever, now sought out by many that originally slept on it.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) Friends & Family"
products.description: White and black leather Air Jordan 5 Retro sneakers from jordan featuring a round toe, a lace-up front fastening, an oversize tongue, a flat sole, a jumpman logo at the tongue, a stitched number 75 on each heel and transparent mesh side panels. These styles are supplied by a premium sneaker marketplace. Stocking only the most sought-after footwear, they source and curate some of the most hard to find sneakers from around the world.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Bel Air"
products.description: This vibrant Air Jordan 5 colorway was inspired by the classic ‘90s TV show the Fresh Prince of Bel-Air starring Will Smith who famously rocked the Air Jordan 5 in early episodes. The ‘90s vibe is obvious, with the multi-colored neon accents and wild print on the inner lining.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Hornets"
products.description: A 2015 release of the iconic Air Jordan 5, this Midnight Navy and Turquoise colorway of the shoe garnered the nickname “Hornets” due to its similar color scheme to Michael Jordan’s Charlotte Hornets franchise. Despite the all-new colorway, one signature element to the Air Jordan 5 remains: a reflective silver tongue.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Metallic Silver"
products.description: One of the first two non-original retro colorways of the Air Jordan 5 that first released in 2000, the "Metallic Silver" version was back in 2015. The pristine colorway features a white tumbled leather upper with silver accents throughout, easily making for one of the cleanest Air Jordan 5s ever.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Friends & Family Quai 54"
products.description: Own a piece of Parisian streetball history with the Air Jordan 5 Retro "Quai 54" Friends & Family. Originally reserved for tournament VIPs and top-tier athletes, this ultra-rare edition stands in stark contrast to the general release with its luxurious black nubuck upper. The design is electrified by radiant green accents on the lace locks and the iconic "Quai 54" embroidery on the heel, celebrating the world’s most prestigious streetball tournament. With its translucent outsole and silver reflective tongue, it’s a high-heat grail that captures the raw energy of the French capital's basketball culture.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "F&F Fresh Prince of Bel-Air"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Fresh Prince - Friends & Family” is an incredibly rare edition of the classic silhouette made only for Will Smith’s inner circle. Produced in conjunction with the laceless retail version to honor Smith’s 50th birthday, this version of the Jordan 5 features a more traditional construction with laces, but outfits the upper in shiny metallic gold satin. Other than the gold satin replacing the white leather, the rest of the “Grape” colorway is intact, except for a slight tweak of the red Jumpman logos on each heel. With only 25 pairs of the Air Jordan 5 “Fresh Prince - Friends & Family” rumored to exist, this is a true grail for Air Jordan collectors and fans of the iconic TV s

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Fire Red"
products.description: One of Michael Jordan’s classic on-court colorways from 1990, this is the “black tongue” Fire Red Air Jordan 5 Retro. This is the 2013 edition of the iconic colorway.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Blue Suede"
products.description: The "Blue Suede" rendition of the Air Jordan 5 Retro is a highlight of Jordan Brand's Fall 2017 offerings. This pair arrives after its all-red counterpart, also constructed in premium suede. Both shoes feature “Flight Suit” themed colorways inspired by vintage Air Jordan warm-up suits. Classic Air Jordan 5 design cues, including a reflective silver tongue and clear outsole, give this vibrant lifestyle rendition a familiar look. Jumpman branding on the tongue and heel make the cypher complete.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Shanghai Shen"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Shanghai Shen” is a rare China-exclusive colorway of Michael Jordan’s iconic fifth signature shoe that was released in 2013. Unquestionably one of the most sought after non-original Air Jordan 5s ever, the “Shanghai Shen” is inspired by the color coordination of the “Black Laney” Jordan 5. Moreover, the “Shanghai” falls in line with other rare overseas exclusive Jordan 5s like the “Quai 54” and “Tokyo23.” As mentioned, the style borrows from the color block of the “Black Laney” as the upper of the “Shanghai” is composed of a black synthetic nubuck material. A yellow Shanghai medallion appears on the lateral side of the heel and a Varsity Royal embroidered Jumpman resides on

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Black Grape"
products.description: A new take on the original “Grape” colorway, this Air Jordan 5 from features the same purple and teal accents but reverses the upper from white to black. Released in 2013, it has since become one of the favorite non-OG colorways of the 5.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "CEMENT"
products.description: The cement motif is one of the most popular in the Air Jordan’s history, and it returns once again on a 2017 Air Jordan 5 release. This version of Michael Jordan’s fifth signature shoe features a Chicago Bulls-inspired colorway, anchored by a clean white leather upper. The cement speckling appears on the midsole with additional black detailing. The black 3M reflective tongue sports eye-catching red accents, as does the Jumpman on the heel. An icy blue outsole completes the shoe.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Camo"
products.description: For a second time, camo returns to the fighter jet-inspired Air Jordan 5. This version is directly inspired by themes of the military, with its tonal brownish-grey suede upper. It features a reflective camo print on the heel and tongue. The tonal look carries through the midsole, though vibrant red accents it as well. An identical red hue also appears on the inner lining and on the tongue. Needless to say that the folks at Jordan Brand got it right.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "DJ Khaled - Crimson Bliss"
products.description: The DJ Khaled x Air Jordan 5 “Crimson Bliss” is a special collaboration by the famous hip-hop producer on Michael Jordan’s fifth signature shoe. From DJ Khaled’s collection of pastel-colored Jordan 5s, the “Crimson Bliss” is inspired by Miami and warm weather, as the shoe’s pink appearance undoubtedly calls to mind both the Florida city and its climate. The shoe features a Crimson Bliss-colored leather construction with translucent netting on the tongue and mid-panel. Blue “West the Best” branding inspired by Khaled’s signature catchphrase is embroidered on the heel of the left shoe while the Jordan 5’s original “Nike Air” detailing is embroidered on the heel of the right shoe. The words “Ke

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "We The Best - Sail"
products.description: The DJ Khaled x Air Jordan 5 “We the Best - Sail” is one of several popular colorways included in the special collaboration by the famous hip-hop producer on Michael Jordan’s fifth signature shoe. DJ Khaled’s collection of pastel-colored Jordan 5s is inspired by Miami and warm weather, as the shoe’s colorful accents undoubtedly call to mind both the Florida city and its climate. The shoe is complete with a Sail-colored leather construction with translucent netting on the tongue and mid-panel. Yellow “We the Best” branding inspired by Khaled’s signature catchphrase is embroidered on the heel of the left shoe while the Jordan 5’s original “Nike Air” logo is embroidered on the heel of the right

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Green Bean 2022"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Green Bean 2022” brings back the 2006 colorway with a reflective finish that shines when exposed to light in the dark. This May 2022 release of the Jordan 5 “Green Bean” colorway is nearly identical to the original version of the sneaker. The shoe’s grey synthetic upper is treated with a reflective finish that is supposedly inspired by the original sketch of the Jordan 5 by Tinker Hatfield. According to rumors, Hatfield sought to design the Air Jordan 5 with a fully reflective upper, but ultimately scrapped the idea prior to the shoe’s production in 1990. As for the rest of the modern “Green Bean’s” design, bright neon green accents appear on the interior lining, on the sha

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Regal Pink"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Regal Pink” is a colorway of Michael Jordan’s fifth signature shoe that draws inspiration from springtime holiday with its use of pastel colors. This May 2022 release of the vintage basketball shoe by Jordan Brand is designed with a Regal Pink synthetic nubuck upper and translucent netting on the sides, eyelet panels, and lower tongue. The silver reflective tongue features a tonal embroidered Jumpman logo. products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Concord” is an August 2022 release of Michael Jordan’s fifth signature shoe in a colorway inspired by the beloved Air Jordan 11. The “Concord” theme was introduced on the Jordan 11 back in 1996, and is one of the most popular colorways in sneaker history. Here, on the Jordan 5, the “Concord” features the same color block as the model’s classic “Fire Red” colorway, albeit with purple accents instead of red detailing per the original version. The upper is constructed from white leather. Translucent mesh is found on the mid-panel and lower tongue. A purple or Concord-colored Jumpman is embroidered on the heel. products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Jade Horizon"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Jade Horizon” is a March 2022 release of Michael Jordan’s vintage basketball shoe in a colorway with unique, retro-inspired details. A versatile look for the popular, old school basketball and lifestyle shoe by Jordan Brand, the Jordan 5 in “Jade Horizon” has a Jade Horizon-colored leather construction. The eyelet panels, lace toggle, and outsole feature a vintage-inspired, oxidized appearance. A white Jumpman is embroidered on the silver reflective tongue that shines when exposed to light in the dark. Moreover, a white Jumpman is embroidered on the heel. products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Racer Blue"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Racer Blue” is a February 2022 release of Michael Jordan’s classic signature shoe in a colorway that is reminiscent of the original “Black Metallic” colorway. This “Racer Blue” edition replaces red accents with royal blue, and adds even more color by featuring a blue midsole, as well. The upper is constructed in black synthetic nubuck with translucent mesh panels on the sides and tongue. The silver reflective tongue has a Racer Blue embroidered Jumpman and a Racer Blue Jumpman is embroidered on the heel. products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Shattered Backboard"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Shattered Backboard” or “Orange Blaze” updates Michael Jordan’s fifth signature shoe in a colorway first seen on the Air Jordan 1 back in 2015. The “Shattered Backboard” theme is inspired by team uniforms worn by Jordan during an oversea exhibition game in Italy in 1985 when he famously shattered a glass backboard following a powerful dunk. The Jordan 5’s version of the “Shattered Backboard” makes use of the same white, black, and orange color scheme as every “Shattered Backboard” Air Jordan before it, albeit in a unique way. Sail leather appears on the upper while the collar, quarter panel, and lower tongue are constructed in a fine mesh material that appears on the Jordan

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Fire Red Silver Tongue 2020"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Fire Red - Silver Tongue” is a Spring 2020 release of the original colorway of Michael Jordan’s fifth signature shoe. This version brings back the classic “Nike Air” branding previously found on original 1990 releases of the model, that had since been replaced with a Jumpman logo on previous retros. Jordan Brand brings back many original styling elements of the shoe including a reflective silver tongue, black midsole with shark tooth detailing, and an icy translucent blue outsole. products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Raging Bull 2021"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Raging Bull 2021” is the first-ever standalone release of one of the most popular non-original Air Jordan colorways. The “Raging Bull” or “Toro,” as it's also referred to by sneaker collectors, was originally released in 2009 as part of a limited edition “Defining Moments Pack” that dressed Michael Jordan’s fifth signature shoe in two styles: An all-red suede look and a reflective black design. Packaged inside of a shoe box mimicking a wooden crate, the “Defining Moments” Air Jordan 5 bundle remains extremely desirable to this day. As for the design of the modern re-release, Jordan Brand dresses the upper in a fiery shade of supple Varsity Red suede. Clear netting can be fo

The unique colorway is inspired by Michael Jordan’s trophy room, which was an important part of the Jordan family house that Marcus grew up in. The Jordan 5 features an Ice Blue suede upper with red and Sail accents across the upper and midsole. Hits of metallic gold appear on the lace lock and on the “5” and “23” numerals embroidered on each heel.
