products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Anthracite"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Anthracite” is a recontextualized design of Michael Jordan’s fifth signature shoe that features reflective panels. This February 2021 release switches up the look of the all-time classic Jordan 5 silhouette by employing the reflective material typically found on the tongue to the clear netting on the bottom of the tongue and the mid-panel. Elsewhere, Jordan Brand places soft black mesh on the toe, mid-panel, and eyelets. Plush Anthracite or grey suede detailing is located on the collar, quarter panel, and toe cap. White contrast stitching outlines the aforementioned panels. The tonal embroidered “23” branding found on the heel is in reference to the original Player Exclusiv

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Stealth 2.0"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Stealth 2.0” is a modern reinterpretation of the popular non-original colorway of the model that was originally released in 2006. The first “Stealth” Jordan 5 debuted during a time period in which Jordan Brand was re-imagining its core classic Air Jordan models as “lifestyle” shoes by arranging them in materials and colors that could be worn off the court. The look of the "Stealth 2.0" is quite similar to the original "Stealth" design from 2006. Both feature a crisp white leather upper with translucent netting on the mid-panel and tongue. The “Stealth 2.0” displays a black embroidered Jumpman on the heel, differing from the blue Jumpman logo on the original '06 release. The

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "What The"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “What the” honors the 30-year anniversary of Michael Jordan’s fifth signature shoe with a medley of colors culled from some of the model’s most popular, non-original looks. Designs like the “Quai 54,” “Green Bean,” “Raging Bull,” and “Bel-Air” are just some of the colorways referenced. Breaking it down by shoe, the left shoe features the “Raging Bull’s” buttery all-red suede upper with “Quai 54” accenting on the shark tooth midsole and tongue. The right shoe displays an all-yellow nubuck build referencing the sought-after "Tokyo T23" colorway, with the “Army Green’s” silver and orange tongue, and the “Bel-Air’s” shark tooth detailing on the midsole. products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "International Flight"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “International Flight” is inspired by Michael Jordan’s status as basketball’s greatest global ambassador. Along with “International Flight” editions of the Air Jordan 3 and Air Jordan 12, this unique Jordan 5 was released in 2018. This specific colorway is inspired by an exhibition game Jordan played in against the Spanish national team in Barcelona, Spain in 1990. Jordan wore a pair of the original Air Jordan 5 “Fire Red” with a blue, orange, and white uniform. The Air Jordan 5 “International Flight” takes the uniform colors and translates them across the silhouette, featuring a white leather upper with black, orange, and blue accents. A graphic print is also added to the i

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Alternate Bel-Air"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Alternate Bel-Air” (also known as "Ghost Green") is reminiscent of the coveted “Bel-Air” colorway of Michael Jordan’s fifth signature shoe. Both the original “Bel-Air” and “Alternate Bel-Air” are inspired by the “Grape” Jordan 5 worn by Will Smith on the “Fresh Prince of Bel-Air” in the ‘90s. The “Alternate Bel-Air” flips the decidedly throwback color scheme for a fresh new take. White leather appears on the upper, including the toe, collar, and heel. Vibrant contrasting Ghost Green and red “23” and Jumpman embroidery can be found on the heel of the left and right shoes, respectively. Translucent netting dots the mid-panel and tongue. Red Jumpman branding appears on the bla

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Olympic Gold Medal"
products.description: Released in celebration of the summer Olympics of 2016, this Air Jordan 5 takes first place with the “Gold Tongue” colorway. The clean look features a white leather upper with a metallic gold tongue and black accents.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Premio Bin23"
products.description: Very limited and constructed with impeccable quality, this is the Air Jordan 5 from the BIN 23 series of premium Air Jordans. Similar to the original “Black/Metallic” colorway, the shoe features a soft black leather upper metallic silver accents and white laces.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Alternate Grape"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Alternate Grape” is an equally impressive variation of the beloved “Grape” Jordan 5 colorway popularized by Will Smith on the “Fresh Prince of Bel-Air.” The “Alternate Grape” displays an attention-grabbing all-Purple-everything suede upper, save for the contrasting black netting on the mid-panel and tongue. The translucent lace lock and turquoise lace toggle and embroidered turquoise Jumpman on the black leather tongue provide a true-to-original vibe to contemporary design. Black embroidered Jumpman detailing dots the heel and a clear Air window is surrounded by a black midsole. An icy blue translucent out wraps up the styling of this Air Jordan 5. Release date: July 7, 202

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Satin Bred"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Satin” is a premium makeover of the fifth Michael Jordan signature shoe that released during fall 2018. After using it on other Jordans, the Jordan Brand applied the satin construction to the Air Jordan 5 for the first time. The impressive rendition features shiny black satin covering the upper with a speckled red midsole for a twist on the classic Chicago Bulls color scheme. The construction of the Air Jordan 5 “Satin” includes two of the silhouette's most classic details: a reflective silver tongue and a clear rubber outsole. “Recognize” and “Greatness” are inscribed on the patches on the inside of each tongue.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "WINGS"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Wings” is a special edition of the legendary silhouette featuring a graphic upper inspired by illustrations done by students at Little Black Pearl, which is a nonprofit cultural arts center serving Chicago's youth. The special details of the attention-garnering Air Jordan 5 don’t stop at the all-over graphic print. The Jordan 5's signature details are also modified, with the lace toggle and mesh side panels altered into wing shapes. Both “winged” details also glow in the dark, while the model’s traditional reflective tongue adds the final bit of flash. The Air Jordan 5 “Wings” promotes Jordan Brand’s Wings program which helps youth around the world unlock their full potenti

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Pro Star"
products.description: Inspired by the early 1990s cartoon starring Michael Jordan alongside Bo Jackson and Wayne Gretzky as crime-fighting athletes, the “Pro Stars” Air Jordan 5 features a colorway inspired by the colors of the show’s logo and opening credits. The bold look combines a white leather upper with black, Infrared, and Poison Green accents. A first for the Air Jordan 5, the look also features a speckled tongue.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Red Suede"
products.description: Not to be confused with the “Raging Bulls” colorway, Jordan Brand ushered in summer 2017 with this Jordan 5 in “Red Suede.” As the name infers, the upper is dressed in a tonal red suede, including the coated mesh panels and lace tabs. The glaring difference between the “Raging Bulls” and this shoe is a matching red midsole, black shark teeth, and an icy outsole to match the reflective 3M tongue. The result is a slick sneaker that stays true to Michael Jordan’s lineage as a perennial player for the Chicago Bulls. And that’s without mentioning that these kicks are bound to turn heads.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Fear Pack"
products.description: From the Air Jordan retro Fear Pack of 2013 with similar colorways of the Air Jordan 3 and 4, this Air Jordan 5 features a Sequoia green suede upper with black, olive, and red accents. the Fear Pack is inspired by a quote from Michael Jordan: “I’m scared of what I won’t become, and you’re scared of what I could become.”

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Oreo"
products.description: One of the many great Air Jordan 5 colorways from 2013, this “Oreo” version features a black nubuck upper with white accents and speckled detailing on the midsole's “shark teeth.” The result is a simple and ultra-wearable yet bold look on the classic silhouette.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Laney"
products.description: Supplied by a premier sneaker marketplace dealing with unworn, already sold out, in demand rarities. Each product is rigorously inspected by experienced experts guaranteeing authenticity. Based off the team colors of Michael Jordan’s high school, this “Laney” Air Jordan 5 features a white leather upper with royal blue and yellow accents. First released in 2000 and then again in 2013, it has gone down as one of the all-time classic Air Jordan 5 colorways.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Grape (2013)"
products.description: The most recent release of the always-popular original “Grape” Air Jordan 5, this version from 2013 features everything you know and love about the shoe. The celebrated colorway may not come back again for a few years, so grab a pair now while you can.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Fire Red 2013"
products.description: Here we have the 2013 retro of the original Air Jordan V colorway featuring a white leather upper with Fire Red, black, and metallic silver accents. Worn on court by Michael Jordan during the 1989-90 NBA season, the colorway is forever a historic piece of the Air Jordan family.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 Retro "Sail"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 SE "Sail" is a neutral-based colorway of Michael Jordan’s iconic fifth signature shoe. True to its nickname, the Jordan 5 “Sail” features a Sail leather upper with Coconut Milk-colored netting on the tongue and mid-panel. A black Jumpman appears on the tongue and on the heel. Moreover, additional black detailing can be found on the speckled shark tooth design on the forefoot of the midsole. Underfoot, a Coconut Milk rubber outsole gives the shoe a classic, slightly aged aesthetic that ties into the Jordan 5’s old school vibe. Release date: April 13, 2024

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Black Cement"
products.description: One of the most important sneakers of all time and #1 in the hearts of many, the Air Jordan 3 in its original ‘Black/Cement’ colorway is a must-have in any sneaker collection. The shoe that started the legendary partnership of Air Jordan And Tinker Hatfield, the bold design originally released in 1988 and now sells out almost instantly any time it’s retroed. This listing is for the 2011 retro release.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Laser Palomino"
products.description: Elevate your rotation with the detailed artistry of the Air Jordan 3 Retro "Laser Palomino". This eye-catching release replaces traditional elephant print panels with laser-etched graphics covering the leather upper, paired with rich earth-toned palomino suede mudguards and heel overlays. Fire red branding pops on the tongue for classic heritage energy, while visible Air-Sole cushioning in the heel delivers reliable comfort. It is an intricate, head-turning blend of iconic street style and modern craftsmanship.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "True Blue (2026)"
products.description: Step back into sneaker greatness with the Air Jordan 3 Retro True Blue (2026). This highly anticipated release revives one of the original 1988 colorways, featuring a premium white tumbled leather upper and OG-style Nike Air branding on the heel. Iconic cement grey elephant print wraps the toe and heel in a refined, thinner pattern faithful to Tinker Hatfield's debut mold. Finished with striking True Blue accents and a Varsity Red Jumpman on the tongue, it’s a timeless masterpiece.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Fire Red 2013"
products.description: One of the four original Air Jordan 3 colorways, Michael Jordan wore this “Fire Red” version on court for much of 1988, making it a true icon of the Air Jordan line. this listing is for the shoe’s most recent re-release in 2013.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Pure Money"
products.description: This “Pure Money” colorway of the Air Jordan 3 from 2007 features the silhouette’s most pristine look ever in all-white leather with metallic silver accents.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "White/Cement"
products.description: A favorite of the original colorways from one of the most important and loved sneakers ever, the ‘White/Cement’ Air Jordan 3 is as classic as it gets. Worn by Michael Jordan oncourt throughout much of 1988, this colorway was also on his feet for his flight from the free throw line in the 1988 Slam Dunk Contest.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Crimson"
products.description: An all new colorway released in 2013, this Air Jordan 3 features a bold look in black leather with eye-popping Bright Crimson and Canyon Purple accents. A bit slept on when it originally dropped, the colorway is now sought out by many that missed out.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Grateful"
products.description: Major key alert! It’s all-red-everything on this incredibly exclusive Air Jordan 3 designed by DJ Khaled for himself and his closest friends. The DJ Khaled x Air Jordan 3 features a vibrant red leather upper with the elephant print toe and heel panels you know and love, completed with a modified heel tab proclaiming “WE THE BEST” along with the usual Jumpman. If you’re reading this, chances are you weren’t one of the lucky individuals blessed by Khaled with your own pair. Act like you were, and pick them up from Stadium Goods.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Wolf Grey"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro got dressed in Wolf Grey for this 2014 release of one of the most beloved Air Jordan silhouettes. The grey tumbled leather upper is complimented by metallic silver elephant print and black accents for a balance of neutral tones with a distinct flash.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Black Cat"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 gets blacked out for the “Black Cat” edition from 2007. The stealthy colorway features one special detail: subtle elephant print on the laces.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "DJ Khaled Father of Asahd"
products.description: The DJ Khaled x Air Jordan 3 “Father of Asahd” is a very rare friends and family edition of the Jordan 3 designed by and made exclusively for DJ Khaled. After first creating the red Jordan 3 “We the Best” in 2017, Khaled followed up his exclusive colorway with two more versions in 2018 in blue to celebrate the release of his album “Father of Asahd.” This version is named after the album, and features a blue suede construction with a reflective mudguard at the base of the upper and the classic elephant print paneling in grey. “We the Best” is found on the left heel tab opposite the traditional Jumpman logo on the right, while a silver rubber outsole completes the impressive look. The DJ Khale

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Fear Pack"
products.description: From the “Fear Pack” of 2013, this Air Jordan 3 features a dark grey and black leather upper with orange accents.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Court Purple"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Court Purple” is an unofficial nod to the Phoenix Suns as the colorway appears dressed in the team’s uniform colors. One of Jordan Brand Holiday 2020 releases, the “Court Purple” design of Michael Jordan’s third signature shoe features a black tumbled leather upper with purple leather accenting on the collar and on the plastic eyelets. The model’s classic elephant print detailing appears on the mudguard and toe cap. Elsewhere, orange borders the Court Purple embroidered Jumpman stitched onto the black leather tongue and a synthetic purple Jumpman dots the back of the shoe above the orange “AIR” branding. Release date: November 21, 2020.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Winterized - Archaeo Brown"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 Winterized “Archaeo Brown” is a rugged version of the retro basketball shoe made for the winter. The Jordan 3 Winterized, as its name suggests, updates Michael Jordan’s third signature shoe with details meant to withstand harsh weather conditions. In “Archaeo Brown,” the colorway features a neutral, earth tone appearance. A water-resistant brown nubuck material is found on the upper. Pink suede mudguard and purple ballistic mesh on the collar contrast the brown base. The Jordan 3’s original and beloved elephant print detailing is replaced with dark grey nubuck panels with white contrast stitching on the heel and toe. Classic Jumpman branding is found on the heel and tongue.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Wizards 2023"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Wizards” is the modern, retail version of the former Player Exclusive colorway of the Jordan 3 that was worn by Michael Jordan with the Washington Wizards. Originally an unreleased Player Exclusive sneaker worn by Jordan during his tenure with the Wizards in the early 2000s, the Jordan 3 “Wizards” was officially released by Jordan Brand in 2023 with much fanfare. The colorway’s white, blue, and elephant print accents nod to the Air Jordan 3 “True Blue’s” color scheme, and its gold accents salute to the Wizards’ former team uniform colors. products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Desert Elephant"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Desert Elephant” remixes an original colorway of the heralded basketball sneaker. An April 2022 release by Jordan Brand, the “Desert Elephant” nods to the Jordan 3’s original, iconic “Black Cement” colorway, as it features the same color block as the original version with a few modifications. The “Desert Elephant” is complete with a black tumbled leather upper, red lower eyelets, elephant print, and black laces, just like the “Black Cement.” However, the “Desert Cement” replaces all grey elements with sandy beige accenting that gives the shoe a decidedly retro flair. products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Fire Red 2022"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 OG “Fire Red” is the 2022 release of an original colorway of Michael Jordan’s third signature shoe. This modern reissue of the “Fire Red” marks the first time the shoe has featured its iconic “Nike Air” branding on the heel since the original release in 1988. The upper features a white leather base with contrasting grey elephant print on the toe cap and heel. Fire Red-colored leather appears on the collar. The blazing red hue is also found on the “Nike Air” detailing on the heel, on the top eyelet holes, and on the Jumpman that’s embroidered on the white leather tongue. products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Pine Green"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Pine Green” is a Fall 2021 release of Michael Jordan’s third signature shoe in a colorway that mimics the look of an Oregon Ducks Player Exclusive model. In no way affiliated with the Nike sponsored university, the “Pine Green” is nonetheless a worthy tribute to the many classic Oregon Duck Player Exclusive colorways as the shoe is arranged in the same black, grey, and green color block of several hard-to-come-by Oregon PEs. The upper features a black tumbled leather construction with grey elephant print on the toe and heel. Pine Green accenting comes into play on the painted mudguard on the sides and on the dotted leather collar, top eyelets, and Jumpman on the grey leathe

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Knicks"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 in the “Knicks” is inspired by one of Michael Jordan’s greatest on-court rivals, the New York Knicks. Long a nemesis and perennial thorn in the side of Jordan’s Chicago Bulls teams, the Knicks provided a constant challenge to the Bulls reign of dominance in the late ‘80s and ‘90s with their swarming defense and take-no-prisoners approach. With too-many-to-name regular season and playoff classics, one game in particular stands out as the source of inspiration behind this design; Jordan’s infamous “Virus Game” that took place during the 1987-1988 season. products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Racer Blue"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Racer Blue” is a July 2021 release of Michael Jordan’s third signature shoe in a highly wearable colorway. The “Racer Blue” joins popular Air Jordan 3s like the original “True Blue” colorway and non-original “UNC” and “Knicks” colorways in featuring blue on its design. Here, white tumbled leather forms the base of the upper. Grey elephant print can be found on the toe and heel. The variation of elephant print that appears on the “Racer Blue” is darker than the material found on many Jordan 3 releases. Elsewhere, Jordan Brand places dotted Racer Blue leather on the collar. The deep blue hue also graces the painted mid-panel as well as the Jumpman on the heel and embroidered

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Animal Instinct"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Animal Pack” turns Michael Jordan’s third signature basketball shoe into a lifestyle design with a wild animal print motif. Jordan Brand continues to expand into the lifestyle category and the Air Jordan 3 is the perfect silhouette to explore such eccentric themes as mismatched animal patterns. The base of the upper features a black faux-pony hair material that covers the mid-panel, toe, and parts of the mudguard and collar. Cheetah print appears on the toe cap and ankle collar with contrasting zebra print adorning the lateral panel and heel. Finishing touches include tiger patterning on the eyelets and a bold orange heel tab with black Jumpman detailing. Release date: Dece

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "International Flight"
products.description: In 2018 Jordan Brand presented the ""International Flight"" pack, featuring three retro models inspired by exhibition and charity games Michael Jordan played during his career. This Air Jordan 3 ""International Flight"" was a tribute to Magic Johnson's Midsummer Nights game in 1988, where Jordan stole the show with 54 points. He wore Air Jordan 3 ""Fire Red"" sneakers and a blue and white uniform during the game, and all of those colors are referenced in the sneaker.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Pure White"
products.description: Released in July 2018, Air Jordan 3 "Pure White" is a pristine iteration of the iconic silhouette. Similar to the all-white Air Jordan 3 "Pure Money" which came out in 2007, this "Pure White" version takes things in a frosty new direction with the addition of an icy blue translucent outsole and clear plastic lace eyelets. The accompanying Jordan hangtag also comes in a clear treatment, adding a finishing detail to the clean silhouette. The Air Jordan 3 “Pure White” certainly cooled down the sneaker rotations of Jordan collectors when it first released in the summer of 2018. But the timeless colorway will endure for years to come.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Blue Cement"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Blue Cement” is a desirable non-original colorway of Michael Jordan’s third signature shoe that was released in Fall 2020. Dressed in a color scheme reminiscent of the “Red Cement” Jordan 3 that debuted to much fanfare during the NBA’s All-Star Weekend in 2020, the “Varsity Royal” plays up on the silhouette’s throwback styling while remaining fresh in every aspect of its design. Appearing in the same color block of the “Black/Cement” colorway, the upper swaps black tumbled leather with Varsity Royal leather. The iconic elephant print panels are found on the toe and heel. White Jumpman detailing appears on the heel and an Air window in the heel of the midsole helps retain th

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Katrina / Hall Of Fame"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Katrina” may not be an original colorway of the legendary model from 1988, but it’s still one of the most celebrated. It was first produced in very limited quantities to raise money for Hurricane Katrina relief efforts in 2005. After becoming highly sought after in the following years, the Air Jordan 3 “Katrina” finally received a wider release in 2018, much to the delight of Air Jordan collectors everywhere. The unique Jordan 3 colorway features a white leather upper with Fire Red detailing. Cement Grey accents the signature elephant print paneling. The clean look is ready to become a regular member of your Air Jordan collection.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Cool Grey"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Cool Grey” is a lifestyle colorway of Michael Jordan’s third signature shoe that first released all the way back in 2007. The “Cool Grey” seen here was remastered by Jordan Brand as part of its Spring 2021 release cycle. It features several upgrades in design in comparison to the original version of the shoe, including a new premium grey leather construction on the upper and a slightly darker grey midsole. Elsewhere, dark grey leather appears around the eyelets and collar and classic elephant print detailing can be found on the toe and heel. A red Jumpman logo is embroidered on the grey leather tongue. Orange eyelet holes appear on the collar and base of the tongue. A Sport

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Mocha"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Mocha” marks the 2018 return of the beloved colorway. One of the first non-original lifestyle colorways of the iconic model to be released, the “Mocha” Jordan 3 first released in 2001 and returned 17 years later for the first time ever. The clean look features a white tumbled leather upper with Mocha brown accents on the signature elephant print paneling at the heel and toe, as well as the branding, top TPU lace eyelets, and outsole. Metallic silver lace eyelets near the toe finish off the premium look. The Air Jordan 3 “Mocha” released in December 2018 as one of the premier Jordan Brand releases for the holiday season.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "CYBER MONDAY 2016"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Cyber Monday” is a clean and simple look for Michael Jordan’s third signature shoe. The colorway features a solid black upper in full-grain leather with perforated detailing on the tongue and lace panels. The all-black upper is contrasted with a solid white sole unit. The usual elephant paneling at the toe and heel is omitted for an even cleaner appearance. The “Cyber Monday” nickname is a reference to the Air Jordan 1 High “Cyber Monday” in a similar color scheme that released one year earlier on the shopping holiday following Black Friday. Despite its nickname, the Air Jordan 3 “Cyber Monday” released on October 15, 2016.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Georgetown"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Georgetown” is a March 2021 release of Michael Jordan’s third signature shoe in a Georgetown Hoyas inspired colorway. Unofficially, the “Georgetown” honors the college basketball powerhouse by employing the team’s uniform colors in its design. The look references many of the Player Exclusive “Georgetown” colorways given to members of the Hoya family by Jordan Brand. Details include a Midnight Navy tumbled leather upper with contrasting dotted Cement Grey leather panels on the eyelets, collar, and tongue. Classic elephant print appears on the heel and toe as per the original styling of the Air Jordan 3. Additional design cues include a navy blue embroidered Jumpman on the gr

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Red Cement/Unite"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Red Cement” is a special edition of the iconic silhouette released during NBA All-Star Weekend 2020 in Chicago. Basically a red version of the classic "Black/Cement" colorway, the fiery “Red Cement” design looks like it could have been an original version of the Jordan 3 worn by "His Airness" on-court in 1988. This is achieved by retaining the same color block of the "Black/Cement" colorway, but replacing the black tumbled leather with Fire Red leather. The iconic elephant print panels are found in their usual places at the toe and heel, while original “Nike Air” branding graces the heel. Visible Air in the heel completes the look. Release date: February 15, 2020.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "UNC 2020"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “UNC” is a Carolina-blue-based colorway of the Jordan 3 design inspired by the University of North Carolina Tarheels. The “UNC” makeup of the Air Jordan 3 first arrived as a player exclusive during the 2018 NCAA Men’s March Madness Basketball Tournament and now re-appears as a separate release for the general public. Similar to the PE version, the retail Air Jordan 3 “UNC” features a white tumbled leather base that includes hits on the toe and mid-panel. Contrasting along the mudguard comes in the form of Air Jordan 3-specific elephant print on the toe, lateral panel, and heel that contrasts a solid white leather mudguard. Completing the look is black Jumpman branding on the

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Chlorophyll"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 "Chlorophyll" is a special edition of the third Air Jordan that pays tribute to another Nike sneaker that was also designed by Tinker Hatfield. The light grey, white, black, and green color scheme is a reference to the original Air Trainer 1, the cross-training model that ushered in a whole new category of footwear after it debuted in 1987 — one year before Hatfield’s Air Jordan 3 was released. The Air Jordan 3 "Chlorophyll" is part of a “Tinker Hatfield” pack of Air Jordan retros that released in 2018 featuring recognizable colorways of other landmark models designed by Hatfield in the late 1980s and early ‘90s.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "White Cement '88 (2013)"
products.description: In 2013 Jordan Brand finally opted to bring back the original “Nike Air” branding on the heel of the Air Jordan 3 with this special release of the iconic ‘White/Cement’ colorway. Air Jordan fans were delighted to get the 3 back in its true form, and all pairs disappeared immediately.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Joker"
products.description: Supplied by a premier sneaker marketplace dealing with unworn, already sold out, in demand rarities. Each product is rigorously inspected by experienced experts guaranteeing authenticity. Due to its similarities in colour to the famous foe of Batman, this Air Jordan 3 in black, green, and purple quickly picked up the “Joker” nickname. Featuring a pebbled leather texture, an ankle length, a brand embossed tongue, a lace-up front fastening, a round toe and a flat rubber sole.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Sport Blue"
products.description: Seeming to combine the original "Bred" and "True Blue" colorways of the Air Jordan 3, this 2014 "Sport Blue" release combines the best of both worlds. Featuring the same color block as the Breds, but with blue replacing the red accents. For an added special touch, the outsole comes in translucent blue.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Infrared 23"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro borrows the iconic Infrared hue from the Air Jordan 6 for this all new colorway released in 2014. With the neon red accents matched with the classic elephant print, the “Infrared 23” Air Jordan 3 made for one of the best recent colorways of the beloved silhouette.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Powder Blue"
products.description: Released in 2014, the Air Jordan 3 Retro "Powder Blue" calls back to Michael Jordan's days at North Carolina with its baby blue colorway, a first for the Air Jordan 3. The construction features a soft brushed leather upper with black accents and the signature elephant print.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 Retro "Green Glow"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 "Green Glow" is a colorway of Michael Jordan’s third signature shoe loosely inspired by the Jordan 3’s iconic “Black Cement” style, but with a twist. Like the Jordan 3 “Black Cement,” the “Green Glow” features a black leather upper and grey elephant print details, but with light green accenting instead of the red accenting found on the “Black Cement.” Specifically, Green Glow accenting appears on the eyelets, on the Jumpman branding on the tongue and heel, and on the “Jordan” logo on the outsole. A black painted mudguard appears on the heel above the white midsole. A small visible Air unit in the heel of the midsole gives the “Green Glow” a classic Jordan 3 look. Release dat

Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Comic"
products.description: Step out in vibrant court heritage with the Air Jordan 1 Low SE Comic. Reimagining the iconic 1985 silhouette, this special edition pairs a crisp summit white leather base with soft light arctic pink and sleek metallic silver overlays. Engineered for premium style and everyday comfort, it features genuine leather construction, a responsive foam midsole with an encapsulated Air-Sole unit, and a solid rubber outsole for classic traction.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Sail Deep Pewter Elephent Print"
products.description: Step into sneaker history with the Air Jordan 1 Low SE Elephant Print. Honoring the legacy of the 1985 original, this classic low-top pairs a premium leather upper in a clean sail palette with sleek deep pewter, gamma grey, and game royal accents. Complete with signature toebox perforations, an encapsulated Air-Sole unit for lightweight cushioning, and timeless brand detailing, these kicks deliver a fresh, everyday look that effortlessly anchors any streetwear rotation.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Black Sail Light British Tan"
products.description: Rediscover a classic with the Air Jordan 1 Low SE the "Black Sail Light British Tan." This special edition sneaker features a premium mix of materials, pairing rich "Light British Tan" leather overlays with unique pinstriped black textile side panels. The crisp "Sail" Swoosh and midsole provide a vintage inspired contrast, while the gum rubber outsole adds a timeless finish. With its sophisticated color palette and textured details, this pair offers a refined, elevated take on legendary hoops heritage.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Black Pastels"
products.description: Step into a beautifully soft, muted lifestyle aesthetic with the Air Jordan 1 Low SE Black Pastels. Reimagined with a premium mix of textures, this special edition silhouette pairs dark, vintage vibing Anthracite nubuck leather overlays with a soft Muslin canvas base on the toe box and mid panels. Injecting a subtle, elegant touch of color, the iconic side Swooshes and embroidered heel Wings logo are draped in a pale Iris Whisper purple. Tied together with soft Sail laces and matching interior lining, it sits atop a clean Sail midsole and a matching Anthracite rubber outsole, perfectly blending heritage court lines with a sophisticated, weathered palette.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Dodgers"
products.description: Keep your sneaker game strictly major league with the Air Jordan 1 Low SE in "Dodgers". Paying homage to LAs iconic baseball heritage, this special edition silhouette combines a crisp white leather base with bold "Old Royal" overlays along the Swoosh, heel, and collar lining. A pop of University Red hits the clean mini Swoosh embroidered on the lateral forefoot, adding the perfect touch of contrast. Grounded by a timeless gum yellow outsole for classic board and court traction, this low top essential effortlessly blends deep baseball roots with premium everyday streetwear appeal.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Black/Black/Racer Pink/Pale Ivory"
products.description: Step into an edgy, multi textured masterpiece with the Air Jordan 1 Low SE Black Racer Pink. Reimagining the classic 1985 low top silhouette with a premium, material focused aesthetic, this special edition colorway features a dark base built from a combination of smooth black leather panels and heavily textured charcoal black overlays. Making a sharp visual impact against the dark backdrop is a clean, pale ivory leather Swoosh sliding across the side panels, which matches the vintage toned midsole underfoot.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Multi-Color Sail Light Bone"
products.description: Embrace a handcrafted aesthetic with the Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Multi-Color Sail Light Bone." This 2025 Special Edition release breaks away from traditional color-blocking, featuring a "distressed" patchwork upper that blends neutral Sail and Light Bone leathers with vibrant, sunset-inspired denim overlays. The design is rich with artisanal details, including exposed stitching on the lace-stay panels and pre-frayed edges that echo high-end "reconstructed" streetwear. Finished with a clean gum-tinted outsole, it’s a sophisticated, multi-textured take on the 1985 classic.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Black"
products.description: Step into a legendary fusion of styles with the Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Black Elephant Print." This 2025 Special Edition release pays homage to the 1988 Air Jordan 3 by incorporating the iconic elephant-print texture directly into the black leather overlays. Built with a premium mix of smooth and textured leather, the shoe maintains its sleek low-profile silhouette while adding a layer of architectural depth. With a crisp white midsole and encapsulated Air-Sole cushioning, it delivers a versatile, street-ready look that honors two of the most important chapters in Jordan Brand history.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Flax"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Flax" delivers a clinical, high-status execution of the 1985 Peter Moore classic, masterfully blending "Workwear" heritage with a radical, autumnal technicality. This iteration features a premium landscape of long-hair hairy suede in a uniform "Flax" wheat tone, providing a rugged, multi-dimensional foundation for the model’s iconic anatomical profile. The design is defined by its explosive, monochromatic strike, utilizing specialized tonal embroidery for the Wings logo and a nylon tongue that injects a layer of high-octane luxury into the utilitarian build. Grounded by a "Sail" vintage-aged midsole and finished with a matching flax-colored outsole for elite, heritag

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Medium Olive Sail"
products.description: Infuse your daily rotation with the "Aged-to-Perfection" energy of the Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Medium Olive/Sail." This phenomenal sneaker offers a unique narrative, inspired by vintage Jordan graphics and military-inspired tones. The durable cupsole construction and solid rubber outsole ensure long-lasting traction, while the multi-textured upper—combining nubuck, suede, and smooth leather—provides a tactile, luxury feel. Whether you’re pairing them with cargos or denim, the "Medium Olive" delivers a fresh, sought-after look that stays true to the 1985 original while embracing a modern, outdoor-ready vibe.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Red/Black"
products.description: Lean into a "Bred" legacy with a premium twist in the Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Black/Varsity Red." This Special Edition (SE) release takes the most iconic colors in basketball history and elevates them with a refined mix of velvety nubuck and smooth full-grain leather. The deep black base is perfectly offset by vibrant Varsity Red on the toe box and heel, creating a high-contrast look that feels both archival and modern. Finished with a clean white midsole and a black-dipped Wings logo, it’s a sophisticated essential for those who want the "Chicago" energy in a low-profile, luxury build.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Light Smoke Grey"
products.description: Timeless monochrome style is always fresh with the Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Light Smoke Grey." This special edition sneaker revamps the iconic low-top silhouette with premium leather and textiles in a neutral palette of Light Smoke Grey, Black, and White. The classic look is grounded by reliable Nike Air cushioning in the heel for lightweight comfort and a durable rubber outsole for grip. This is your go-to pair for clean heritage style that goes with everything.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Brown Elephant"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Brown Elephant" is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe in low-top form with classic elephant print on its design. The “Brown Elephant” colorway of the always-popular Jordan 1 Low features a white leather base with tan suede overlays. The Swoosh on the sides has been designed in brown elephant print, a classic pattern that first appeared on the Air Jordan 3 way back in 1988. As for the rest of the shoe, a “Wings” logo is embroidered on the heel and a Jumpman is seen on the tongue. An aged midsole and brown rubber outsole complete the look. Release date: July 20, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Flight Club"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE “Flight Club” is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe with multi-color overlay panels. Yet another unique look for the always-popular Jordan 1 Low, the “Flight Club” features a white leather base with grey suede on the toe cap, forefoot, and eyelets. Faded pink suede can be found on the collar and faded orange suede appears on the heel. A black leather Swoosh logo is located on the sides. Classic “Wings” branding is embroidered on the heel. A pink Jumpman is embroidered on the black nylon tongue. Release date: May 9, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "SKY J MAUVE"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE “Sky J Mauve” is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe designed with a premium arrangement of materials. The shoe’s eye-catching design features Sky J Mauve leather on the perforated toe, and Sky J Mauve suede on the heel. The toe cap, forefoot, eyelets, and Swoosh are designed in black leather, while the collar appears in Sky J Orange. A black “Wings” logo is embroidered on the heel and a black Jumpman can be found on the tongue. Underfoot, a white midsole and Sky J Mauve outsole complete the look. Release date: November 13, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "New Emerald"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE “New Emerald” is a clean look for the popular lifestyle shoe meant for casual wear. The “New Emerald” features white leather on its perforated toe and mid-panel. Contrasting New Emerald suede overlays contrast the neutral-colored base. A silver leather Swoosh appears on either side of the shoe while yellow “Wings” branding is embroidered on the heel. Both the Jumpman and “Air” logos on the white leather tongue are also designed in yellow. A two-tone, white midsole and grey rubber outsole completes the look. Release date: July 14, 2022

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Tokyo 96"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE “Tokyo 96” is a colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe inspired by his inaugural trip to Japan as part of Nike’s Hoops Heroes Tour. The eye-catching colorway is complete with a Sail suede base with Dutch Blue leather overlays on the toe and forefoot. Contrasting Smoke Grey accents appear on the eyelets, on the textured leather Swoosh, and on the heel. A “Wings” logo is seen on the back of the shoe in Kumquat. The tongue features exposed foam padding with a Jumpman branded tag. Underfoot, the shoe’s aged midsole gives the design a vintage look. Release date: March 25, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Wear Away - Electric Green"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE “Wear Away - Electric Green” is a unique colorway of the retro basketball shoe that features wear-away overlays. The “Wear Away - Electric Green” has a white leather base that’s contrasted with black-painted leather overlays with a green shade partially exposed underneath. A black leather Swoosh is found on either side of the shoe and a black “Wings” logo is embroidered on the heel. An Electric Green Jumpman is embroidered on the black nylon tongue. Release date: September 29, 2022

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Light Curry"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE “Light Curry” is an earth tone colorway of Michael Jordan’s retro basketball shoe in the easy-wearing low-top silhouette. The “Light Curry” features Sail-colored canvas on the perforated toe and on the mid-panel. The overlay panels on the forefoot, eyelets, collar, and heel are designed in Light Curry suede. A Medium Olive canvas Swoosh is found on both sides of the shoe and a yellow “Wings” logo is stitched onto the heel. Jordan Brand places a Medium Olive-colored Jumpman logo on the Sail canvas tongue. Additional olive green accenting is found around the tongue and on the interior lining.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Wear Away Yellow"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE “Wear-Away - Yellow” is a unique colorway of the classic basketball shoe that features wear-away overlays. From a greater collection of “Wear Away” Jordan 1 Lows, the “Yellow” colorway has a white leather base that’s contrasted with bronze-tinted leather overlays with a wear-away yellow pattern on the toe cap, forefoot, and heel. A black leather Swoosh is found on either side of the shoe and a black “Wings” logo is embroidered on the heel. A classic Jumpman logo is embroidered on the black nylon tongue. Release date: October 7, 2022

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Easter Pastel"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Easter Pastel" paints the iconic sneaker with delicate hues in celebration of the spring holiday. Pastel shades of blue, pink, and two shades of purple take turns covering each of the many panels across the upper. The off-white midsole and light grey rubber outsole tread are made to be more understated than the rest. And finally, the laces, Swoosh, and Jumpman-branded tongue tab round off the scheme in light cream.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Arctic Punch"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE “Arctic Punch” is a Spring 2021 colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in its low-top silhouette. As fresh as any Easter inspired shoe on the market, the “Arctic Punch” is a vibrant design teeming with airy spring vibes as evidenced by its pink leather panels and Purple Pulse tumbled leather Swooshes on each side. A pink nylon tongue tag with purple Jumpman detailing and a purple liner further the model’s unofficial Easter theme. An embroidered “Wings” design on the back of the shoe is consistent with the styling of many Air Jordan 1 Lows.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "White / Grey / Red"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE “White/Grey/Red” is another clean and wearable look for the versatile silhouette. The “White/Grey/Red” variation is complete with white leather on the perforated toe and mid-panel and Light Smoke Grey suede on the overlays and heel. An eye-grabbing Gym Red-colored leather Swoosh appears on either side and a red “Wings” logo is embroidered on the heel. Additional Gym Red accenting can be found on the collar, on the underside of the tongue, and on the Jumpman detailing that appears on the white nylon tongue. A semi-translucent red lace dubrae contrasts the look of the white laces. Underfoot, a two-tone, white midsole and Light Smoke Grey rubber outsole completes the loo

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Barcelona"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Barcelona” is a colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in the low-top style that draws design inspiration from a sweater that Jordan wore during the ‘92 Summer Olympics in Barcelona. The “Barcelona” is dressed in a two-tone, white-and-Cyber Teal upper with white leather on the perforated toe and mid-panel. The overlays and Swoosh appear in glossy Cyber Teal-colored leather for a distinctive, ‘90s-esque look. White “Wings” branding is embroidered on the heel and a Cyber Teal Jumpman can be found on the white nylon tongue. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Spades"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE “Spades” is a unique colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe inspired by playing cards. Constructed on the always-in-style low-top Jordan 1, the “Spades” exudes a luxury influence with lavish red-and-black leather detailing inspired by the background of a playing card on the toe cap and mid-panel. Jordan Brand goes as far as to embroider a gold “K” and “Q” on the white leather forefoot overlay on the left and right shoe, respectively. The letters represent the king and queen cards found in a deck of cards. Moreover, a gold spade graphic resides on the red tongue tag on the white leather tongue. Metallic gold leather Swooshes on either side combine with a red

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Violet Shock"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE “Violet Shock” is a tropical take on the low-top edition of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe. Debuting as part of Jordan Brand’s Spring/Summer 2021 release cycle, the “Violet Shock’s” purple-and-teal color block is slightly reminiscent of Nike’s popular “South Beach” design that has appeared on too-many-to name styles over the years. Plush Violet Shock suede can be found on the forefoot, eyelets, collar, and heel. The aforementioned pink panels contrast the white leather mid-panel and perforated toe. Contrast teal-colored stitching borders the black leather Swoosh on both sides and a black “Wings” logo is embroidered on the heel. A Violet Shock Jumpman is printed

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Tropical Twist"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE “Tropical Twist” is a unique colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe that mimics the color block of a classic Nike SB Dunk release from 2005. The shoe we’re referring to is Diamond Supply Co. and Nike SB’s “Tiffany” Dunk, one of the most sought after sneakers in the world. Although not a direct one-to-one remake, the “Tropical Twist” undoubtedly draws favorably from the “Tiffany” Dunk by matching its black tumbled leather overlays with a mint green leather base. Unlike the “Tiffany,” a gradient orange-to-mint Swoosh appears on both sides of the “Tropical Twist.” Moreover, a tonal embroidered “Wings” logo is stitched onto the heel and a teal Jumpman is printe

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Racer Blue"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE “Racer Blue” is one of the more unique colorways of the low-top version of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe. The “Racer Blue” theme was used on the Air Jordan 9 of the same nickname from January 2020, though in a more subtle manner when compared to the bespoke-style, patchwork design of the shoe seen here. Racer Blue suede appears on the forefoot and heel. The deep royal blue hue can be found on the canvas tongue, as well. A dusty University Blue suede Swoosh and upper eyelet panel contrast the black suede mid-panel and toe cap. Embroidered “Wings” and Jumpman branding can be found on the heel and the tongue, respectively. A white canvas overlay with “23” embroid

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "USA"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE “USA” is a patriotic colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in the popular low-top style. Jordan Brand’s dedication to elevating the Jordan 1 Low into the upper echelons of sneaker culture has seen the brand use the model in collaborations with Dior and Travis Scott since 2019. Here, the “USA” adds to the impressive assortment of Jordan 1 Lows by featuring the red, white, and blue color scheme of the American flag. A Midnight Navy suede material appears on the forefoot, mid-panel, collar, and eyelets. The University Red leather Swoosh logo on either side of the shoe breaks up the look. White leather can be found on the perforated toe and on the heel. A red

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Nothing But Net"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low “Nothing But Net” riffs on the funky multicolor shirt worn by Michael Jordan during media appearances for the 1992 Summer Olympics and in a classic Super Bowl commercial from 1993. The pattern used on the shoe may look familiar to sneaker fans and collectors who remember it appearing on the Jordan 7 of the same nickname from 2015. Here, the upper of the Jordan 1 Low displays white perforated leather on the toe and smooth white leather on the mid-panel. The aforementioned geometric pattern dots the toe cap, forefoot, eyelets, and heel. A black Swoosh with contrast red outline stitching graces either side and a red embroidered Jumpman is placed on the white leather tongue.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Fuchsia"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Active Fuschia" brings a bold touch to the historic shoe with bright color and premium embellishments. Jordan builds upon the shoe's white leather base with black overlays around the forefoot, lace guards, and a Nike Swoosh on the side. Done in a lively shade of fuschia, micro-perforated suede paneling at the heel adds color to the rear. Meanwhile, fuschia is also seen on the laces, Jumpman logo on the tongue, inner lining, and rubber outsole. Recognizing the basketball legend for which the shoe was created, a "23" lace keeper is added.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Seafoam"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE "Seafoam" is a colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe with light green accents. From Jordan Brand’s Spring 2024 collection, the “Seafoam” Jordan 1 Low features a white leather base and Seafoam hairy suede overlays and Swoosh branding. A classic “Wings” logo is embroidered on the heel, and a Swoosh appears on the tongue. Jordan Brand finishes off the look with a Sail rubber midsole and a Seafoam rubber outsole. Release date: April 2024

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low SE "DUNE RED"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low SE “Dune Red” is a two-tone colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature sneaker in the low-top style. The Jordan 1 Low was first released in 1985, and is now a popular lifestyle shoe due to the appeal of colorways like the “Dune Red.” The upper features a white leather base and Dune Red leather overlays and Swoosh branding. A lighter shade of red is used on the embroidered “Wings” logo on the heel. Additional details include a Dune Red Jumpman on the tongue, a speckled Sail midsole, and a red outsole. Release date: January 20, 2024

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Champagne"
products.description: From the Air Jordan 6 “Champagne and Cigar” pack celebrating Michael Jordan’s first championship in 1991 when he wore the original version of the shoe, this is the Champagne colorway. The celebratory sneaker features a glossy champagne-bottle-green upper with black, gold, and clear accents. The championship ring lace locks complete the theme.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Awake NY - Playful Pink"
products.description: Make a bold, vibrant statement with the Air Jordan 6 Retro "Awake NY - Playful Pink". This striking NYC-inspired collaboration channels high-energy street style with a premium multi-tonal pink upper accented by bright orange detailing and paint-speckled midsole accents. Awake NY's signature script "A" logo comes debossed right onto the side quarter panel for an exclusive touch. Built with classic Air cushioning and translucent outsole pods, this pair delivers standout flair with all-day comfort.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Awake NY Midnight Navy"
products.description: Step into New York energy with the Air Jordan 6 Retro "Awake NY Midnight Navy". Celebrating the vibrant culture of NYC, this standout collaboration pairs premium leather and nubuck in varying shades of blue, punctuated by sharp Infrared 23 contrast stitching and heel branding. Awake NY's signature script "A" logo is subtly embossed onto the side quarter panel for an exclusive touch. Complete with translucent outsole pods and classic Air cushioning, this limited pair brings iconic streetwear heritage straight to your rotation.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Lakers"
products.description: Michael Jordan was wearing the Air Jordan VI when the Chicago Bulls beat Los Angeles in the 1991 NBA Finals. It features a spoiler-style heel and visible Air-Sole unit, plus a toggle lace lock. This colorway of the classic sneaker sports a sleek black upper and contrast stitching in Laker purple and yellow.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Black Cat"
products.description: Supplied by a premier sneaker marketplace dealing with unworn, already sold out, in demand rarities. Each product is rigorously inspected by experienced experts guaranteeing authenticity. The all-black Jordan 6 features a leather upper with both solid paneling and perforated panels for a unique look. Air Jordan's patented lace closures are back as well as the classic Jumpman logo on the sole.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Brazil Pack"
products.description: A special limited edition release in celebration of the 2014 World Cup in Brazil, this Air Jordan 6 Retro is presented in premium black leather and nubuck with accents in green and yellow to represent the national colors of the host country.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Golden Moments Pack"
products.description: Part of a two-shoe collection with the Air Jordan 7, the “Golden Moments” pack features each shoe in gold trim in honor of the USA basketball team taking home the gold medal back in 1992, when Michael Jordan wore the Air Jordan 7, and 2000, when Ray Allen and Vin Baker wore the “Olympic” Air Jordan 6. The 6 features a white leather upper with plenty of gold trim and an American flag graphic on the insole to drive home the patriotic theme.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Diffused Blue"
products.description: The Air Jordan 6 “Diffused Blue” is an all-new look for the iconic silhouette that debuted in the winter of 2018. The clean and premium colorway features a premium leather upper in Diffused Blue with Court Blue accents and the shoe’s traditional clear rubber outsole. The result was a refreshing new color palette for the Jordan 6. The Air Jordan 6 “Diffused Blue” was originally thought to be a player exclusive for Jimmy Butler who first wore the colorway in early 2018 while he was playing for the Minnesota Timberwolves, but fortunately it released later in the year for all Air Jordan collectors to enjoy.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Olympic"
products.description: First appearing at the 2000 Summer Olympics on the feet of Ray Allen and Vin Baker with a retail release at the same time, the ‘Olympic” Air Jordan 6 was finally back in 2012 for its much-awaited re-release. Now the patriotic red, white, and blue colorway is one of the most celebrated Air Jordan 6 colorways ever, and a staple on the feet of sneakerheads every 4th of July.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Chrome 2022"
products.description: The Air Jordan 6 “Chrome 2022" is the modern reissue of the popular non-original colorway of the retro basketball shoe in mid-top form. Originally released back in 2002 on the Jordan 6 Low, the “Chrome” was brought back on the model’s original mid-top silhouette in November 2022. The modern “Chrome” color block is identical to the original version from back in the day. Along with the “Nike Air” embroidery on the heel, the rest of the shoe retains the correct height and panel shapes as the inaugural release. One of the most beloved Air Jordan models and colorways of all time, the Air Jordan 6 “Black/Infrared” features a black nubuck upper with bright neon red accents and icy clear portions of the outsole. This 2019 retro brings back the original Nike Air branding embroidered on the heel (previous retros of the Jordan 6 had a Jumpman logo on the heel). products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "DMP 2020"

One of the most celebrated and coveted two-shoe sets ever from Jordan Brand, the Defining Moments Pack celebrated Michael Jordan’s first NBA Championship and contains an Air Jordan 6 and Air Jordan 11, both of which sport a premium redesign. The Air Jordan 6 features a stealthy black nubuck upper with a gold-accented Jumpman on the tongue and gold trim on the midsole that provides a touch of opulent styling. Whether you’re a Tarheel fan or not, you won’t want to miss out on a pair of this ultra-wearable colorway.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Maroon"
products.description: Long awaited, the last original colorway of the Air Jordan 6 never to retro finally did in 2015. The classic “Maroon” version was finally crossed off the list for collectors waiting over twenty years for its return. This special release also marked the first time original “Nike Air” branding was found on the heel of the Air Jordan 6 since the retros from the year 2000. These are a must-have for any fan of the iconic Air Jordan silhouette.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Tinker Hatfield"
products.description: The Air Jordan 6 “Tinker Hatfield” is a new release that replicates an original sketch of the shoe by the legendary Nike and Air Jordan designer. This Jordan 6 has a white and grey upper with dark blue and infrared accents. This was the color scheme that Hatfield originally dreamed up for the sixth Air Jordan model in one of his first preliminary sketches. The style was never actually produced during the shoe’s original run in 1991. All these years later, Tinker’s sketch is now a reality with this 2018 release. The Air Jordan 6 “Tinker Hatfield” is a fresh and new look that naturally also sports some throwback ‘90s vibes.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Slam Dunk"
products.description: A unique collaboration between Jordan Brand and Japanese manga artist Takehiko Inoue, creator of the Slam Dunk cartoon series, the Air Jordan 6 receives an all-red upper with imagery fans of the 31-volumed manga series will easily recognize.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Carmine"
products.description: One of the most popular original colorways of the Air Jordan 6, Michael Jordan made this bold color block in white and red famous on court in 1991. The legendary Air Jordan 6 returned in 2014 as one of the biggest Air Jordan retro releases of the year, and disappeared even faster than its last release in the Countdown Pack collection in 2008.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Infrared"
products.description: Perhaps the most beloved of all Air Jordan 6 colorways, the ‘Black/Infrared’ look is among the greatest Air Jordans of all time. Worn on court by Michael Jordan while attaining his first NBA championship in 1991, the black and Infrared Air Jordan 6 is one of the most historically important Air Jordan ever, as well. A must have for any sneaker collection.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Sport Blue"

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Infrared"

products.title: Air Jordan 6 Retro "Cigar"
products.description: From the Air Jordan 6 “Champagne and Cigar” pack celebrating Michael Jordan’s first championship in 1991 when he wore the original version of the shoe, this is the Cigar colorway. A laser-etched Jumpman logo at the heel replaces the standard hologram jewel, while the rope-style shoe laces are inspired by graduation honor cords. products.title: Air Jordan 13 Retro "2011 Playoffs"

A black outsole completes the shoe, along with the iconic Jumpman hologram logo on the heel. This colorway was worn by Michael Jordan for much of the 1997-98 NBA season, which was his last season with the Chicago Bulls. This is the 2017 retro release of the “Chicago” Jordan 13.

The construction features a black suede base with reflective-accented black mesh paneling across the upper. products.title: Air Jordan 13 Retro "Hyper Royal"
products.description: This "Hyper Royal" colorway of the Air Jordan 13 was released early in 2018. It wasn’t an entirely new edition, however. An Air Jordan 13 with a white leather and royal blue suede upper was originally created in the early 2000’s as a special player edition for former NBA player and Jordan Brand team member Quentin Richardson. That PE was a coveted rarity for years, and now more Air Jordan fans can have a chance to own their own version with the clean Air Jordan 13 “Hyper Royal.”

products.title: Air Jordan 13 Retro "Olive"

If you know Air Jordan history, you know the color scheme was originally found on the Air Jordan 9, as an OG colorway all the way back in 1994. Who knew it would also look so good on the Air Jordan 13 all these years later? Featuring a premium suede construction with touches of red for the branding and outsole detailing, no Air Jordan fan will want to miss the Jordan 13 Olive.

When the “Altitude” Air Jordan 13 first dropped in 2005, it was one of the first non-OG Air Jordan retro colorways to really cause a stir and become a must-have release for collectors. The black leather colorway with stingray texture detailing and bright green accents just couldn’t be denied. While Air Jordan fans welcomed the Altitude Air Jordan 13 back in 2010, some weren’t quite satisfied with the change of materials: reflective mesh replacing the full-grain leather paneling across the upper. In 2017 the Altitude 13s make their second return, this time reproduced in the original all-leather upper. Fly in and grab your pair today.

And finally, the signature black cat inspired green holographic jewel occupies its usual place on the ankle. The latest Air Jordan 13 "Bred" retro proves that few things compare to a time-tested pair of kicks.

However, eight years later, the house that Michael built decides to give the Air Jordan 13 Retro an official release. products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Taxi"
products.description: An original colorway of the Air Jordan 12 from 1997, the “Taxi” version in a predominantly white leather upper with the signature toe panel in black is perhaps the most iconic version of the twelfth Air Jordan.

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Wing It"
products.description: Limited to only 12,000 individually numbered pairs worldwide, this special edition Air Jordan 12 from 2016 features a black and white colorway (similar to the OG “Playoffs” colorway) with an added bonus: black paint on the quarter panes can be rubbed off to reveal a wings graphic.
