products.description: The Air Jordan 12 “Cherry” is an original colorway of Michael Jordan’s twelve signature design with Nike—and first official Jordan Brand model—from 1997. Worn throughout the 1996-97 NBA season while a member of the legendary Chicago Bulls, Jordan soared to new heights while wearing the premium model. The upper is constructed of white leather base with bold red pebbled leather contrasting along the toe, forefoot and mudguard. Silver top eyelets along with embroidered black Jumpman detailing on the tongue and a black nylon heel tab with additional Jumpman branding are signature design aspects of the Air Jordan 12. Completing the look is a white and red sole with “23” on the heel and “Jumpman”

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Gamma"
products.description: The Air Jordan 12 Retro received this appealing colorway in 2013, featuring a bold contrast of black nubuck with vibrant Gamma Blue. The look was an instant hit thanks to its use of an OG block with an appealing new color palette.

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Cherry 2023"
products.description: The Air Jordan 12 “Cherry” is the re-release of an original colorway of Michael Jordan’s twelfth signature shoe that debuted in 1997. Worn by Jordan with the Chicago Bulls throughout the NBA’s 1996-97 regular season, the Jordan 12 “Cherry” is one of the most popular and iconic Jordan models of all time. The 2023 version of the shoe remains faithful to the original style from ‘97. It features a white leather construction with a Varsity Red textured mudguard/toe panel that spills onto the midsole. Silver eyelets and black Jumpman and “Two 3” detailing are found on the collar and tongue, respectively. Release date: October 28, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Black Taxi"
products.description: The Air Jordan 12 “Black Taxi” is a mostly monochromatic black colorway of Michael Jordan’s twelfth signature shoe that references its original “Taxi” look, but with a twist. The “Black Taxi,” as suggested by its nickname, updates the Jordan 12’s original “Taxi” colorway with black accents in lieu of the “Taxi’s” predominantly white upper. The “Black Taxi” features a black leather upper instead of the “Taxi’s” white leather construction. A tonal synthetic textured mudguard ties into the colorway’s stealthy vibe. Yellow accents come into play on the eyelets and on the midfoot overlay with “Jumpman” branding. Additional pops of yellow are found on the embroidered Jumpman and “Two 3” logos on t

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Utility"
products.description: Black suede/leather Air Jordan 12 Retro high-top sneakers from JORDAN featuring round toe, front lace-up fastening, logo-embossed tongue, ankle-length, pull-tab at the heel, branded insole and rubber sole. These styles are supplied by a premium sneaker marketplace. Stocking only the most sought-after footwear, they source and curate some of the most hard to find sneakers from around the world..

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Playoffs 2022"
products.description: The Air Jordan 12 “Playoffs 2022” is a February 2022 release of an original colorway of the retro basketball shoe that was worn by Michael Jordan during the 1997 NBA Playoffs. An All-Star Weekend 2022 release, the Jordan 12 “Playoffs” celebrates the shoe’s 25-year anniversary in spectacular fashion as the modern incarnation of the shoe is a one-to-one remake of the original version from ‘97. The shoe features a black leather upper with contrasting Metallic Silver eyelets. Textured white leather is found on the toe, mudguard, and midsole. A silver “Jumpman” plate appears on the branding plate on the lateral side of the shoe. The black leather tongue displays a red embroidered Jumpman and “Two

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Royalty Taxi"
products.description: The Air Jordan 12 “Royalty Taxi” is a reimagined version of the original colorway of Michael Jordan’s retro basketball shoe from the late ‘90s that features several new modifications. A Holiday 2021 release by Jordan Brand, the new-look “Royalty Taxi” or “Royalty” mimics the Air Jordan 12’s original white-and-black “Taxi” color block, but with a few notable variations. Instead of a black leather mudguard, per the original design, the mudguard found on the “Royalty” is dressed in black suede. Also, the Jumpman plate above the midsole now appears in gold. Additional gold accenting comes into play on the Jumpman-branded eyelet holders and on the Jumpman and “Two 3” detailing on the white leathe

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Reverse Flu Game"
products.description: The Air Jordan 12 “Reverse Flu Game” rearranges the color block of an original colorway of Michael Jordan’s twelfth signature shoe. The “Reverse Flu Game” inverts the classic black leather upper and red pattern leather mudguard of the original Jordan 12 worn by Michael most famously during his epic “Flu Game” performance of Game 5 of the '97 NBA Finals. Whereas the original "Flu Game" featured a leather upper, the "Reverse Flu Game" displays a plush Varsity Red suede construction. The mudguard features a contrasting cut of black pebbled leather. The black rope laces sit on top a red suede tongue. A nod to the original design of the Air Jordan 12, the tongue displays a black embroidered Jumpm

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Indigo"
products.description: The Air Jordan 12 “Indigo” is yet another desirable colorway of Michael Jordan’s twelfth signature shoe. This late-Summer 2020 release displays a similar color blocking to the Jordan 12 “Obsidian” from 2012, though the upper paneling deviates in shade from dark navy blue to an indigo hue. Smooth white leather dots the mudguard and tonal embossed Jumpman branding appears above the midsole. Silver eyelets with Jumpman detailing, University Blue laces, and tonal embroidered Jumpman branding on the Indigo tongue add further styling to the classic silhouette. A white rubber midsole and outsole complete the look. Release date: August 22, 2020.

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Dark Concord"
products.description: The Air Jordan 12 “Dark Concord” is a colorway from Jordan Brand’s Holiday 2020 release cycle that calls to mind classic player exclusive colorways from the 2000s. Although not officially associated with any player or team, the “Dark Concord” Jordan 12 looks as if it could have been worn by Mike Bibby with the Sacramento Kings or even Kobe Bryant back in the day. The upper features a black nubuck construction with faux lizard leather print on the forefoot and mudguard. Dark Concord accented eyelets and Jumpman branding above the black rubber midsole breaks up the shadowy appearance of the shoe. Additional purple detailing can be found on the Jumpman embroidery on the tongue, and on the nylon

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "PSNY FRIENDS AND FAMILY"
products.description: This limited release special edition, titled “PSNY Friends and Family” is a collab with streetwear brand Public School New York. This colorway featuring plush and grainy leather all black uppers with white soles was released only to friends and family, and therefore was a very limited release.

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Deep Royal Suede"
products.description: Air Jordan 12 Retro 130690 400

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Dark Grey"
products.description: The Air Jordan 12 “Dark Grey” is a clean, neutral colorway of Michael Jordan’s beloved twelfth signature shoe. Jordan Brand constructs the versatile high-top with a classic paneled white leather upper. Contrasting the look is a signature high-cut pebbled grey leather mudguard that extends into the mid-panel of the shoe. Chrome Jumpman branding appears on the midsole and is contrasted by bold red Jumpman branding embroidered onto the white leather tongue. True-to-original Jordan Brand logo detailing appears on both the spine of the heel as well as on the grey rubber outsole. The Air Jordan 12 “Dark Grey” was released on November 29, 2019.

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "UNC"
products.description: One of the brand-new Air Jordan 12 colorways released in 2016 during the model’s big comeback year, this clean colorway features a Wolf Grey nubuck upper with white toe panels and University Blue accents. Often referred to as the “UNC” colorway due to its similar color scheme to Michael Jordan’s alma mater of North Carolina.

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "University Gold"
products.description: The Air Jordan 12 “University Gold” is a refreshing new colorway of Michael Jordan’s late-90s signature shoe. Adopting the familiar two-toned appearance of some of the greatest Jordan 12s, the “University Gold” look displays a buttery black leather upper and contrasting yellow lizard-patterned leather mudguard. The rest of the design is kept understated as black laces, silver hardware, and a black leather tongue allow for the embroidered yellow Jumpman and “Two 3” branding on the tongue to garner attention. A carbon fiber midfoot plate, black Jumpman, and two black traction pods on the yellow outsole follow the styling cadence of the original Air Jordan 12s from 1997. Release date: July 18,

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Gym Red"
products.description: This “reverse” colorway of the OG white and red Air Jordan 12 colorway features a red leather upper with accents in white for a new spin on the classic Bulls color scheme.

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "French Blue 2016"
products.description: Among the many colorways of the Air Jordan 12 to release in 2016 was the beloved “French Blue” version first released in 2004, featuring a clean white and dark blue color scheme.

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Flu Game 2016"
products.description: This original Air Jordan 12 in black and red is now forever known as the “Flu Game” colorway after being worn by Michael Jordan during his legendary performance with flu-like symptoms in the 1997 NBA Finals. Despite being very ill and barely being able to finish the game, Jordan put up 38 points and led the Chicago Bulls to victory in a crucial Game 5 win that eventually propelled his team to another NBA Championship.

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "The Master"
products.description: Inspired by a classic poster graphic from the ad campaign of the original Air Jordan 12, this all-new look released in 2016 features a luxe black leather upper with accents in grey and metallic gold. The clean look will go down as one of the best colorways for the twelfth Air Jordan ever.

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Gym Red"
products.description: The Air Jordan 12 “Black Friday/Gym Red” is a premium edition of the storied silhouette that released during the Holiday 2018 season. The eye-catching colorway features a premium Gym Red leather upper with a matte finish from top to bottom. The minimal branding is done in a contrasting shade of black. Metallic red detailing is added for the top lace eyelets and the “Jumpman” tab on the midfoot above the midsole. Jordan Brand’s special release for the biggest holiday shopping event of the year certainly didn’t disappoint, as the striking all-red look and elevated materials of the Air Jordan 12 “Black Friday/Gym Red” made it one of the must-have releases of the season.

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Dark Grey"
products.description: JORDAN 130690005 DARK GREY/DARK GREY-WOLF GREY rubber/Suede/Suede/Leather

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "PSNY"
products.description: This ultra premium collaboration on the Air Jordan 12 with Public School NY features an all-nubuck construction molded with the the iconic lines of the twelfth Air Jordan. The stylish rendition of the Air Jordan 12 was released in limited quantities, and has now become one of the most sought-after versions of the shoe ever.

products.title: Air Jordan 12 Retro "Bordeaux"
products.description: The Bordeaux look has been popular within the Jordan Brand think tank in 2017. Following the "Paris" pair from the Public School City Exclusive collab, we see another Air Jordan 12 feature the eye-catching colorway. This time, the purple-ish hue isn't tonal, as it's instead offset by white details on the sole unit and heel. The upper is constructed in a premium suede, with the matching textured mudguard appearing in faux caviar leather. This release continues the trend of Jordan Brand delivering classic models with more lifestyle focused designs – particularly the Air Jordan 12.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Bin23"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 "Bin 23" remains a pinnacle of the Premio Series, celebrating premium craftsmanship and elite exclusivity. Dressed in a sophisticated Cinder and White palette, this sneaker features high-grade tumbled leather and a unique wax seal logo on the heel. The gold-tipped laces and refined accents elevate the 1988 classic into a luxury collector's piece. It is a sophisticated, soulful masterpiece that honors the finer details of Jordan Brand’s storied history with an unmistakable touch of luxury.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "World’s Best Dad"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “World’s Best Dad” is a soulful and celebratory tribute to fatherhood and the ultimate family man. Featuring a premium leather upper in a sophisticated navy and grey palette, this special edition includes custom "World's Best Dad" branding and heartwarming details throughout the design. The iconic elephant print and visible Air cushioning provide the classic Jordan style and comfort. It is a heartwarming, high-energy masterpiece that makes the perfect gift for the hero in your life.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Brazil"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro "Brazil" is a high-octane, celebratory masterpiece that honors the rich athletic heritage and vibrant cultural energy of the South American nation on Tinker Hatfield's legendary 1989 silhouette. Constructed from a premium dual-textured upper, the sneaker features a deep royal blue tumbled leather chassis sharply complemented by a navy blue smooth leather mudguard overlay at the forefoot. The design is anchored by an explosive varsity yellow midsole and a high-contrast candy pink mesh collar and tongue lining, providing a definitive, light-catching architectural focal point that subverts traditional Jordan color-blocking. Engineered for ultimate street-level durability

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Levi's - All-Star"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 "Levis - All Star" merges two American icons in a celebration of craftsmanship and basketball heritage. Featuring a full-denim upper with signature Levi’s "red tab" detailing, this pair reimagines the classic elephant print with distressed indigo textures. The premium construction is accented by a tan leather tongue patch, mimicking the back of a pair of 501s. Complete with the iconic visible Air unit and a rubber outsole, this collaboration is a rugged yet refined masterpiece for denim enthusiasts.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "SoleFly - Miami Hurricanes"
products.description: Pay homage to the "305" and the legendary grit of the U with the SoleFly x Air Jordan 3 "Fruits Of Our Labor." This 2025 collaboration celebrates the Miami Hurricanes with a sophisticated "Sail, Gorge Green, and Bright Mandarin" palette. Ditching the traditional elephant print for a more artisanal touch, the design features premium Gorge Green suede on the mudguard and vibrant Bright Mandarin suede on the heel. Finished with a vintage-tinted midsole and the iconic "Nike Air" branding in green, this pair captures the "coastal luxury" and athletic excellence that define South Florida’s sports culture.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Levi's - Indigo"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 "Levis - Indigo" merges two American giants in a celebration of premium craftsmanship. Featuring a full-denim upper with the signature Levi’s "red tab," this pair reimagines the classic elephant print with distressed indigo textures. The tan leather tongue patch mimics the back of a pair of 501s, adding a rugged, artisanal touch to the 1988 silhouette. It is a sophisticated, lifestyle-oriented masterpiece that bridges the gap between legendary basketball heritage and classic American denim culture.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Spring Is In The Air"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 "Spring is in the Air" celebrates the season of renewal with a soft, floral-inspired colorway. Featuring a premium pastel palette across the leather upper, this release updates the classic 1988 silhouette with a fresh, optimistic aesthetic. The iconic elephant print is reimagined in a complementary tone, while the visible Air unit ensures all-day comfort. It is a soulful, celebratory masterpiece that offers a sophisticated and bright addition to any warm-weather sneaker rotation for the modern era.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "El Vuelo"
products.description: Step into exclusive style with the Air Jordan 3 "El Vuelo". This celebrated silhouette features a unique design and premium materials, embodying the spirit of "The Flight." Experience comfortable Air cushioning and a versatile look, perfect for making a bold statement with a sophisticated edge.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Family Affair"
products.description: Step into a piece of sneaker history with the Air Jordan 3 "Family Affair". This special edition sneaker features a clean design with subtle accents that pay tribute to the Jordan family legacy. Experience comfortable Air cushioning and a versatile look, perfect for making a bold statement with a sophisticated edge.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Pure Money (2025)"
products.description: Elevate your look with the pristine style of the Air Jordan 3 "Pure Money." The all-white leather upper, complemented by subtle metallic silver accents on the eyelets and branding, offers a clean and luxurious aesthetic. The iconic elephant print adds a touch of texture, making this versatile sneaker a fresh statement piece.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Rare Air"
products.description: Experience a fresh take on a legend with the Air Jordan 3 "Rare Air." This iconic silhouette blends classic Jordan DNA with a unique color palette. The distinct pattern and visible Air cushioning remain, delivering heritage appeal and all-day comfort. This edition also features the iconic "Nike Air" branding on the heel, adding to its authentic retro appeal. The "Rare Air" showcases a dynamic combination of tones for an eye-catching look.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Seoul 2.0"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 "Seoul 2.0" is a unique colorway of Michael Jordan's third signature shoe that honors the South Korean capital. The "Seoul 2.0" released in 2025 and followed the first "Seoul" AJ3 that came out in 2018. The "Seoul 2.0" Jordan 3 has the South Korea flag embroidered on the tongue and carries over the red and blue colors to the ankle and lining. The "Seoul 2.0" has a vintage-inspired midsole and lighter grey elephant print to distinguish it from the original.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Black Cat 2025"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 "Black Cat" is a stealth, all-black colorway of Michael Jordan's third signature sneaker. The shoe has all of the details that Jordan 3 fans love, including the elephant print around the heel and toe, and the exposed Air cushioning unit. The AJ3 "Black Cat" also features patent leather accents that help the shoe really stand out.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "(2024) - Black Cement"
products.description: One of the most revered sneakers of all time, the Air Jordan 3 "Black Cement" is getting a retro release for Holiday 2024. This "Black Cement" AJ3 pays faithful tribute to the original Jordan 3 that first came out in 1988. The Jordan 3 "Black Cement" features tumbled black leather and the iconic elephant print on the panels of the upper. And the "Nike Air" branding that purists love is featured on the heel.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Midnight Navy"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 "Midnight Navy" is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe with navy accents. Michael Jordan’s third signature shoe in the “Midnight Navy” colorway features a white leather upper with elephant print overlays on the toe and heel. A Midnight Navy-colored mudguard contrasts the look, as do the Midnight Navy eyelet holes. More Midnight Navy accenting is featured on the Jumpman on the white leather tongue and on the Jumpman on the heel. The white midsole has a visible Air bubble in the heel. A grey rubber outsole completes the look. Release date: January 13, 2024

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "J Balvin - Rio"
products.description: The J Balvin x Air Jordan 3 “Rio” is a collaboration by the popular recording artist on a colorway of the classic Jordan sneaker inspired by his son, Rio. J Balvin and Jordan Brand have worked together on colorways of the Air Jordan 1, Air Jordan 2, and Air Jordan 3 in consecutive years since 2020. The “Rio” represents the fourth project between the two entities, and second on the Jordan 3 following 2023’s “Medellín Sunset".” As for the design, the shoe features a black leather base with classic grey elephant print on the toe and heel inspired by the pattern found on the original Jordan 3 from 1988. A gradient midsole with a Solar Flare and Total Crimson Abyss color combination matches the a

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Fear (2023)"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 "Fear Pack" is the 2023 re-release of the colorway of Michael Jordan’s third signature shoe that debuted back in 2013. Inspired by Jordan Brand’s “Become Legendary” campaign from 2008 that featured Carmelo Anthony, Derek Jeter, and other Jordan Brand Athletes, the Jordan 3 “Fear Pack” or simply “Fear” was originally released alongside an Air Jordan 4 and Air Jordan 5 in “Fear” colorways. As for the Jordan 3 “Fear,” the shoe features a Night Stadium suede construction with elephant print on the toe and heel. Total Orange accents are found on the eyelets, on the Jumpman on the tongue and on the heel, and on the rubber outsole. Release date: November 25, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Palomino"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Palomino” brings a premium lifestyle look to the iconic silhouette. The elevated design for the Jordan 3 features various shades of brown, including a light tan suede base, a medium shade of brown for the signature elephant print panels at the toe and heel, and darker “Palomino” brown for the lace eyelets, midsole, and inner lining. Gold Jumpman branding on the tongue and heel tab contrast the brown shades of the upper, while a cream colored midsole and grey outsole complete this classy look for the Jordan 3. Release date: July 29, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "White Cement Reimagined 2023"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “White Cement Reimagined” is a special version of the classic basketball sneaker that replicates the model’s original design. Released by Jordan Brand in 2023 to celebrate the iconic Jordan 3’s 35th anniversary, the “White Cement Reimagined” retains the look of the model’s “White Cement” colorway with accurate-to-original panels, colors, and overall shape. Faithful to the 1988 version of the Jordan 3 “White Cement,” the “Reimagined” features a higher-cut ankle collar inspired by the OG Jordan 3’s design. It also is equipped with a white leather upper with contrasting grey elephant print on the toe and heel, which has also been modified to look like the detailing on the origi

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Dark Iris"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Dark Iris” is a colorway that draws favorably from another popular, non-original Jordan 3. The shoe we’re referring to is the Air Jordan 3 “Court Purple” from 2020. Like that release, the “Dark Iris” features purple accenting and grey elephant print detailing, but with a white leather base instead of black leather. As for the rest of the design, purple leather accenting appears on the collar and on the plastic eyelets. The model’s classic elephant print detailing appears on the mudguard and toe cap. Elsewhere, a Dark Iris-colored Jumpman is found on the heel and stitched onto the white leather tongue. Release date: August 24, 2022

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Muslin"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Muslin” is a March 2022 release of Michael Jordan’s third signature shoe in a colorway that modifies the silhouette’s original design in a more streamlined appearance. The “Muslin” is a versatile look for the vintage basketball shoe that features a Sail-colored canvas upper with contrasting grey suede panels on the toe and heel that replace the Jordan 3’s original elephant print design. A darker shade of cream white is found on the eyelets, heel tab, and midsole. Jordan Brand places a red Jumpman on the tongue and on the heel beneath the “Air” branding. Release date: March 25, 2022

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Cardinal"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Cardinal” is a February 2022 release of the vintage basketball shoe in a colorway inspired by an original Air Jordan 7 colorway. The “Cardinal” Jordan 3 references the colors and materials of the Jordan 7’s original “Cardinal” colorway from 1992. The white tumbled leather upper is contrasted with Cardinal Red accenting on the painted mudguard on the heel, collar, and top eyelet holes. Both the bottom eyelets and Jumpman logo embroidered on the white tumbled leather tongue are designed in a Light Curry shade of yellow. A Cardinal Red Jumpman resides on the back of the shoe. The Jordan 3’s signature elephant print is found on the toe and heel. Release date: February 19, 2022

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Patchwork Camo"
products.description: The Air Jordan 3 “Patchwork Camo” is a November 2021 release of Michael Jordan’s third signature shoe in a colorway that features three different types of camouflage print. The classic basketball shoe displays “rain,” “leaf,” and “woodland” camo patterns on multiple overlays on its design, a first for the Jordan 3. The left and right shoes feature various earth-tone colors and camo panels in a mismatched design. A velcro-style “Nike Air” patch can be added or removed from the heel. The unique Jordan 3 is completed with a white midsole and a black outsole with orange accents. Release date: November 29, 2021

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Wings"
products.description: Uplift your collection with the highly sought-after Air Jordan 3 Retro "Wings." This limited-edition release is part of the Jordan Brand Wings Scholarship Program, with proceeds supporting youth education. It features a clean White leather upper accented by Off-White elephant print, elevated with a unique rose-adorned denim twill on the mudguard. Pops of Fire Red and Vintage Green are scattered throughout, blending luxury finishes with a deeply meaningful cause.

products.title: Air Jordan 3 "Cement Grey"
products.description: For a legendary look that stands the test of time, consider the Air Jordan 3 "Cement Grey." This timeless design boasts signature details, including its distinctive grey elephant print. It delivers responsive cushioning and a comfortable fit, making it a versatile and sharp choice for any sneakerhead.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Chris Paul - Give Them Flowers"
products.description: The Chris Paul x Air Jordan 1 Low OG “Give Them Flowers” is a special colorway of the retro basketball shoe inspired by the basketball star’s career. Considered one of the best point guards in NBA history, Chris Paul has had as impressive a career as any other player from his era. On the Jordan 1 Low OG “Give Them Flowers,” Jordan Brand celebrates Paul’s achievements by designing Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe with an intricate floral pattern texture. An off-white roughout suede material appears on the perforated toe, tongue, and Swoosh, contrasting the rest of the shoe’s mostly white upper. Classic “Nike Air” branding appears on the tongue while the phrase “Give Them Flowers” is seen

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Travis Scott - Tropical Pink"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low "Travis Scott - Tropical Pink" electrifies the collaborative silhouette with a vibrant, high-visibility hue. Featuring a premium construction in "Tropical Pink" and earthy accents, this pair highlights the iconic reverse Swoosh and industrial branding that have made Travis Scott’s releases legendary. The responsive cushioning and low-profile design provide all-day comfort with an unmistakable visual profile. It is a bold, sophisticated masterpiece that redefines the boundaries of modern streetwear for the true creative explorer.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Travis Scott - Shy Pink"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low "Travis Scott - Shy Pink" offers a sophisticated, soft-toned take on Cactus Jack’s signature aesthetic. Featuring a premium nubuck and leather upper in "Shy Pink" and earthy neutrals, this collaboration includes the iconic oversized reverse Swoosh. The industrial branding and "Cactus Jack" details reflect Travis Scott’s unique creative vision. It is a bold, high-energy masterpiece for those who value the intersection of high-end hip-hop culture and the timeless legacy of the Air Jordan 1.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Laser"
products.description: Step into wearable artwork with the Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Laser." This striking release revives Jordan Brand's iconic mid-2000s laser technology, wrapping a premium black leather upper in intricate, tattoo-style Palomino brown graphics that celebrate Michael Jordan's legendary career. Sleek black nubuck details on the toe cap and Swoosh anchor the look, while vibrant University Red laces and a matching outsole deliver a bold burst of energy. A clean white midsole completes this masterpiece, blending archival storytelling with street-ready sophistication.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Chinese New Year"
products.description: Air Jordan 1 Low OG DH6932 100

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Xuan Wu"
products.description: Step into legend with the Air Jordan 1 Low OG Xuan Wu. Celebrating the Year of the Snake, this special release draws inspiration from Xuan Wu, the mythical tortoise-snake deity of protection and strength. The low-top silhouette features a premium black leather upper paired with an ornate, embossed cloud-print design on the heel. A translucent tortoise-shell pattern outsole and striking metallic gold Nike Air branding on the tongue complete this highly symbolic and wearable masterpiece.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Nigel Sylvester - Better With Time"
products.description: Step into a unique collaboration with the Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Nigel Sylvester Better With Time." This special sneaker, born from a partnership with BMX pro Nigel Sylvester, features a distinct design and premium materials. Experience comfortable cushioning and a style that's perfect for making a bold statement with an exclusive edge.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Chicago (2025)"
products.description: Unleash a bold classic with the Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Chicago." This striking sneaker features a crisp white leather upper, accented by a vibrant red overlay and a sleek black Swoosh. Enjoy superior cushioning and a design that's perfect for making a powerful statement with a nod to sneaker heritage.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Rui Hachimura - Cranes"
products.description: Experience a blend of hoops heritage and Japanese elegance with the Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Rui Hachimura - Cranes." This sophisticated sneaker honors Rui's background, showcasing delicate cherry blossom and crane graphics on the textile overlays, symbolizing peace and longevity. The premium oatmeal suede and black accents provide a luxurious contrast. Finished with a metallic gold-outlined Swoosh—a nod to his "Black Samurai" nickname—and a custom insole logo, this is wearable art you'll be excited to lace up.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Year of the Snake"

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Bleached Coral"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low OG “Bleached Coral” is a clean look for the original version of the retro basketball shoe primed for the warm weather season. The shoe features a “Black Toe” Air Jordan 1 inspired look with its Bleached Coral cracked leather toe and contrasting black cracked leather toe cap and forefoot overlays. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Neutral Grey"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low OG “Neutral Grey” is a June 2021 re-release of an original colorway of the low-top version of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe that debuted in 1985. While not quite a true one-to-one remake of the first low-top “Neutral Grey,” the June 2021 release is nonetheless a highly covetable look for the alternate Jordan 1 Low. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Mystic Navy"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low OG “Mystic Navy'' is a classic retro sneaker with a simple two-tone arrangement. Underfoot, the sole unit has a white midsole and blue outsole. Release date: June 30, 2022

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Chinese New Year 2021"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low OG “Chinese New Year” is a limited edition colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe that celebrates the traditional Chinese holiday. Limited to 8500 units, the “Chinese New Year” Jordan 1 Low is a desirable shoe that also shows love to the classic “Bred” colorway by employing black and red panels into its design. Various floral designs are embroidered into the black and red canvas panels found on the forefoot, mid-panel, eyelets, and heel, respectively. A University Red canvas Swoosh logo appears on either side of the shoe. Jordan Brand places a gold “Wings” emblem on the back of the shoe and “Nike Air” branding can be found on the tag of the black nylon tongue.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Starfish"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low OG “Starfish” is an August 2021 release of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in low-top form that pays tribute to a now-classic colorway. The “Starfish,” despite its nickname, gives a nod toward the Air Jordan 1’s popular “Shattered Backboard,” specifically the “Reverse Shattered Backboard” Jordan 1 from 2016, with its black, white, and orange color scheme. Also, the Air Jordan 1 Low OG is a near one-to-one remake of the original version of the low-top basketball shoe from 1985. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Ghost Green"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 Low OG “Ghost Green” is a modified version of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe that introduces new design details to the model. In low-top form, the “Ghost Green” Jordan 1 features a predominantly two-tone white and pale green color block. The forefoot, eyelets, collar, heel, and Swoosh display a Ghost Green leather construction. The perforated toe and mid-panel are constructed in white leather. A small embroidered Swoosh appears on the forefoot, a design that was not on the original Air Jordan 1 Low from 1985. Elsewhere, a “Wings” logo appears on the grey leather heel tab. products.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG "Mocha"
products.description: Step into a classic with a new twist with the Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG "Mocha." This celebrated silhouette features a crisp white leather upper accented by rich brown nubuck on the heel. Experience comfortable cushioning and a design recognized for its enduring appeal, perfect for making a bold statement with a sophisticated color palette.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 High OG "Shattered Backboard (2025)"
products.description: Make a bold statement with the striking look of the Air Jordan 1 High OG "Shattered Backboard." The vibrant Starfish orange, black, and sail color blocking, combined with premium tumbled leather, creates an instantly recognizable and highly coveted aesthetic. This legendary colorway brings back impactful style to the timeless Air Jordan 1 silhouette.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 High OG "UNC Reimagined"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High "UNC Reimagined" offers a fresh look at Michael Jordan's first signature shoe. products.title: Air Jordan 1 High OG "Black Toe Reimagined"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High "Black Toe Reimagined" continues the Jordan Brand's Reimagined series that adds subtle updates to iconic models and colorways. The Jordan 1 "Black Toe Reimagined" has a premium leather upper and a nylon tongue that is adorned with the "Nike Air" tag. "Air Jordan" is embossed around the ankle just like the pair that Michael Jordan dangled over his shoulder in some of the original Jordan 1 campaign photos.

products.title: Air Jordan 1 High OG "Mauve"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High OG “Mauve” is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe with an autumn-inspired design. From Jordan Brand’s Fall 2023 collection, the Jordan 1 High OG “Mauve” features a white leather base that’s contrasted with Mauve, or muted purple, leather overlay panels on the toe, forefoot, eyelets, collar, and heel. A Mauve leather Swoosh can be seen on each side of the shoe. “Wings” branding is found on the collar and “Nike Air” and Swoosh logos appear on the tongue tag. Underfoot, a white midsole and Mauve outsole complete the look. Release date: October 14, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 1 High OG "Skyline"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High OG “Skyline” is a colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe that is inspired by the original Jordan 1 campaign rollout. In a unique way, the Jordan 1 High OG “Skyline” is influenced by the purple and orange hues of the skyline photo of “The GOAT” wearing the original Jordan 1. The shoe features a white leather base with denim overlays that are designed with a Vivid Orange appearance that gradients into Lilac towards the heel, a nod to the orange-to-purple hue of the skyline. A black “Wings” logo appears on the collar and “Nike Air” detailing is found on the tongue. Release date: April 8, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 1 High OG "Spider-Man Across the Spider-Verse"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High OG “Spider-Man Across the Spider-Verse” is a special colorway of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe that is inspired by the sequel of the movie, “Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.” Specifically inspired by the film’s protagonist, Miles Morales and his Spider-Man suit, the “Spider-Man Across the Spider-Verse” is also the much-anticipated follow-up to 2019’s Jordan 1 High OG “Spider-Man.” Here, the “Spider-Man Across the Spider-Verse” features a similar design to its predecessor and the Jordan 1’s original and iconic “Chicago” colorway. products.title: Air Jordan 1 High OG "True Blue"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High OG “True Blue” is a colorway of the classic high-top sneaker that draws favorably from an original Air Jordan colorway. The shoe in question is the Air Jordan 3’s original “True Blue” colorway that debuted in 1988. While the shoes share a nickname, they differ from each other in design. Here, the Jordan 1 “True Blue” features a white leather construction with True Blue-colored leather on the toe cap, forefoot, eyelets, and Swoosh. The blue hue also appears on the “Wings” logo on the collar overlay and on the “Nike Air” logo on the tongue tag. Cement Grey leather is found on the heel. Underfoot, a white midsole and grey rubber outsole complete the look. Release date: Jan

products.title: Air Jordan 1 High OG "White Cement"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High OG “White Cement” is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe that takes inspiration from the classic elephant patterning found on the Air Jordan 3. The “White Cement’s” overlay panels feature the same iconic elephant print that debuted on the Jordan 3 in 1988. As for the rest of the design, the shoe features a white leather base with the aforementioned Cement-colored elephant print overlays. A black Swoosh appears on either side of the shoe. A black “Wings” logo is located on the collar and white “Nike Air” detailing appears on the tongue tag. Underfoot, the vintage-inspired Sail rubber midsole is paired with a grey outsole. products.title: Air Jordan 1 High OG "Taxi"
products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High OG “Taxi” is an August 2022 release of Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe in a colorway inspired by the iconic “Black Toe” Jordan 1 from 1985. Interestingly enough, the “Taxi” is also inspired by a rare, unreleased sample Jordan 1 High OG given to Shinedown, a Jacksonville, Florida based rock band, in celebration of their “Attention Attention” album release in 2018. As for the “Taxi,” yellow leather is found on the perforated toe and black leather is found on the toe cap, forefoot, and eyelets. The black leather around the toe is inspired by the original Jordan 1 “Black Toe” from 1985. Release date: August 13, 2022

products.title: Air Jordan 1 High OG "Stash"

A Spring 2022 release by Jordan Brand, this utilitarian look for the Jordan 1 includes an outdoors-inspired design with flaps on the mid-panel and a large pocket on the back of the shoe. The entire upper is constructed of black nylon. Orange tabs throughout the upper balance the sneaker’s monochromatic black appearance. Even with the design modifications, it still features a Swoosh on the sides and a “Wings” logo on the collar—two signature elements of the original Air Jordan 1. Release date: May 3, 2022

products.title: Air Jordan 1 High OG "Rebellionaire"

A March 2021 release, the “Rebellionaire” arrives in the same color block as the Jordan 1’s original “Shadow” colorway, with the addition of distressed leather panels and lettering printed throughout the design. The grey leather panels on the perforated toe, collar, heel, and Swoosh on either side feature “They Can’t Stop You From Wearing Them” print inspired from the aforementioned Jordan 1 “Banned” commercial. products.description: The Air Jordan 1 High “Meant to Fly” is a Fall 2019 release that is inspired by an early advertisement for Michael Jordan’s first signature shoe. Jordan, in the mid-80s video campaign, can be seen taking off in slow motion from a playground black-top as jet engine noises swirl in the background. products.description: Along with Carmelo Anthony and Chris Paul, fellow Jordan Brand team member Blake Griffin also got his own colorway of the Air Jordan 1 High in 2015. His version features a bold red and white upper with black accents and Blake’s BG logo on each tongue.

She is also a self-proclaimed sneakerhead, who has developed a close relationship with her local Shoe Palace store in San Jose. The colors are complemented by Abloh's deconstructed aesthetic and signature details such as bright orange detailing and a red zip tie. products.description: Bring legendary street style to the fairway with the Air Jordan 1 Low Golf "Forest Green." products.title: Air Jordan 4 "11Lab4 Red"

products.title: Air Jordan 4 "11Lab4 Black"
products.description: For the 11Lab4 concept, Jordan Brand combines the silhouette of the Air Jordan 4 with the iconic patent leather gloss of the Air Jordan 11. This colorway features a blacked-out upper for a sleek and ultra stylish look.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 "Tour Yellow"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 "Tour Yellow" charges into the scene with a high-visibility colorway that celebrates the speed and energy of the 1989 classic. This pair features a vibrant yellow nubuck upper accented by sharp black and grey details. The signature supportive wings and visible Air cushioning ensure legendary lockdown and comfort. It is a bold, high-energy masterpiece designed for those who want to represent the greatness of the Jumpman with a powerful, electrified presence.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 "Nigel Sylvester - Brick After Brick"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro "Nigel Sylvester - Brick After Brick" is a high-octane, narrative-driven masterpiece that marks the professional BMX rider’s first official collaboration on the iconic AJ4 silhouette. Reimagining the legendary 1989 Tinker Hatfield design through the lens of Sylvester's relentless urban grind, the sneaker features a premium smooth white leather upper complemented by textured neutral suede overlays at the forefoot. The design is anchored by striking "Fencepost" red accents across the eyelets, midsole, and interior lining, providing a high-contrast architectural focal point that pays homage to the brick walls of his childhood riding spots. Engineered for exceptional daily

products.title: Air Jordan 4 "Bred (2026)"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 "Bred (2026)" revives one of sneaker history's most iconic colorways with unmatched fidelity to the original 1989 release. Crafted with a smooth black nubuck upper, this legendary silhouette features authentic white-edged paneling, classic Cement Grey mesh netting, and Fire Red accents throughout. Complete with coveted "Nike Air" heel branding and the updated OG mold, it delivers timeless basketball heritage paired with essential daily street style.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 "Toro Bravo (2026)"
products.description: Make an unmistakably bold statement with the Jordan Air Jordan 4 "Toro Bravo (2026)". Returning in its head turning Fire Red nubuck construction, this legendary retro features crisp Cement Grey accents, contrasting black support wings, and signature quarter panel netting. Crafted closer to the 1989 originals sleeker shape, it offers visible heel Air cushioning and lightweight support for all day comfort. It is the ultimate crossover of heritage basketball culture and high impact street style.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 "Flight Club"
products.description: Pay homage to the dawn of the Jumpman community with the Air Jordan 1 Retro OG "Flight Club." Launching in early 2026, this release celebrates the legendary 1989 membership program that connected fans to MJ via exclusive newsletters and posters. The design features a premium Sail leather upper for a sophisticated, aged aesthetic, beautifully contrasted by sharp black wings and heel tabs. With the iconic "Nike Air" branding on the heel trimmed in University Red, this pair serves as a sophisticated history lesson in a colorway that rivals the modern-classic "Military Black."

products.title: Air Jordan 4 "Lakers"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Lakers” celebrates the storied history of the purple and gold with a premium, court-ready look. Dressed in a clean white leather base, this pair features vibrant "University Gold" and "Field Purple" accents throughout the eyelets, mesh, and midsole. The iconic "Flight" tongue tag and visible Air cushioning ensure this pair remains true to its 1989 roots. It’s a perfect tribute for fans of the Lake Show, offering a bold way to represent the team while enjoying legendary comfort.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 "Rare Air - Gold Lettering"
products.description: Step into a rare find with the Air Jordan 4 "Rare Air Gold Lettering." This limited-edition sneaker features a clean design with striking gold lettering, adding an exclusive touch. Experience comfortable cushioning and a design celebrated for its enduring appeal, perfect for making a bold statement with a unique edge.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 "Cave Stone"
products.description: Unearth a gem for your collection with the Air Jordan 4 "Cave Stone." This remarkable release redefines the classic silhouette with a unique, textured suede upper in a striking cave stone hue. Its rich, rugged material and vibrant accents create a powerful aesthetic, making this highly coveted shoe a centerpiece for any true sneaker enthusiast.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 "Nike SB - Navy"
products.description: The Nike SB x Air Jordan 4 "Navy" is a new installment in the ongoing collaboration between Nike Skateboarding and Jordan Brand. The Nike SB AJ4 looks like a traditional Jordan 4 but has some unique details. Suede is placed around the toe box to make the shoe more skate-friendly. The clean navy and white upper is accented with a gum outsole, and Nike SB branding appears on the heel.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 "Fear"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 "Fear" brings a dark and moody tone to Michael Jordan's fourth signature shoe. Returning in 2024, the greyscale Jordan 4 was originally part of the "Fear Pack" that dropped in 2013. The panels on the upper of the AJ4 "Fear" progress from light grey to dark grey to black as you move from the toe to the heel. These are contrasted with a light grey Jumpman on the heel tab and tongue patch.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 "Oxidized Green"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Oxidized Green” is a colorway of Michael Jordan’s fourth signature shoe with green details. A versatile look for the iconic silhouette, the upper features a white leather design with tonal netting on the mid-panel and tongue. Contrasting Oxidized Green accents can be found on the molded eyelets, the lace “wings,” and on the heel tab, branded with a classic Jumpman logo. An additional Jumpman can be found on the tongue tag. Underfoot, an Oxidized Green mudguard, a vintage-inspired Sail midsole, and a visible Air unit in the heel complete the look. Release date: July 13, 2024

products.title: Air Jordan 4 "Wet Cement"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 "Wet Cement" is a highly anticipated re-release of one of the most iconic colorways in Jordan Brand's history. Paying homage to the legendary original design, this edition of the Air Jordan 4 blends classic styling with fresh, modern touches. With its timeless combination of muted grays, bold accents, and signature details, the "Wet Cement" colorway is a must-have for sneakerheads, basketball fans, and style-conscious individuals alike.

products.title: Air Jordan 4 "Bred Reimagined"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 "Bred Reimagined" is an iconic and original colorway of the fourth Air Jordan sneaker that replicates the model’s original design. The “Bred Reimagined” was released by Jordan Brand in February 2024 to celebrate the legendary Jordan 4’s 35th anniversary. Dressed in the same color block as the original version from 1989, the “Bred Reimagined” mimics the look of the OG Jordan 4 “Bred” with accurate-to-original panels, colors, and overall shape. However, the design does differ from the original “Bred” Air Jordan 4 by featuring a tumbled leather upper instead of the OG’s nubuck construction. products.title: Air Jordan 4 "A Ma Maniére - Violet Ore"
products.description: The A Ma Maniére x Air Jordan 4 “Violet Ore” is a collaboration between the upscale clothing and sneaker boutique and Jordan Brand on Michael Jordan’s fourth signature shoe. Over the last few years, A Ma Maniére has been one of the most influential and highly regarded sneaker collaborators in the footwear industry. Headed up by James Whitner, the high end boutique brings a luxury approach to design with its projects with Jordan. On the “Violet Ore,” A Ma Maniére updates the Jordan 4 with a pale purple nubuck upper with tonal netting on the tongue and mid-panel. products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Midnight Navy” is a colorway of Michael Jordan’s fourth signature shoe inspired by the model’s iconic “White Cement” style. The “Midnight Navy” replicates the color scheme of the Jordan 4 “White Cement,” but replaces the shoe’s red accents with navy. The upper is constructed from white leather, save for the tongue and mid-panel which feature tonal mesh detailing. Midnight Navy plastic lace holders are found on the throat and collar. The Jordan 4’s signature “Cement” detailing appears on the “Wings” tabs, on the mudguard, and on the Jumpman and “Air” branded heel counter. A visible Air unit in the heel completes the design. Release date: October 29, 2022

The “Red Cement” features red-based cement detailing while the “White Cement” has grey cement patterning. products.title: Air Jordan 4 "Black Canvas"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “Black Canvas” is a stealthy, mostly monochromatic colorway of the retro basketball shoe. products.title: Air Jordan 4 "White Thunder"
products.description: The Air Jordan 4 “White Thunder” is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe that draws favorably to a popular style in the Jordan 4’s line. The shoe we’re referring to is the Jordan 4’s “Thunder” colorway from 2006’s “Thunder & Lightning” pack that was released in limited quantities exclusively on Jumpman23.com, Jordan Brand’s former website. products.title: Air Jordan 4 "Rare Air- White Lettering"

The full-length Air-sole unit and carbon fiber shank plate provide the performance DNA made famous in 1996. It is a sophisticated, high-energy masterpiece that honors the legacy of North Carolina in a sleek and iconic low-top frame.

products.title: Air Jordan 11 Retro Low "Nightshade"

products.description: The Air Jordan 11 Low IE gets a blacked-out colorway, perfect for any referee that happens to be an Air Jordan sneaker fan. A summer 2015 release.

products.title: Air Jordan 11 Retro Low "Bred (2025)"
products.description: The Air Jordan 11 Low "Bred" is a low-top, black and red colorway of Michael Jordan's 11th signature shoe. The 2025 edition of the AJ11 Low "Bred" stays true to the original design. It has a black mesh upper that is accented with the Jordan 11's signature patent leather mudguard and a transluscent red outsole.

products.description: Light bone/university red recycled rubber Air Jordan 11 Retro Low "Light Bone" sneakers from Nike featuring round toe, flat rubber sole, front lace-up fastening and branded insole. These styles are supplied by a premium sneaker marketplace. Stocking only the most sought-after footwear, they source and curate some of the most hard to find sneakers from around the world.

products.title: Air Jordan 11 Retro Low "Legend Blue"
products.description: The Air Jordan 11 Low “Legend Blue” is based on an original colorway of Michael Jordan’s timeless eleventh signature shoe. Originally known as the “Columbia” Jordan 11 when it was released and worn by Michael Jordan in 1996, the crisp white-and-light-blue colorway is actually a “UNC” inspired design, sans any official naming by Nike or Jordan. In 2014, the “Columbia” was repackaged as the “Legend Blue,” though the design shares many similarities with the OG look. Here, this Spring 2021 version of the “Legend Blue” is dressed in crisp white leather with a white patent leather mudguard. A white mesh tongue, with Legend Blue “Jumpman Jordan” insignia contrasts the look of the black liner. Of no

products.title: Air Jordan 11 Retro Low "Easter Emerald"
products.description: Inspired by the colors of spring, the Air Jordan 11 Low "Easter/Emerald" features a crisp white leather upper with the signature patent leather mudguard rendered in an iridescent green tone. The green patent leather plays well off of the icy blue outsole. Originally created as a basketball sneaker that could be worn with a tuxedo, this Air Jordan 11 certainly deserves a place in any "Easter best" outfit.

products.title: Air Jordan 11 Retro Low "RE2PECT"
products.description: In 2017 Jordan Brand created the Air Jordan 11 “RE2PECT” to honor the retirement of legendary New York Yankee Derek Jeter. Only five pairs were released, making them an extremely rare collector's item. To celebrate the one-year anniversary of the sneaker's release, Jordan Brand made an Air Jordan 11 Low “RE2PECT.” The low-top reproduces the original construction of the mid exactly, with a premium blue suede upper, leather laces, Jeter’s number 2 embroidered on each heel, and a translucent sole.

products.title: Air Jordan 11 Retro Low "Cool Grey"
products.description: "Cool Grey" is one of the most iconic and revered Air Jordan colors. For spring 2018, Jordan Brand released the Air Jordan 11 Low in the monochromatic hue. The updated take on the classic look is an ideal sneaker for the warmer months. The low top replicates the color and materials of the original Air Jordan 11 “Cool Grey” precisely, with a grey nubuck base, a grey patent leather mudguard, and a translucent sole.

products.title: Air Jordan 11 Retro Low "Cherry"
products.description: The Air Jordan 11 Low “Cherry” is the 2016 re-release of the colorway that debuted on the retro basketball shoe in 2001. The original Jordan 11 Low “Cherry” was released as part of the “Retro+” collection of lifestyle-inspired Air Jordan colorways before it returned in 2016. The OG “Cherry” was one of the first non-original Air Jordan 11 colorways and Air Jordan 11 Low releases. True to the original, the 2016 edition of the “Cherry” features a white mesh upper with tonal nylon overlays. A Varsity Red patent leather mudguard contrasts the neutral appearance of the upper. Small red Jumpman branding appears on the white mesh tongue. The Air Jordan 11 Low “Cherry” inspired the Air Jordan 11 “Che

products.title: Air Jordan 11 Retro Low "Concord Bred"
products.description: The Air Jordan 11 Low “Concord Bred” is a Summer 2020 release that combines two iconic looks for the model and trims them down into low-top form. Certainly one of the most sought-after silhouettes in sneaker history, the Air Jordan 11 was worn by Michael Jordan during perhaps his greatest season in the NBA in 1995-96. Here, Jordan Brand opts for a luxurious black patent leather mudguard that wraps around the entire shoe. White leather covers the mid-panel and collar that makes the colorway reminiscent of the iconic "Concord" edition. products.title: Air Jordan 11 Retro Low "Closing Ceremony"
products.description: To celebrate the 2016 Summer Olympics in Rio Jordan Brand release of the Air Jordan 11 Retro Low "Closing Ceremony." The sneaker features a Gold medal-inspired mix of White leather, Metallic-Gold patent leather mudguard sitting on an icy out-sole.

products.title: Air Jordan 11 Retro Low "Navy/Gum"
products.description: In the early 2000s, Jordan Brand introduced a topless take on the iconic AJ11. Since the Air Jordan 11 Lows debut, it has been seen in many colors and variations. This color way sees the model dipped Navy for the upper, White midsole and a Gum bottom.

products.title: Air Jordan 11 Retro Low "Cobalt"
products.description: Easily one of the most obscure and underrated original Air Jordan colorways ever, the “Cobalt” Air Jordan IE Low has remained a cult-classic, even after its return in 2015. Don’t sleep on them any longer.

products.title: Air Jordan 11 Retro Low "Barons"
products.description: The “Barons” motif, inspired by Michael Jordan’s minor league baseball stint with the Birmingham Barons, returns to a classic Air Jordan silhouette in 2017. This time, an Air Jordan 11 Retro Low adopts a clean black and white colorway. Areas of the upper that are traditionally Cordura mesh appear in a buttery Black suede on this version. The patent leather mudguard, also black, features a marbled black and silver finish. The usual Jumpan branding can be found on the tongue and heel, along with the familiar “23” logo. A white midsole and an icy translucent outsole complete the slick design.

products.title: Air Jordan 11 Retro Low "Concord"
products.description: The world famous Air Jordan 11 “Concord” colorway of the Air Jordan 11 got transformed into the low-top silhouette for this 2014 release. The most anticipated Air Jordan 11 Low ever when it released, it’s now most sought after version of the shoe, as well.

products.title: Air Jordan 11 Retro Low "Infrared"
products.description: The low-top version of the Air Jordan 11 gets dressed in a sleek black upper with a speckled grey heel panel and hits of vibrant Infrared on the branding and outsole for one of the silhouette’s most unique color blocks ever.

products.title: Air Jordan 11 Retro Low "Georgetown"
products.description: The Air Jordan 11 Low received this familiar Georgetown Hoyas colorway with a grey ballistic nylon base and navy patent leather paneling for yet another excellent edition of the low-top version of the iconic basketball shoe.
