products.description: The famous “Bred” colorway of the Air Jordan 11 in the shoe’s low-top form. This colorway was spotted on Michael Jordan’s own feet as a PE edition way back in 1996 and remained at an almost legendary status until they finally dropped at retail in summer 2015.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "Black University Blue (2026)"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 "University Blue" brings a refreshing collegiate energy to the rugged silhouette Michael Jordan wore in 1990. Featuring a premium nubuck upper in vibrant "University Blue," this release is accented by a silver reflective tongue and a classic shark-tooth midsole. The "Team Jordan" patch on the heel celebrates the spirit of North Carolina heritage. It is a sophisticated, high-energy masterpiece that blends elite basketball performance with a timeless, high-contrast colorway for the modern era.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "Wolf Grey (2026)"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 "Wolf Grey" delivers a clean, neutral aesthetic to Tinker Hatfield’s fighter-plane-inspired design. Featuring a premium nubuck upper in a versatile "Wolf Grey" finish, this release is highlighted by a signature silver 3M reflective tongue. The shark-tooth midsole and translucent icy outsole stay true to the 1990 original, providing a sophisticated look for the street. It is a refined, high-energy masterpiece that offers legendary comfort and a timeless, low-profile colorway for any elite collection.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "Paris Saint-Germain"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 "Paris Saint-Germain" continues the iconic partnership between the Jumpman and the legendary French football club. This edition features a sophisticated tonal colorway inspired by the city of light, complete with "PARIS" branding behind the signature side mesh. The PSG crest and "Ici C'est Paris" slogans on the insole and heel celebrate the passion of the Parc des Princes. Combining premium materials with classic AJ5 details like the lace toggles and shark-tooth midsole, it’s a global streetwear essential.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "White Metallic (2026)"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 "White Metallic" delivers a crisp, high-contrast aesthetic to the fighter-plane-inspired 1990 classic. Featuring a premium white leather upper with shimmering metallic silver accents on the shark-tooth midsole, this release captures a sophisticated, space-age look. The signature 3M reflective tongue and translucent icy outsole remain as authentic AJ5 details. It is a refined, high-energy masterpiece that offers legendary comfort and a clean, timeless palette, making it a versatile essential for any high-end rotation.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "Awake NY - Racer Blue"
products.description: Step into a unique collaboration with the Air Jordan 5 "Awake NY Black." This remarkable sneaker, a partnership with Awake NY, features a sleek all-black design with subtle, distinctive details. Experience legendary comfort and a bold aesthetic, perfect for making a statement with an exclusive edge.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "Awake NY - Bubblegum Pink"
products.description: Lace up a truly special collaboration with the Air Jordan 5 "Awake NY Arctic Pink." This remarkable sneaker, a result of the Awake NY partnership, features a vibrant pink design with subtle, distinctive details. Experience superior cushioning and a bold aesthetic, perfect for making a statement with an exclusive and colorful edge.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "Fire Red - Black Tongue (2025)"
products.description: For a sneaker that truly stands out, check out the Air Jordan 5 "Fire Red / Black Tongue." This memorable design showcases its signature details in a clean white and rich red palette, with the legendary black tongue as a focal point. It delivers a supportive fit and a dynamic aesthetic, making it a valuable addition for any collector.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "Tokyo (2025)"
products.description: Unleash an exclusive masterpiece with the Air Jordan 5 "Tokyo". This striking sneaker features a bright, unique colorway and premium materials inspired by the vibrant energy of the city. Enjoy superb Air cushioning and a design that's perfect for making a powerful statement with a nod to global street style.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "A Ma Maniére - Violet Ore"
products.description: A fusion of iconic design and thoughtful storytelling, the A Ma Maniére x Air Jordan 5 "Violet Ore" continues a celebrated partnership. This collaboration elevates the classic AJ5 silhouette with premium materials and subtle branding, reflecting A Ma Maniére's dedication to craftsmanship and community narratives within sneaker culture.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "Luminous Green"
products.description: Illuminate your look with the vibrant women's Air Jordan 5 "Luminous Green." The clean Sail upper provides a perfect backdrop for the striking Luminous Green accents on the shark teeth, Jumpman logos, and lace lock. This bold colorway, combined with the AJ5's distinctive design elements, creates a head-turning and stylish sneaker statement.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "El Grito"
products.description: Air Jordan 5 HF8833 100

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "A Ma Maniére- Black"
products.description: The A Ma Maniére x Air Jordan 5 SP "Black" is a collaboration by James Whitner’s boutique on a colorway of Michael Jordan’s fifth signature shoe with vintage details. Since the late 2010s, A Ma Maniére has been one of the most successful collaborators in the sneaker space, having worked with Jordan Brand on several now-classic Jordan sneakers on multiple occasions. As for the design of this shoe, the upper features a black nubuck construction with pre-aged netting on the tongue and mid-panel designed in an “A” pattern after A Ma Maniére’s logo. The retailer’s branding can also be found on the “A” logo on the silver reflective tongue of the left shoe while a black Jumpman is embroidered on th

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "Midnight Navy"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Midnight Navy” is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe loosely inspired by the Georgetown Hoyas college basketball team. While not affiliated with the Hoyas, the “Midnight Navy” updates Michael Jordan’s fifth signature shoe with a dark navy blue textile upper with suede on the heel, collar, and toe panels. Smoky translucent netting appears on the side and tongue. A black Jumpman is embroidered on the heel and textile tongue. Navy shark tooth detailing with white speckling on the light grey midsole sits above the solid navy and translucent outsole. Release date: November 10, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "Burgundy 2023"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Burgundy 2023” is the modern re-release of the non-original colorway of the retro basketball shoe that debuted in 2006. Once part of Jordan Brand’s “LS” or “lifestyle” collection, the Jordan 5 “Burgundy” was one of the model’s first non-original colorways, and one of its most popular releases of the 2000s. The modern edition is nearly identical to the original 2006 release. Deep Burgundy suede appears on the shoe’s upper. Translucent netting is found on the mid-panel and on the tongue. A Deep Burgundy Jumpman appears on the silver reflective tongue and a silver Jumpman is embroidered on the heel. Light Graphite shark tooth detailing is found on the burgundy painted midsole.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "Aqua"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Aqua” is a colorway of Michael Jordan’s fifth signature shoe in a look loosely inspired by a Player Exclusive of the shoe for Chris Paul in his time with the New Orleans Hornets. The “Aqua” features a black synthetic nubuck construction with translucent netting on the sides and tongue. An Aqua-colored Jumpman is embroidered on the Metallic Silver reflective tongue and on the heel. Additional Aqua accenting can be found on the Jumpman on the lace toggle, on the inner lining, and on the shark tooth detailing on the midsole. The design replicates Paul’s never released colorway of the shoe, sans his number “3” embroidered on each heel. Release date: April 8, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "Craft"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Craft” is a modified version of the retro basketball shoe made from an interesting combination of materials that give it a lifestyle-focused design. Part of a greater collection of “Craft” sneakers, the Jordan 5 Craft features a Taupe-colored suede and textile construction with translucent netting on the mid-panel and tongue. An orange textile on the underside of the tongue matches the embroidered orange Jumpman on the tongue’s front. Tonal Jumpman detailing is also found on the heel. Underfoot, grey shark tooth detailing with white speckling and an icy blue translucent outsole round out the premium look. Release date: June 17, 2023

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "Island Green"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 “Island Green” is inspired by the warm, tropical vibes of island beaches with its light green accents. Michael Jordan’s fifth signature Nike basketball shoe features a premium white leather constructed upper with glossy tonal cheetah spots printed into the design. Soothing Island Green eyelets and netting on the mid-panel and tongue contrasts the sleek upper. An embroidered light green Jumpman covers the heel with black laces and a clear lace lock adding the finishing touches to the upper. The midsole goes all black with white speckled "teeth" detailing, and the translucent rubber portions of the outsole also feature the tropical green hue. Release date: November 11, 2019.

products.title: Air Jordan 5 "White/Black"
products.description: The Air Jordan 5 "White/Black" is a monochrome iteration of the classic Air Jordan silhouette that originally came out in 1990. The iconic design elements of the Jordan 5 such as the metallic tongue, lace toggle, translucent outsole, and fighter plane-inspired elements on the midsole, look incredibly sleek and clean in this "White/Black" colorway.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "White/Infrared - Infrared Pack"
products.description: From the Air Jordan 6 Infrared Pack of 2010 featuring both the original and iconic black and white colorways of the shoe accented with the famous neon red hue. This listing is for the White/Infrared colorway only, allowing you to grab the shoe that Michael Jordan wore for most of the 1990-91 regular season by itself. Worn by Jordan on the way to his first NBA Championship with the Chicago Bulls, the White/Infrared Air Jordan 6 is an essential piece in any Air Jordan collection.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "Oreo"
products.description: Indulge in a sweet classic with the Air Jordan 6 "Oreo." Returning for the first time since 2010, this highly anticipated retro pairs a smooth black nubuck base with premium white leather overlays for a stark, two-tone look. The iconic cookie-themed design comes alive with striking black and white speckled detailing on the midsole, spoiler-like heel tab, and lace lock. Complete with visible Air cushioning and an icy translucent outsole, it delivers championship-level style and comfort.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "Cap & Gown"
products.description: The Air Jordan 6 "Cap & Gown" delivers a luxurious, formal-ready aesthetic to the silhouette Michael Jordan wore for his first championship. Featuring an all-black palette with premium patent leather and suede, this special edition is designed for life’s milestone moments. The smoke-tinted outsole and tonal branding provide a sophisticated, high-fashion look that bridges the gap between the court and the red carpet. It is a powerful, elite masterpiece that celebrates excellence, success, and the honor of graduation.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "A Ma Maniére - Smokey Mauve"
products.description: The Air Jordan 6 Retro "A Ma Maniére - Smokey Mauve" continues James Whitner’s mission of luxury storytelling. This collaboration features a premium suede upper in a sophisticated "Smokey Mauve" hue, accented by black and sail details for a refined, vintage look. The signature AMM branding appears on the heel and lace toggles, elevating the 1991 classic into a high-fashion staple. It is a timeless, soulful masterpiece that celebrates the intersection of community, luxury, and the legendary heritage of the Jumpman.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "Florida Gator PE"
products.description: The Air Jordan 6 “Florida Gators PE” is a Player Exclusive colorway of the sixth Air Jordan that was made exclusively for the Florida Gators athletic department. An unreleased shoe, the Jordan 6 “Florida Gators PE” features a blue suede upper with a slightly faded treatment. The Gators’ signature logo is embroidered on the back of the shoe while a chenille Jumpman appears on the left tongue and a chenille “23” patch is seen on the right tongue. Underfoot, the Sail midsole is contrasted with orange panels around the visible Air bubble on the forefoot and heel.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "Bin23"
products.description: Emerging from the deepest corners of the Jordan vault, the Air Jordan 6 "BIN23" Sample reimagines the pinnacle of the Premio Series with a dark, cinematic edge. While the original retail release leaned into a lighter palette, this 2026 edition commands attention with a Triple Black aesthetic, utilizing high-grade matte leather and buttery nubuck that feels as substantial as it looks. The silhouette’s 1991 performance DNA is elevated to a collector’s masterpiece through the signature red wax seal on the heel—a mark of artisanal exclusivity. Sharp Infrared accents strike through the midsole and heel tab, providing a bold contrast that honors the "Infrared" heritage while maintaining a stealthy

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "Infrared Salesman (2026)"
products.description: Unlock a legendary piece of sneaker history with the Air Jordan 6 Retro "Reverse Infrared" (2026). Originally seen as an elusive "Salesman Sample" in a 1999 catalog, this vaulted colorway finally makes its retail debut to celebrate the silhouette's 35th anniversary. The design features a premium black nubuck upper contrasted by an extended Light Crimson midsole that flows across the entire sidewall. True to its "Salesman" roots, the shoe includes a factory-inspired hangtag and an inner collar "Not For Resale" stamp, offering a powerful blend of archival mystery and modern elite performance.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "Quai 54"
products.description: The Air Jordan 6 “Quai 54” is one of two colorways released by Jordan Brand in 2020 that coincides with the annual streetball tournament in Paris, France. Both colorways of Michael Jordan’s beloved sixth signature shoe display a Sail leather base with patterned textile underlaid panels on either side. This version features an orange and maroon multidirectional motif within the aforementioned design found on the mid-panel. Brown embroidered Jumpman branding can be found on the cream colored nylon overlay on the tongue. The red lace toggle features a white Jumpman logo and co-branded “Nike Air” and “Quai 54” embroidery graces the left and right heel, respectively. Release date: August 8, 2020.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "Pearl"
products.description: Air Jordan 6 HF0414 074

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "Yellow Ochre"
products.description: The Air Jordan 6 "Yellow Ochre" is a colorway of Michael Jordan’s sixth signature shoe with a white-and-yellow color scheme. Featuring the reconizable color block of the original “Carmine” Air Jordan 6, this “Yellow Ochre” colorway replaces all of the red accents with an earth tone shade of yellow. The yellow hue in question is found on the synthetic nubuck base of the shoe, along with white leather overlays and black detailing throughout. The Jordan 6’s signature icy translucent rubber outsole and visible Air unit in the heel complete the design. Release date: January 27, 2024

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "Aqua"
products.description: The Air Jordan 6 "Aqua" is a colorway of Michael Jordan’s sixth signature shoe inspired by an iconic Air Jordan design. The shoe in question is the Air Jordan 8 “Aqua,” an original colorway of the retro basketball sneaker that was worn by Jordan during the 1993 NBA All-Star Game. Jordan Brand transfers the Jordan 8 “Aqua’s” color scheme onto the Jordan 6 by featuring the shoe’s Bright Concord and Aquatone accents on the midsole. The upper features a black synthetic nubuck construction with tonal overlays. A Bright Concord Jumpman is embroidered on the tongue while a teal Jumpman is seen on the purple lace toggle. On the back of the shoe, a black spoiler with Aqua accents completes the look.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "Cool Grey"
products.description: The Air Jordan 6 “Cool Grey” is a versatile, neutral colorway of Michael Jordan’s sixth signature shoe. The “Cool Grey” color story debuted in the early 2000s on the Air Jordan 11 before appearing on other classic Jordan sneakers like the Air Jordan 3, Air Jordan 4, and now the Air Jordan 6. The shoe features a Cool Grey synthetic nubuck base with white tumbled leather overlays throughout the design. A Cool Grey Jumpman is embroidered on the heel. Additional grey accenting can be found on the shoe’s plastic tongue spoiler and neoprene lace overlay with Jumpman branding. Icy blue translucent panels surround the Air units in the forefoot and heel of the white foam midsole. Release date: April

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "Georgetown"
products.description: The Air Jordan 6 “Georgetown” is a clean colorway of Michael Jordan’s sixth signature shoe inspired by the Georgetown Hoyas team uniforms. Although Jordan and the UNC Tar Heels defeated the Hoyas to win the NCAA Men’s College Basketball Championship in 1982, that hasn’t stopped Jordan Brand from using the popular basketball team’s uniform colors on several great Jordan shoes, including this Jordan 6. The upper features a grey suede construction with contrasting Midnight Navy accenting on the heel “spoiler,” lace toggle, and on the Jumpman on the back of the shoe. Additional navy detailing appears on the painted mudguard above the semi-translucent panel on the forefoot and heel of the midsole

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "Chinese New Year"
products.description: The Air Jordan 6 Low “Chinese New Year 2022” is a special release of Michael Jordan’s sixth signature shoe in a colorway dedicated to the cultural holiday. Released in early 2022, the “Chinese New Year 2022” edition of the Jordan 6 Low celebrates Lunar New Year, a holiday observed in Asia and all over the world that honors the beginning of a new calendar year. The shoe features a white leather upper with Metallic Gold accents on the spoiler on the heel, the midsole, and the Jumpman branding found on the heel and on the neoprene tongue overlay. A gold Jumpman appears on the lace toggle. Underfoot, an icy translucent panel surrounds the visible Air unit in the heel to complete the look.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "PSG - Paris Saint Germain"
products.description: The Paris Saint Germain x Air Jordan 6 “Iron Grey” is the next chapter of the continued partnership between Jordan Brand and the French soccer club. The inspiration behind this PSG x Air Jordan collaboration comes from none other than the iconic Air Jordan 6 “Carmine.” Lifting the color block of the original “Carmines,” the PSG version is comprised of contrasting black suede overlays and an Iron Grey base. An Iron Grey tongue, Jumpman logo, and black laces sit atop matching hues on the midsole, while bright Infrared accents and a smoky translucent outsole complete the clean look. The design also sports special collaborative branding on the heel and insole, and adds a label with “Paname,” the

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "Reflections of a Champion"
products.description: The Air Jordan 6 “Reflections of a Champion” is a special reflective edition of the iconic model. The flashy colorway is part of the “Reflections on a Champion” pack, which celebrates Michael Jordan’s first three NBA Championships with the Chicago Bulls with reflective editions of the three shoes he wore during the seasons leading up to his first “3-Peat.” Jordan’s first title in 1991 is represented by this Air Jordan 6 featuring a reflective silver upper with accents mirroring the iconic “Infrared” colorway in black and neon red. Original “Nike Air” branding embroidered on each heel completes the striking look. The Air Jordan 6 “Reflections of a Champion” released on June 8, 2019.

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "Quai 54 - Purple"
products.description: The Air Jordan 6 “Quai 54 - Purple” was released by Jordan Brand in 2020 to coincide with the annual streetball tournament in Paris, France. One of two “Quai 54” colorways of Michael Jordan’s sixth signature shoe, this design displays a Sail leather base with underlying patterned textile panels with purple, orange, and black accenting on either side. Black embroidered Jumpman branding can be found on the purple nylon overlay on the tongue. Jordan Brand opts for a purple lace toggle with mini black Jumpman detailing and co-branded “Nike Air” and “Quai 54” embroidery on the left and right heel, respectively. A clear Air unit is encased within the heel for a timeless appearance. Release date: J

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "Reverse Oreo"
products.description: The Air Jordan 6 “Reverse Oreo” is a colorway of Michael Jordan’s sixth signature shoe in the popular, cookie-inspired theme. The “Oreo” colorway was introduced on the Air Jordan 4 in 1999, and has been used on countless Air Jordan models over the years, including on the Jordan 6. The upper features a white leather design with tonal overlays and perforations for breathability on the sides and collar. The tongue and Jumpman logos on the tongue and heel appear in black, while the midsole and heel spoiler feature black-and-white speckle detailing in an “Oreo” inspired design. An icy blue translucent outsole completes the look. Release date: June 8, 2024

products.title: Air Jordan 6 "Olympic"
products.description: Step into an emblem of winning heritage with the Air Jordan 6 "Olympic." This remarkable shoe offers a powerful blend of classic design and celebratory appeal, highlighted by its striking red, white, and blue accents. It's a stylish and comfortable option for any fan who desires a fresh, standout look with a triumphant aura.

products.title: Air Force 1 Low "Puerto Rico"
products.description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low “Puerto Rico” is an early 2000s colorway that shows love to the Caribbean island. Nike re-released the “Puerto Rico” makeup of the low-top shoe in June 2020 to much fanfare and excitement. One of the most sought-after Air Force 1 of the aughts, the “Puerto Rico” seen here features several true-to-original styling points, including an embroidered Puerto Rican flag on the heel and printed flag motif on the tongue tag. White leather forms the base of the upper and can be found on the perforated toe and on the tonal Swoosh branding on either side of the shoe. The navy blue leather heel tab features contrasting red “Nike Air” embroidery, a look that references the colors

products.title: Air Force 1 Low "A Ma Maniére - White"
products.description: Elevate your luxury street style with the A Ma Maniére x Nike Air Force 1 Low "White". Crafted with a premium white tumbled leather upper, this refined silhouette reimagines the classic model with elevated details, including signature "A" toe box perforations and a double-stacked Swoosh. Inside, a padded jacquard monogram lining provides supreme comfort, while debossed A Ma Maniére branding along the midsole and a translucent outsole complete this minimalist masterpiece.

products.title: Air Force 1 Low "Los Angeles"
products.description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low “Los Angeles” is a colorway of the classic sneaker from the “Nike Coast” collection that debuted in 2023. Representing Los Angeles to the fullest, this Air Force 1 Low features a mixture of materials that brings out the best in the iconic silhouette. A canvas-like denim textile is featured on the Diffused Blue upper. A tonal leather Swoosh is found on the sides. An “LA” logo is stitched onto the lateral side of the heel. A removable “Nike Coast” pendant is found on the laces. The satin quilted inner lining gives the shoe a decidedly luxurious feel. Release date: June 7, 2023

products.description: Air Force 1 488298 412

products.title: Air Force 1 Low "A-Cold-Wall White"
products.description: The A-COLD-WALL x Nike Air Force 1 Low “White” is a limited edition collaboration by British designer Samuel Ross on the iconic silhouette. A-COLD-WALL’s high-end streetwear aesthetic is applied to the Air Force 1, which features a minimalist construction with a stitchless upper built with Nike’s Flyleather, a material that blends recycled leather and textile and maintains the look and feel of premium leather. The shoe also has a modified lacing system with eyelets only at the top and bottom of the eyestay panel that result in a crossed treatment for the laces. The Swooshes are perforated, while “ACW” branding is applied to the midfoot area and tongue. Also released in a black iteration, the

products.title: Air Force 1 Low "Alter and Reveal"
products.description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low “Alter and Reveal” is a “do-it-yourself” inspired look that brings a customizable elements to the retro basketball shoe. As its name suggests, the “Alter and Reveal” Air Force 1 Low intrigues with hidden details that are only revealed when altering the design. Both the toe and mid-panel feature a cut-away mesh construction that displays a hidden layer beneath. The rest of the shoe’s construction features different materials, including black suede on the forefoot and pebbled Gym Red leather on the quarter panel. A glossy black leather Swoosh is located on either side of the shoe and a small red Swoosh is embroidered on the lateral side of the forefoot. Classic “Nike A

products.title: Air Force 1 Low "Terror Squad - University Red"
products.description: The Air Force 1 Low "Terror Squad - University Red" celebrates the deep-rooted connection between Fat Joe’s legendary crew and NYC sneaker culture. Dressed in a bold White and University Red palette, this release features the iconic "TS" logo embroidered on the heel. The premium leather construction and classic silhouette pay homage to the era of hip-hop street dominance and exclusive PE colorways. It is a powerful, nostalgic statement piece that honors a true pioneer of the sneaker game and the Bronx.

products.title: Air Force 1 Low "Cracked Leather Pack - Black / White"
Air Force 1 Low "Skeleton - Black"
products.description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low “Skeleton - Black” is a spooky rendition of the venerable low-top design. The “Skeleton” Air Force 1 in black is a follow up to the popular all-white leather colorway that was released a year earlier to celebrate Halloween in 2018. Here, the “Skeleton” Air Force 1 features the same festive glow-in-the-dark Halloween vibe with a graphic of the bones of the foot adorning the sides of the upper. Sporting a nighttime-appropriate black leather base, the stealthy upper features a tonal Swoosh that sits underneath the anatomic design. The same skeleton theme also appears on the insoles with a glow-in-the-dark outsole completing the look of the shoe. Release date: October 25

products.title: Air Force 1 Low "Geometric Print"
products.description: With the Nike Air Force 1 '07 "Geometric Print," small tweaks are made to refresh the iconic silhouette. Most of the shoe sports a clean white leather upper, complemented by leather overlays, tonal white stitching and perforations at the toe box. Exploring a new print, a black and white geometric pattern is displayed on the Nike Swoosh, tongue tab, and portions of the inner lining. At the heel tab is the same pattern marked with “NIKE” branding. Underfoot, a clean white sole with its “AIR” branding painted black completes the look.

products.title: Air Force 1 Low "Dusty Olive Canvas"
products.description: Refresh your daily sneaker rotation with the NIKE Air Force 1 Low "Dusty Olive Canvas". Swapping traditional leather for a tactical feel, this iconic silhouette features a rich Dusty Olive canvas upper complemented by soft Olive Aura accents and layered Hemp Swooshes. Anchored by a clean Phantom midsole housing encapsulated Air cushioning, it offers classic court inspired comfort with an earthy, modern twist perfect for elevating any casual ensemble.

products.title: Air Force 1 Low "Scream Ghostface"
products.description: Channel your inner horror enthusiast with the NIKE Air Force 1 Low "Scream Ghostface". This cinematic sneaker features a summit white leather upper accented by menacing black comic book outlines, metallic silver details, and stark gym red hits that pay homage to slasher history. Complete with classic Air cushioned comfort and legendary court style, it is a thrilling, collectible must have for movie fans and sneakerheads alike.

products.colorway: Kobe Bryant Forever Black Purple Stardust
products.title: Air Force 1 Low "Kobe Bryant Forever Black Purple Stardust"
products.description: Honor the legacy of an icon with the Air Force 1 Low "Kobe Bryant Forever Black Purple Stardust". Blending classic court heritage with Black Mamba details, this release features a textured black upper accented by soft Purple Stardust hits on the lining, tongue branding, and outsole. Finished with Kobe's sheath logo and metallic "Mamba Forever" dubraes, this pair seamlessly delivers timeless style and legendary identity.

products.title: Air Force 1 Low "Technicolor Tale Orange Pony Hair"
products.description: Make a bold statement with the NIKE Air Force 1 Low "Technicolor Tale Orange Pony Hair". Featuring a vibrant Campfire Orange and Sunset pony hair upper, this tactile sneaker reimagines an iconic classic with rich, plush texture. Contrast piping accents the Swoosh and overlays, resting atop a clean white midsole and durable rubber outsole. Encapsulated Air cushioning guarantees all day comfort, delivering a standout, luxurious look for true streetwear connoisseurs.

products.title: Air Force 1 Low "Kobe Bryant Forever White/Armory Blue"
products.description: Channel the Mamba mentality with the Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever White/Armory Blue. Paying homage to the legendary basketball icon, this special-edition silhouette elevates Bruce Kilgore’s 1982 classic with a subtle all-over snakeskin-textured upper. A clean white base is beautifully contrasted by serene armory blue accents on the lining, heel emblem, and Kobe’s numbers 8 and 24 embroidered on the heels. The homage is completed with exclusive Mamba Forever lace dubraes and signature sheath branding on the tongue.

products.title: Air Force 1 Low "Ja Morant Pearlescent White"
products.description: The Ja Morant x Nike Air Force 1 Low "Pearlescent White" reimagines the iconic basketball silhouette with an iridescent, high-shine aesthetic. Featuring a smooth leather upper treated with a shimmering pearlescent finish, this iteration shifts in light for an eye-catching look. Heavy-duty rope laces and signature "12:AM" branding on the heel tab celebrate Morant's personal style, while encapsulated Air cushioning delivers classic comfort with bold street appeal.

products.title: Air Force 1 Low "Victor Solomon Trophies"
products.description: Step into a masterclass of luxury with the Nike Air Force 1 Low Victor Solomon Trophies. Created in partnership with contemporary artist Victor Solomon for WNBA All-Star Weekend, this premium edition elevates the basketball icon into a fine art statement. It features a stealthy, multi-textured all-black upper crafted from pebbled leather, smooth leather, and textile panels. Striking metallic gold details evoke championship hardware, highlighted by a raised embossed Swoosh, chain-link laces, and basketball-shaped lace locks.

products.title: Air Force 1 Low "Reflective Woodland Camo"
products.description: Air Force 1 '07 LV8 718152 203

products.title: Air Force 1 Low "Black Metallic Dark Grey Croc"
products.description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low "Black Metallic Dark Grey Croc" reimagines the iconic basketball sneaker with a luxurious texture upgrade. Featuring a sleek, triple-black upper, the design stands out with a striking crocodile-embossed leather finish complemented by Metallic Dark Grey accents. Classic perforations on the toe box enhance breathability, while encapsulated Nike Air cushioning and a durable rubber outsole deliver timeless comfort and traction for a bold, street-ready look.

products.colorway: Kobe Bryant Forever Vast Grey Electric Green
products.title: Air Force 1 Low "Kobe Bryant Forever Vast Grey Electric Green"
products.description: Honor a hardwood legend with the Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Vast Grey Electric Green. Blending timeless AF1 architecture with Mamba DNA, this special-edition sneaker features a premium leather upper covered in an all-over snakeskin print. The understated vast grey backdrop is electrified by vibrant electric green accents on the branding, while signature Kobe details celebrate his enduring legacy. Equipped with classic Air cushioning, this pair delivers standout style and ultimate street comfort.

products.title: Air Force 1 Low "Beige / Obsidian"
products.description: Step out in style with the Nike Air Force 1 Low Parachute Beige Obsidian. Updating the legendary 1982 basketball silhouette with an understated, two-tone color palette, this low-top pairs a premium parachute beige leather upper with striking obsidian blue overlays on the Swoosh and heel tab. A clean white midsole houses classic encapsulated Air cushioning for responsive, all-day comfort, while a durable rubber outsole provides reliable court-to-street traction.

Underfoot, the white rubber midsole and black rubber midsole complete the look. Release date: August 11, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Athletic Department - Deep Jungle"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low "Athletic Department - Deep Jungle" is a colorway of the retro basketball sneaker with a vintage college sports aesthetic. The upper features a Sail leather construction with a Deep Jungle-colored suede Swoosh that matches the appearance of the heel tab with “Nike” embroidery. Classic “Nike” detailing can be seen on the tongue. More Deep Jungle accenting includes a green lining, and green rubber outsole underneath the rubber midsole. A special “Nike Athletic Department” logo is found on each insole. Release date: October 1, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Black / Amber Brown"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low "Black/Amber Brown" is a versatile colorway of the classic basketball shoe with a simple and stylish look. A decidedly fall-inspired vibe, the Dunk Low “Black/Amber Brown” features a black leather upper with tonal leather overlays. An Amber Brown leather Swoosh logo appears on the mid-panel while classic “Nike” branding is embroidered on the heel. More Swoosh and “Nike” logos are seen on the tongue tag. Underfoot, a white midsole and Amber Brown-colored outsole complete the clean colorway. Release date: November 2, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Trout"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Trout” is a unique colorway of the classic basketball and lifestyle shoe inspired by the official state fish of Oregon, the home of Nike’s headquarters. A creative colorway for the Dunk Low, the “Trout” has trout-inspired detailing on the side panels. Other nods to the fish are found on the tongue tag that features a graphic of a trout, and on the insole. As for the rest of the shoe, hairy suede overlays in green appear on the upper and Scale-like Swooshes are seen on the mid-panel. An aged-looking rubber midsole gives the shoe a retro appearance. Release date: June 16, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Tweed Corduroy"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low "Tweed Corduroy" is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe that has a unique combination of materials. As its name suggests, the Dunk Low’s “Tweed Corduroy” colorway features tweed and corduroy materials on its design, giving the model a bespoke-style look. The design includes a Midnight Navy corduroy base with Ale Ivory tweed on the toe cap, forefoot, and eyelets. Pale Ivory patterned tweed is seen on the collar and heel. A brown corduroy Swoosh appears on the sides. “Nike” branding can be found on the tongue and heel. Underfoot, an aged midsole and brown outsole complete the look. Release date: November 7, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Kyler Murray - Be 1 of One"
products.description: The Kyler Murray x Nike Dunk Low "Be 1 of One" is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe co-designed by the talented football player. Inspired by positivity and inclusivity, the “Be 1 of One” Dunk Low demonstrates Nike’s commitment to promote a healthy community around its sneakers—and beyond. The collaboration with the star NFL quarterback features an olive leather base with quilted light olive-colored overlays with frayed edges. Metallic rose gold Swoosh branding is seen on both sides of the sneaker. Classic “Nike” branding is seen on the heel and tongue tag. “Be 1 of One” detailing is found on the underside of the tongue while thick rope laces appear on top of the tongue. Underfoot, a cr

products.title: Dunk Low "Light Carbon"
products.description: Dunk Low FB9109 101

products.title: Dunk Low "Smoke Grey"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low "Smoke Grey" is yet another easy-to-wear colorway of the retro sneaker. The Dunk returned in a big way in 2020 and, in the years since, has remained a staple of the brand’s seasonal footwear collections. Here, the upper features a white leather base and Smoke Grey suede overlay panels. A Smoke Grey leather Swoosh appears on either side of the shoe while classic “Nike” branding is embroidered on the heel and printed on the tongue tag. The white rubber midsole and gum rubber outsole complete the clean look. Release date: October 3, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Game Royal Navy"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low "Game Royal/Navy" is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe with different shades of blue on its design. The Dunk Low in “Game Royal” features a white leather base contrasted with Game Royal leather overlays on the toe cap, forefoot, and eyelet panels. Midnight Navy leather overlays appear on the collar and heel. A Football Grey leather Swoosh logo is seen on both sides. “Nike” branding is embroidered on the heel and printed on the tongue tag. Underfoot, a white midsole and navy outsole complete the look. Release date: November 3, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Night Sky"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low "Night Sky" is a unique colorway of the classic basketball shoe with star graphics on its design. The upper features a white leather base and Campfire Orange leather overlays. A star pattern can be found on the black leather Swoosh on the mid-panel and on the heel tab with “Nike” branding on the back of the shoe. Classic “Nike” and Swoosh logos appear on the tongue tag. A white midsole and Anthracite outsole speckled with white complete the eye-catching Dunk colorway. Release date: December 19, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "From Nike, To You - Navy"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low "From Nike To You - Navy" is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe from Nike’s Holiday 2023 footwear collection. The upper features a white leather construction with Midnight Navy leather overlays. A Pale Vanilla-colored leather Swoosh appears on either side of the shoe, while a “From Nike to You, Oregon USA” logo is found on the underside of the tongue. An embroidered “Nike” script logo appears on the heel. Underfoot, a cream midsole and navy outsole complete the look. Release date: December 13, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Stencil Swoosh"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Stencil Swoosh” is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe with layered Swooshes. The “Stencil Swoosh” Dunk Low features a white leather base that’s contrasted with Cool Grey leather overlays and spray painted-style Swooshes in black and grey on the side. Classic “Nike” branding is seen on the heel and alongside a Swoosh on the tongue tag. Underfoot, the shoe’s white rubber midsole and black rubber outsole round out the look. Release date: December 21, 2021

products.title: Dunk Low "Fir"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low "Fir" is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe with a unique color scheme. The Dunk Low at hand features a white leather base and Fir, or green, leather overlays. A Midnight Navy leather Swoosh appears on both sides, while “Nike” branding is embroidered on the heel in yellow. Additional “Nike” detailing can be found on the tongue along with a Swoosh logo. Underfoot, a white midsole and navy outsole complete the look. Release date: December 5, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Mystic Red"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low "Mystic Red" is a red-and-green colorway of the lifestyle shoe. Getting comparisons to the colors found on horror movie icon Freddie Kruger’s signature sweater, the “Mystic Red” features the Dunk’s classic two-tone color block in shades of dark green and red across its leather base. The olive green, or “Cargo Khaki” as Nike calls it, hue is also seen on the “Nike” and Swoosh logos on the tongue tag. Release date: August 12, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Fragment Design - Clot"
products.description: The Fragment x Clot x Nike Dunk Low “White/Black” is a three-way collaboration between Hiroshi Fujiwara and Edison Chen’s clothing brands and Nike on a colorway of the vintage basketball shoe with a tear-away design. Fujiwara’s Fragment Design and Chen’s Clot clothing brands team up to give the Dunk Low one of its most unique colorways yet on the “White/Black.” The shoe features a silky white fabric across the upper that can be worn away or cut off to reveal a hidden pattern underneath. Contrasting the look are black leather eyelets, a black nylon tongue, and black inner lining. “Clot” and “FRGMT” branding are embroidered on the back of the left and right shoe, respectively. Release date: Ma

products.title: Dunk Low "CLOT - What The"
products.description: The CLOT x Nike Dunk Low "What The" is a collaboration between Edison Chen’s streetwear brand and Nike on a colorway of the retro basketball shoe that celebrates the pair’s collaborative history. Since 2006, CLOT and Nike have collaborated on numerous occasions, including on the Air Max 1 and the Air Force 1. The pair’s “What The” Dunk features elements from each previous collaboration. Various materials and colors appear in a mismatched design across the left and right shoe. “CLOT” branding is seen on the back of both shoes. Release date: July 29, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Light Carbon"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low SE “Light Carbon” is a grey-based colorway of the retro basketball shoe. Ideal for casual wear, the “Light Carbon” Dunk Low is one of the most versatile Dunk colorways. The upper features a white leather base construction with Platinum Tint leather overlay panels and a Light Carbon suede Swoosh on either side. A Light Carbon “Nike” logo is embroidered on the heel and “Nike” and Swoosh logos are found on the tongue tag. Underfoot, a white midsole and translucent grey outsole complete the look of this easy-wearing sneaker.

products.title: Dunk Low "Team Gold"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Team Gold” is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe with a versatile design. The “Team Gold” features a white leather construction with Team Gold leather overlays throughout. A Team Gold leather Swoosh appears on either side and white “Nike” branding is embroidered on the heel. More classic “Nike” detailing is found on the gold tongue tag on the white nylon tongue. Underfoot, a white rubber midsole and Team Gold outsole complete the look. Release date: March 1, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Racer Blue / Photon Dust"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Racer Blue/Photon Dust” is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe with a two-tone, blue-and-white color scheme. The Dunk Low in “Racer Blue/Photon Dust” features a white tumbled leather base with Racer Blue-colored leather overlays and Swoosh branding. White “Nike” detailing is embroidered on the heel and blue “Nike” and Swoosh logos are found on the tongue tag. Underfoot, the look is rounded into form with a white rubber midsole and blue rubber outsole. Release date: April 1, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Athletic Department - University Blue"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low "Athletic Department" is a colorway of the classic basketball and lifestyle shoe with a vintage look. From a greater collection of “Athletic Department” colorways by Nike, the Dunk Low seen here features a Sail leather base with light grey synthetic nubuck overlays on the toe, forefoot, eyelets, and heel. A University Blue leather Swoosh appears on the sides. Classic “Nike” branding is seen on the heel and on the tongue tag. An “Athletic Department” logo appears on the insole. The pre-yellowed midsole gives the shoe a decidedly old school, vintage look. Release date: July 25, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Red Panda"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Red Panda” is a colorway of the retro sneaker inspired by a red panda’s fur. Using the animal native to the eastern Himalayas as a source of inspiration, the “Red Panda” features an interesting combination of colors in its design. The upper has a dark brown suede base contrasted with light tan leather overlays on the toe cap, forefoot, eyelets, and Swoosh. A red suede overlay is seen on the collar and heel. Classic “Nike” branding is embroidered on the heel and printed on the tongue. A dark brown rubber midsole and light brown outsole complete the look.

products.title: Dunk Low "Split - Deep Jungle"
products.description: Dunk Low FB9109 300

products.title: Dunk Low "Oil Green"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low "Oil Green" is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe with earth tone colored features. The sneaker is complete with a white leather upper that’s paired with Oil Green leather overlays on the toe cap, forefoot, and eyelet panels. Cargo Khaki leather can be seen on the heel and collar. A Light Bone leather Swoosh appears on each side. Classic “Nike” branding is embroidered on the heel and printed on the tongue tag alongside a Swoosh. Release date: August 1, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Polar Blue / White"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low "Polar Blue" is a colorway of the retro basketball sneaker with a clean two-tone color block highlighted by light blue. Reminiscent of the classic “UNC” colorway, this Dunk has a white leather base and Polar Blue leather overlays. A Polar Blue leather Swoosh appears on the mid-panel. “Nike” branding is embroidered on the heel and printed on the tongue. A white midsole and blue outsole complete the look. Release date: October 14, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Khaki / Gum"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Khaki/Gum” is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe with a tan-based look. Another versatile edition of the Dunk Low, the upper features a combination of Khaki-colored suede and leather panels. More specifically, Wheat Grass-colored suede is seen on the base while Rattan leather panels and Swoosh branding create low contrast color and texture. A burnt orange “Nike” logo is embroidered on the heel and printed on the tongue tag above a Swoosh. Underfoot, a cream-colored rubber midsole and gum rubber outsole complete the clean colorway. Release date: December 21, 2022

products.title: Dunk Low "Picante Red"

products.title: Dunk Low "Shashiko - Industrial Blue"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low Shashiko “Industrial Blue” is a colorway of the classic basketball shoe that replaces its traditional leather build with a premium textile twill. More specifically, the “Industrial Blue” features a Summit White textile base with Industrial Blue textile overlays and Swoosh branding with white contrast stitching. White Shashiko stitching is embroidered on the toe and heel. Underfoot, a white rubber midsole and blue outsole complete the look. Release date: March 9, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Shashiko - Light Orewood Brown"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low Shashiko “Light Orewood Brown” is a colorway of the vintage basketball and lifestyle shoe made from a sturdy twill material. On the “Light Orewood Brown,” the shoe features a tan textile base and tonal Swoosh with contrasting brown stitching throughout. Contrasting red Shashiko stitching can be seen on the toe box and on the heel. The shoe’s mostly monochromatic tan appearance is continued on the midsole. A brown rubber outsole completes the look. Release date: March 9, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Chicago Split"
products.description: Dunk High Retro Prm DZ2536 600

products.title: Dunk Low "Dark Beetroot"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Dark Beetroot” is a colorway of the popular sneaker with a unique color block. The “Dark Beetroot” Dunk Low has a black tumbled leather base and Dark Beetroot leather overlays on the toe cap, forefoot, eyelets, collar, and heel. A white leather Swoosh breaks up the look on the sides of the shoe. White “Nike” branding is embroidered on the heel and white “Nike” and Swoosh logos appear on the tongue tag. A white rubber midsole Dark Beetroot outsole finish off the look. Release date: September 20, 2022

products.title: Dunk Low "Grey Panda Volt"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Grey Panda/Volt” is a versatile colorway of the retro basketball shoe that features subtle Volt accenting. Dubbed the “Grey Panda,” this version of the Dunk Low has a black leather base with contrasting Photon Dust leather overlays and Swoosh branding. Subtle pops of Volt can be found on the “Nike” embroidery on the heel and on the “Nike” and Swoosh logos on the tongue tag. A white midsole and contrasting black rubber outsole complete the look. Release date: January 18, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Navy / White / Grey"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Navy/White/Grey” is a classic and versatile colorway of the vintage basketball shoe that shows love to a popular, non-original Air Jordan 1 style. The shoe in question is the Jordan 1 High OG “Midnight Navy” that originally debuted as part of Jordan Brand and Nike’s former Japan-only “Concept Japan” or Co.Jo collection. Like the “Midnight Navy,” the “Navy/White/Grey” features a white leather base with contrasting navy leather overlays and a grey Swoosh. As for the rest of the shoe, old school navy “Nike” branding is embroidered on the heel and navy “Nike” and Swoosh logos are found on the tongue tag.

products.title: Dunk Low "Ironstone"
products.description: Dunk Low FD9746 001

products.title: Dunk Low "Clear Jade"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low "Clear Jade" is a colorway of the popular shoe with a warm weather vibe. Designed for casual wear, the “Clear Jade” colorway features a white leather upper with Clear Jade leather overlay panels and Swoosh branding. A white “Nike” logo is stitched onto the heel and “Nike” and Swoosh branding are found on the tongue tag. Underfoot, a white rubber midsole and Clear Jade rubber outsole complete the look. Release date: July 1, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Dolphins"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low "Dolphins" is a colorway of the retro basketball sneaker that features the team uniform colors of the NFL’s Miami Dolphins. In no way officially affiliated with the Dolphins, the colorway nicknamed after the football team nonetheless salutes the squad by featuring its uniform colors on its design. The upper has a white leather base with aqua leather overlays. An orange leather Swoosh is seen on both sides of the shoe. “Nike” branding is embroidered in white lettering on the orange leather heel tab. Aqua “Nike” and Swoosh logos are seen on the tongue tag. A white rubber midsole and aqua rubber outsole complete the look.

products.title: Dunk Low "Hyper Royal"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low "Hyper Royal" is another versatile, two-tone colorway of the retro basketball shoe. The Nike Dunk remains a timeless footwear option for casual wear years after its debut in 1985, and after its triumphant return in 2020. The “Hyper Royal” features a white leather upper with tonal leather overlays. A Hyper Royal leather Swoosh is seen on either side of the shoe. A royal “Nike” logo is embroidered on the heel and printed on the tongue tag with a royal Swoosh. Release date: October 1, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Reverse Brazil"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Reverse Brazil” is a two-tone, yellow-and-green colorway of the retro basketball shoe that flips the color scheme of the model’s popular “Brazil” style. As its name suggests, the “Reverse Brazil” reverses the color coordination of the “Brazil” Dunk, and it doesn’t miss the mark. The shoe features Yellow Strike leather overlays and Swoosh branding on an Apple Green-colored leather base. A green “Nike” logo is embroidered on the yellow leather heel tab. Classic “Nike” detailing can be found on the tongue. A white rubber midsole and green outsole complete the look. Release date: February 15, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Tartan Plaid"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Tartan Plaid” is a head-turning colorway of the vintage basketball and lifestyle shoe that features various tartan plaid patterns on its design. This casual Dunk Low features a white leather base with a green-based tartan plaid pattern on its toe cap, forefoot, and while a red-based tartan plaid pattern appears on the heel overlay. Grey tartan plaid is found on the middle eyelet panel. A black leather Swoosh appears on both sides of the shoe. Elsewhere, red “Nike” branding is embroidered on the heel and printed on the tongue tag. The white midsole is paired with a light grey rubber outsole. Release date: January 18, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Miami Hurricanes"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Miami Hurricanes” is a colorway of the classic sneaker that is an unofficial nod to the team uniform colors of the Miami Hurricanes college basketball team. The perforated toe, mid-panel, collar, and heel all appear in orange leather. Contrasting Team Green leather is found on the overlays and Swoosh. Fiery orange “Nike” detailing is embroidered on the heel and green “Nike” and Swoosh logos appear on the orange nylon tongue tag on the tonal nylon tongue. A white midsole and Team Green rubber outsole complete the look. Release date: November 1, 2022

products.title: Dunk Low "Arizona State"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Arizona State” is a two-tone colorway of the retro basketball shoe that draws inspiration from the Arizona State Sun Devils’ team uniform colors. The “Arizona State” Dunk Low is yet another college basketball-inspired look for the shoe that debuted as the sport’s first team sneaker back in 1985. In spite of its lack of official affiliation with Arizona State, the colorway nonetheless nods to the school and its basketball team with its maroon-and-yellow design. The base of the shoe features Bordeaux-colored leather while the overlays and Swoosh appear in yellow leather. A white midsole and yellow rubber outsole put the finishing touches on the shoe. Release date: November 1

products.title: Dunk Low "N7"
products.description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Decon N7 “Opti Yellow” is a special colorway of the popular skate shoe inspired by and in support of Native American and Indigenous youth in the United States. The SB Dunk Low Decon N7 “Opti Yellow” features a unique combination of materials, all of which are inspired by Native American culture and textiles. The N7 Dunk features a Sail canvas upper with tonal leather overlays. The colorway’s signature details include floral motifs on the toe cap, collar, and heel overlays. A red Swoosh with white contrast stitching is seen on the side. Red “Nike SB” branding is found on the tongue tag while an “N7” logo is paired with a Swoosh on the red leather heel tab. Release date: J

products.title: Dunk Low "Glow in the Dark"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Glow in the Dark” is a can’t-miss colorway of the vintage basketball shoe that features a glow-in-the-dark outsole. Undoubtedly one of the boldest Dunk colorways in the model’s collection, the “Glow in the Dark” features shiny Volt leather on its base with tonal leather overlays throughout its design. A black leather Swoosh logo appears on both sides of the shoe. A “Nike” logo is found on the orange leather heel tab. Another “Nike” logo appears on the tongue tag with an orange Swoosh. Underfoot, the shoe’s glow-in-the-dark rubber outsole shines when exposed to light in the dark.

products.title: Dunk Low "85 Athletic Department"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Athletic Department - Grey/Red” is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe with an old-school-inspired appearance. From Nike’s “Athletic Department” collection, which includes other classic sneakers, the “Grey/Red” features a light grey fabric base with tonal suede overlays throughout the design. A red leather Swoosh appears on the sides. The fiery red hue is also found on the leather heel tab with “Nike” branding. A red “Nike” logo is paired with a grey Swoosh on the tongue tag.

products.title: Dunk Low "Foam Finger"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Foam Finger” is a colorful look for the classic sneaker that celebrates sports fans. Inspired by the “number one” foam fingers that fans bring to sporting events around the world in support of their favorite teams, the “Foam Finger” Dunk Low features an assortment of colorful foam finger graphics on the toe, mid-panel, collar, and heel. Contrasting green suede overlays and a blue leather Swoosh contrast the look. The “Nike” branding embroidered on the heel appears in red lettering. As does the “Nike” logo on the tongue. Hemp laces, a white rubber midsole, and icy blue translucent outsole complete the look. Release date: November 8, 2022

products.title: Dunk Low "Celtics"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Celtics” is a colorway of the retro basketball shoe that features the team uniform colors of the Boston Celtics on its design. While not officially associated with the Celtics, this Dunk Low still shows love to the storied basketball team by featuring its uniform colors across its leather panels. More specifically, the shoe has a white leather base with Stadium Green leather overlays and a black leather Swoosh. Block letter “Nike” branding appears on the tongue tag, on the heel, and on the insole. Release date: June 13, 2023

products.title: Dunk Low "Safari Golden Moss"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Safari Golden Moss” is a bold colorway with head-turning, outdoors-inspired patterning on its design. The “Safari Golden Moss” is equipped with mismatched, earth tone safari print overlays. The tan-colored hemp base allows the aforementioned patterns to garner attention. A black leather Swoosh logo can be found on both sides of the shoe and a black “Nike” logo appears on the tan heel overlay. Black “Nike” and Swoosh branding is located on the tongue. Additional details include green and black laces and a gum rubber sole with speckling that subtly nods to the Nike ACG footwear line. Release date: August 2, 2022

products.title: Dunk Low "LeBron James - Fruity Pebbles"
products.description: The LeBron James x Nike Dunk Low “Fruity Pebbles” is a collaboration between LeBron James and Nike on a colorway of the retro basketball shoe inspired by his favorite cereal, Magic Fruity Pebbles. As imagined, the “Fruity Pebbles” Dunk Low by LeBron and Nike is as colorful as the tasty Fruity Pebbles cereal. The shoe features red leather overlays and a white leather base. A blue leather Swoosh appears on both sides and yellow leather is found on the collar and heel. Fruity Pebbles logo detailing appears on the laces and on the tongue tag, and LeBron’s signature branding dots the blue leather heel tab. Release date: September 1, 2022

products.title: Dunk Low "ATL"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “ATL” is a colorway of the vintage basketball shoe that shows appreciation for the city of Atlanta. Dubbed simply the “ATL,” this Dunk Low features an appealing color scheme that turns heads everywhere it goes. University Red leather appears on the shoe’s overlays. The base is designed in Bright Crimson suede. A tonal leather Swoosh is located on the sides. An “ATL” emblem is stamped on the lateral side of the shoe. Red “Nike” branding is embroidered on the heel and printed on the tongue tag.

products.title: Dunk Low "Jackie Robinson"
products.description: The Nike Dunk Low “Jackie Robinson” is a special edition colorway that honors the life and legacy of the civil rights activist and Baseball Hall of Famer. From Nike’s July 2022 release cycle, the “Jackie Robinson” Dunk Low celebrates Jackie Robinson, who broke baseball’s color barrier in 1948. The colorway takes inspiration from Jackie’s time with the Brooklyn Dodgers, beginning with Racer Blue leather overlays on the toe cap, forefoot, eyelets, collar, heel, and Swoosh, all of which are inscribed with inspirational quotes by Jackie. The leather base appears in a cream-grey hue. Together, the two colors are inspired by the Brooklyn Dodgers’ old team uniform colors. Other overtures to Jackie’

products.title: Air Max 90 "Supernova Galaxy"
products.description: The Nike Air Max 90 “Supernova Galaxy” is reminiscent of the outer space theme used on some Nike Basketball’s most popular shoes from its “All-Star” collection of 2012. Transferred over to the Air Max 90 in 2020, the “Supernova Galaxy” colorway is clearly one of the boldest looks of any Air Max shoe. Neoprene material dressed in an intergalactic design appears on the toe and forefoot, as well as the collar and heel. A contrasting black mudguard and mid-panel overlay mimic the darkness of outer space. Nike places a Metallic Silver Swoosh with red accenting on the mid-panel. Additional design components include teal and red eyelet panels and a white rubber heel tab with black “Nike Air” detail

products.title: AIR MAX 90 "NORDIC CHRISTMAS"
products.description: The Nike Air Max 90 “Nordic Christmas” is a Winter 2020 release by Nike that dresses the iconic performance runner in a Christmas-inspired colorway. Appearing alongside a Nike Blazer Mid and Air Force 1 High as part of the “Nordic Pack,” this Air Max 90 is a festive design full of holiday vibes. The mid-panel, forefoot, and toe cap of the shoe display a smooth variety of white leather that allows for the snowflake pattern on the green fabric found on the toe, collar, heel, and tongue. A University Red leather Swoosh adorns either side of the upper and a Dark Atomic Teal leather mudguard appears above the white midsole. Other details include a green “Air Max” window on the mudguard, white “Ni

products.title: Air Max 90 "Total Orange"
products.description: The Nike Air Max 90 “Total Orange” is a new colorway of the performance runner that celebrates the model’s 30-year anniversary. The “Total Orange” edition is one of several back-to-original Air Max 90s that were released in 2020. A more streamlined shape and use of premium materials differentiates the “Total Orange” from other Air Max 90s. An ample amount of the vivid orange hue is applied throughout the design, including on the eyelets, Air Max branding window, heel tab, and panel that surrounds the visible Air unit in the sole. The black mudguard is contrasted by light grey leather accenting on the mid-panel and toe cap.

products.description: Bring energy to a classic runner with the NIKE Air Max 90 "Neutral Grey Tour Yellow." Featuring a clean white mesh upper with soft grey suede overlays, this vibrant pair stands out with bold Tour Yellow Swooshes and deep Obsidian leather mudguards. Speed Red accents light up the visible Max Air unit, delivering time tested cushioning and impact absorption. Finished with a durable waffle rubber outsole, it offers iconic 90s track heritage and unmatched street comfort.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Hyper Crimson"
products.description: Lace up a piece of history and feel the legacy of the Nike Air Max 90. A champion running shoe that transcended sport to define '90s culture, this sneaker continues to reign as a streetwear icon, celebrated for its architectural design, visible comfort, and striking visuals.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Thunderstorm"
products.description: Command attention wherever you step in the NIKE Air Max 90 "Thunderstorm". Inspired by stormy skies, this iconic runner features a rich blue thunderstorm upper beautifully contrasted by icy glacier ice branding accents and a dark obsidian midsole. Visible Max Air cushioning in the heel delivers the signature time tested comfort you know and love, while a durable waffle rubber outsole ensures reliable traction. Perfect for bringing bold, mood enhancing flair to your everyday casual sneaker rotation.

products.title: Air Max 90 "White/Photon Dust/Summit White/Platinum Tint"
products.description: Embrace clean, minimal aesthetic with the NIKE Air Max 90 "White/Photon Dust/Summit White/Platinum Tint". This refined take on the iconic runner pairs crisp white mesh and smooth leather uppers with soft platinum tint and photon dust overlays for subtle, sophisticated contrast. The signature visible Max Air cushioning unit provides classic, plush support underfoot, while the durable waffle outsole ensures timeless traction. Perfect for daily rotation, it seamlessly blends retro athletic heritage with effortless modern style.

products.title: AIR MAX 90 "White/Cool Grey-university Red"
products.description: The Air Max 90 "White/Cool Grey-University Red" brings a classic, varsity-inspired energy to the legendary 1990 silhouette. Featuring a clean white leather and mesh base accented by "Cool Grey" overlays and vibrant "University Red" hits, this release captures the timeless look of American athletic heritage. The signature visible Air cushioning and Waffle outsole ensure all-day comfort and stability. It is a high-energy, soulful masterpiece that honors the DNA of the original runner while providing a fresh look.

products.title: AIR MAX 90 "Lime"
products.description: The Nike Air Max 90 “Lime” is an OG-inspired colorway and construction for the iconic retro runner. The eye-catching upper contains mesh and synthetic materials in white and black with neon green accents. Nike branding appears on the tongue of the model, complemented by the Nike Swoosh, Air Max logo along the side, and Nike Air emblem on the heel. The white midsole contains a translucent Air Max unit surrounded by lime accenting, adding a superior layer of support and cushion for long-lasting wear and durability.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Evergreen Aura"
products.description: Lace up and feel the legacy of one of Nike's most influential designs. The Nike Air Max 90 (originally the Air Max III) returns in a clean and refreshing 'Evergreen Aura' colorway, perfectly blending the model's iconic retro visuals with a nature-inspired palette.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Black Buff Gold"
products.description: Step up your sneaker game with the NIKE Air Max 90 "Black Buff Gold". Built with a sleek, all black upper crafted from durable synthetic leather and breathable materials, this iconic silhouette is accented with striking golden details along the branding and visible heel Air unit. The classic rubber Waffle outsole provides heritage traction, while the plush padded collar and signature Air cushioning deliver exceptional, all day comfort for a sophisticated, bold look.

products.title: Air Max 90 "White Light Bone Neutral Olive Cave Stone"
products.description: The Air Max 90 "White Light Bone Neutral Olive Cave Stone" delivers a rugged, earth-toned aesthetic to Tinker Hatfield’s anatomy-inspired design. Featuring a complex mix of mesh, suede, and leather overlays, this release utilizes a sophisticated palette of olive and stone hues for a versatile, outdoor-ready look. The signature visible Air unit in the heel and Waffle outsole stay true to the 1990 original. It is a soulful, high-energy masterpiece that brings a touch of industrial luxury to the streets.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Reflective Swoosh"
products.description: Make a stealthy statement with the NIKE Air Max 90 "Reflective Swoosh". This iconic sneaker features a sleek black and anthracite upper built from durable materials for an effortless, modern edge. Designed with responsive Max Air cushioning in the heel, it delivers exceptional comfort and impact support with every stride. Complete with a subtle reflective Swoosh that catches the light in the dark, this versatile pair ensures you stay bold and visible wherever your day takes you.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Smoke Grey Diffused Blue"
products.description: The Air Max 90 "Smoke Grey Diffused Blue" offers a cool-toned, versatile take on the quintessential 90s trainer. Featuring a sophisticated palette of "Smoke Grey" and "Diffused Blue," this pair utilizes premium materials to highlight the iconic TPU accents and layered geometry. The visible Air cushioning and padded collar provide the legendary comfort that defined the Air Max era. It is a refined, soulful masterpiece that delivers a clean and timeless look for any high-end casual wardrobe, perfect for year-round styling.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Cool Grey Sundial"
products.description: Brighten up your classic rotation with the NIKE Air Max 90 "Cool Grey Sundial". This fresh iteration of the iconic runner features a neutral blend of cool grey and wolf grey across its layered mesh and leather upper. Vibrant sundial yellow accents pop along the heel branding, Air Max window, and visible Max Air cushioning unit in the heel. Complete with a signature waffle rubber outsole, it delivers legendary street style and proven comfort.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Dusty Cactus"
products.description: The Nike Air Max 90 "Dusty Cactus" breathes new life into a classic with a sharp, high-contrast palette. A grey mesh upper is reinforced by rich hairy suede overlays and a bold black leather mudguard. The muted, tonal design is electrified by vibrant "Dusty Cactus" hits on the TPU eyelets, heel badge, and visible Max Air unit. Balancing heritage performance with a modern street aesthetic, this pair delivers legendary comfort and a timeless, standout look.

products.title: AIR MAX 90 "WOLF GREY HYPER PINK"
products.description: Step into vibrant energy and legendary comfort with the NIKE Air Max 90 "Wolf Grey Hyper Pink". This iconic sneaker pairs a sleek wolf grey and black foundation with electrifying hyper pink accents that instantly command attention. Featuring the signature visible Max Air cushioning you know and love, it delivers all day impact absorption and support. Whether you are upgrading your daily rotation or looking to make a bold statement, this standout pair guarantees effortless style and unmatched performance everywhere you go.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Light Bone Neutral Olive"
products.description: The Nike Air Max 90 continues its legacy with this rugged, sophisticated colorway featuring Neutral Olive and Light Bone tones. Blending foundational comfort with an outdoor-ready aesthetic, the DM0029 011 is the perfect sneaker for transitioning seasons.

products.title: Air Max 90 "College Grey Racer Blue"
products.description: Step into timeless running heritage with the NIKE Air Max 90 "College Grey Racer Blue". Featuring a crisp white mesh base with neutral College Grey and Summit White overlays, this classic sneaker pops with vibrant Racer Blue Swoosh accents. Visible Max Air cushioning in the heel delivers trusted all day comfort and impact absorption, while the iconic rubber Waffle outsole provides durable traction. Fresh, versatile, and legendary, this pair seamlessly completes any casual daily look.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Smoke Grey Fire Red"
products.description: The Nike Air Max 90 is a celebrated icon, and this Black/Iron Grey/Fire Red (DM0029 007) colorway brings a bold, modern edge to its classic '90s running heritage. It combines deep, smoky neutrals with explosive pops of red for a look that's both stealthy and striking.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Slawn - Black Speckle"
products.description: Step into artistic flair with the NIKE Air Max 90 "Slawn Black Speckle". Designed in collaboration with Nigerian born artist Olaolu Slawn, this striking sneaker features a sleek black upper contrasted by dynamic white speckling across the mudguard and midsole. Contrast Swooshes and signature branding add sharp visual pop, while classic Max Air heel cushioning ensures all day comfort. Blending rebellious street art with iconic running heritage, it is a bold statement piece for any collection.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Cool Grey Pure Platinum Black"
products.description: Tinker Hatfield's Nike Air Max 90 design has been amongst the brand's most ubiquitous models since debuting in 1990. As it celebrates its 35th anniversary, the silhouette continues to emerge in new styles.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Hemp Earth"
products.description: The Nike Air Max 90 "Hemp Earth" is an earth tone colorway of the retro running and casual shoe. Designed by Tinker Hatfield and originally released by Nike back in 1990, the Air Max 90 is now beloved for its comfort and timeless design. The “Hemp Earth” features a tan mesh base with light cocoa-colored synthetic nubuck overlays. A white leather Swoosh contrasts the look on either side of the shoe. The “Air Max” branding window on the lateral side of the heel appears in olive to match the color of the lower eyelet panels and the panel that borders the visible Air unit in the heel of the midsole. Release date: October 3, 2023

products.title: Air Max 90 "Gore-Tex"
products.description: The Nike Air Max 90 Gore-Tex “Photon Dust” is a versatile colorway of the retro running shoe with a water-resistant construction. The Air Max 90 Gore-Tex is updated with a water-resistant Gore-Tex shell that keeps water from penetrating the wearer’s foot in inclement weather conditions. The upper features a white ripstop nylon base and Photon Dust leather overlays with a white leather Swoosh. Additional branding elements include “Gore-Tex” branding on the lateral side of the heel and on the tongue, and “Nike Air” detailing on the heel. A large visible Air unit in the heel completes this classic Air Max 90 design with Gore-Tex insulation. Release date: November 10, 2022

products.title: Air Max 90 "Iron Grey University Red"
products.description: Step into classic running heritage with a bold twist in the NIKE Air Max 90 "Iron Grey University Red". Built with a durable combination of mesh, leather, and synthetic overlays, this iconic sneaker features a brooding Iron Grey and Anthracite base accented by a crisp white Swoosh and fiery University Red details. A visible Max Air heel unit provides tried and true responsive cushioning, while the legendary rubber waffle outsole delivers dependable traction and timeless street style.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Smoke Grey Light Lemon Twist"
products.description: Lace up and feel the legacy of a running champion that helped define an era. The Nike Air Max 90 remains a streetwear icon, celebrated for its bold aesthetic, comfortable fit, and revolutionary visible Air cushioning. This edition updates the legendary silhouette with a greyscale base accented by a pop of citrus.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Volcano"
products.description: The Nike Air Max 90 "Volcano" erupts with a high-energy colorway inspired by the raw power of nature. Featuring a dark, charcoal base, this release is electrified by fiery orange and red gradients across the TPU accents and branding. The classic mix of mesh and leather overlays ensures the durability of the 1990 original, while the visible Air unit in the heel provides the iconic cushioned ride. It is a bold, aggressive masterpiece designed for those who want to make an impact.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Hyper Royal"
products.description: The Nike Air Max 90 "Hyper Royal" takes the legendary early '90s silhouette and injects it with a striking, electric blue energy. This version combines a clean, neutral base with vibrant color pops, delivering a classic sneaker with undeniable street appeal.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Flax"
products.description: The Nike Air Max 90 Premium Flax Sail revives a beloved '90s silhouette with a clean, monochromatic colorway dressed in warm flax and sail tones. This low-top profile stays true to its roots with a layered construction featuring supple flax nubuck throughout the upper, providing a premium feel. Tonal flax Swooshes blend seamlessly into the side panels, complemented by classic details like the ribbed rubber eyestays and a textured heel counter. Grounded by a sail-tinted midsole containing the iconic visible Air unit, this sneaker is finished with a durable gum rubber Waffle outsole for multi-surface traction and timeless heritage appeal.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Dark Team Red'"
products.description: Make a bold statement with the NIKE Air Max 90 "Dark Team Red". Staying true to its 90s running roots, this iconic sneaker features a breathable white mesh base paired with smooth grey leather overlays and crisp black Swooshes. Striking burgundy accents around the eyestays, heel tab, and visible Air unit window add rich contrast. Complete with lightweight Max Air cushioning and a waffle outsole, it offers supreme comfort and classic street style.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Pumice"
products.description: Refresh your sneaker rotation with the NIKE Air Max 90 "Pumice". Staying true to its 90s running roots, this classic model blends soft grey, light pumice, and dark slate tones across a durable multi material upper. Refreshing ice blue accents highlight the TPU eyelets, lateral branding window, and visible Max Air heel cushioning frame. Complete with a signature rubber waffle outsole for reliable traction, this versatile sneaker delivers unbeatable retro style and everyday comfort.

products.title: Air Max 90 "Alchemy Pink"
products.description: The Nike Air Max 90 "Alchemy Pink" is an undoubtedly head-turning colorway of the retro running shoe. The "Alchemy Pink" attracts attention with a Alchemy Pink, Cosmic Clay, Fire Red, and Dusty Cactus color scheme. Specifically, the mesh base is designed in Cosmic Clay, while the overlays appear in Alchemy Pink suede. A Dusty Cactus Swoosh appears on the lateral side, and a Cosmic Clay Swoosh can be found on the medial side. A pink “Air Max” logo appears in the orange overlay on the Fire Red mudguard.
