products.title: SB Dunk High "Supreme - By Any Means - Navy/Red"
products.description: The Supreme x Nike SB Dunk High Pro “By Any Means - Navy/Red” is one of three colorways of the skate shoe co-designed by Supreme and Nike SB. Returning to the Nike SB Dunk High, Supreme imagines the skate shoe with classic branding from its own archives. The “By Any Means” detailing on the heel originated on a remixed version of the New Era New York Yankees Fitted Hat issued by Supreme in the 2000s. As for the rest of the shoe, red leather appears on the perforated toe, mid-panel, collar, and heel. The look is contrasted with navy blue leather overlays and Swoosh branding. The phrase “No <3,” as in, “no love,” appears on the forefoot and NWA-style “Supreme Team” detailing is found on the

products.title: SB Dunk High "Supreme - By Any Means - Green/Yellow"
products.description: The Supreme x Nike SB Dunk High Pro "By Any Means - Green/Yellow" is a collaboration between the “World Famous” streetwear brand and Nike SB on the popular skate shoe. This instance in the collaboration between Supreme and Nike SB revives Supreme’s “By Any Means” branding that originated on a remixed version of the New Era New York Yankees Fitted Hat issued by Supreme in the 2000s. The branding in question is the New York Magazine-style “By Any Means” font on the heel. Eye-catching yellow leather appears on the perforated toe, mid-panel, collar, and heel. The look is contrasted with green leather overlays and Swoosh branding. The two-tone, yellow-and-green color block is culled from the orig

products.title: SB Dunk High "New York Mets"
products.description: The Nike SB Dunk High “New York Mets” is a colorway from the baseball-inspired “Bubble Gum” pack that nods to the uniform colors of the NYC MLB team. Alongside the “Phillies” SB Dunk, the “New York Mets” is one of several iterations of the popular skate shoe that shows love to America’s Pastime, and in this case, the Mets, specifically. The shoe features a grey mesh base with tonal suede overlays. A Rush Blue Swoosh with contrasting Team Orange trim is found on either side. The blue-and-orange color combination is inspired by the Mets’ primary uniform colors. Additional blue and orange accenting appears on the blue tongue tag with orange “Nike SB Dunk” branding. A white midsole and gum rubbe

products.title: SB Dunk High "Doraemon"
products.description: The Nike SB Dunk High “Doraemon” salutes the time-traveling Japanese anime character from the cartoon of the same name. Desired by anime aficionados and sneaker collectors, the "Doraemon" Dunk is a Fall 2020 release that is dressed in a color scheme reminiscent of the robotic cat's outfit. The upper features a clean white tumbled leather base for the perforated toe, mid-panel, collar, and upper heel. A stark contrast of Light Photo Blue suede overlays can be found on the forefoot, eyelets, and heel. University Red Swooshes appear on either side of the shoe. The laces and liner are finished off in the same fiery red hue. A yellow nylon tongue tab with white “Nike SB” branding adds a subtle bu

products.title: SB Dunk High "Paul Rodriguez - Mexican Boxing"
products.description: The Paul Rodriguez x Nike SB Dunk High “Mexican Boxing” is the California pro skater’s ode to Mexican boxing heritage. P-Rod, skate legend and longtime Nike SB collaborator, returns with a crisp high-top Dunk as part of Nike’s efforts of introducing the iconic silhouette to a new audience in 2020. Here, the colors found on the Mexican flag inspire the red accented piping along each of the panels found on the upper and green leather Swoosh. A stark white leather base provides a clean backdrop for the aforementioned design elements to pop. Subtle nods to boxing culture include a mini gold-accented championship belt ornament on the shoe’s vamp and an Everlast-styled Paul Rodriguez branding on t

products.title: SB Dunk High "Supreme - By Any Means - White/Black"
products.description: The Supreme x Nike SB Dunk High Pro “By Any Means - White/Black” is one of three colorways of the collaboration between Supreme and Nike SB on the iconic skate shoe. Another chapter in the storied collaboration history between Supreme and Nike SB, the “By Any Means” collection of Dunks revives classic branding that originated on a remixed version of the New Era New York Yankees Fitted Hat issued by Supreme in the 2000s. The branding in question is the New York Magazine-style “By Any Means” font on the heel. Black leather appears on the perforated toe, mid-panel, collar, and heel. The look is contrasted with white leather overlays and Swoosh branding. The phrase “No <3,” as in, “no love,”

products.title: SB Dunk High "Concepts - Turdunken"
products.description: The Concepts x Nike SB Dunk High “Turdunken/Mallard” is a special collaboration cooked up by the Boston sneaker boutique and Nike SB on a Dunk for Thanksgiving and the Holidays. The wild look was described by Concept’s Creative Director Deon Point as being the shop’s “most off-the-wall thing we’ve ever done,” high praise coming from the man who had a hand in coming up with the design of luminaries like the “Lobster” SB Dunks and more. Inspired by the popular holiday dish of turducken, which is both a chicken and duck stuffed inside of a turkey, the “Turdunken” is also based on the mallard duck. Nods to the waterfowl include an iridescent blue and green Swoosh that sit on top of a leather tex

products.title: SB Dunk High "Strawberry Cough"
products.description: The Nike SB Dunk High “Strawberry Cough” is yet another covetable release from Nike’s skateboarding division to employ a playful marijuana-themed design. Taking inspiration directly from the marijuana strain of the same nickname, the “Strawberry Cough” Dunk features a red perforated leather toe, tonal leather overlays on the forefoot, and a red leather mid-panel, all with dot-textured accents reminiscent of seeds found in the tasty fruit. Modeled after the stem and leaves of a strawberry, the back half of the shoe is constructed with supple green suede and a velvet-like materiel along the collar, heel, and Swoosh. The look is pulled together by a whimsical coughing strawberry character embro

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Batman"
products.description: Step out of the shadows and onto the streets with the Nike Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Batman". Noding to Gotham's Caped Crusader, this stealthy silhouette features a dark, moody mix of premium mesh, leather, and nubuck in black and anthracite shades. Vibrant Buff Gold accents mimic the iconic utility belt for a powerful pop of contrast. Equipped with an oversized Big Bubble Max Air setup for upgraded cushioning, this tactical masterpiece delivers ultimate comfort for the concrete jungle.

products.colorway: Big Bubble Black Lime Blast Anthracite
products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Black Lime Blast Anthracite"
products.description: Step into a legendary legacy with the Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Lime Blast Anthracite. Celebrating over three decades of revolutionary design, this remastered rendition stays true to the mid-90s icon while adding a fresh update. Its human-anatomy-inspired signature wavy upper features a premium blend of breathable black mesh and synthetic leather panels in charcoal and gray. Futuristic metallic silver accents and vibrant Lime Blast details add high-energy contrast, while the standout enlarged visible Air cushioning ensures a bold, legendary ride.

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Baltic Blue"
products.description: Reimagining a running legend, the Nike Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Baltic Blue" injects a striking, high-contrast look into the classic silhouette. Deep black panels anchor the muscle-inspired upper, allowing the vibrant Baltic Blue layers and webbed eyelets to pop with sharp, modern energy. Grounded by a black midsole featuring an oversized "Big Bubble" Max Air unit in the heel, this pair blends nostalgic retro-sporty heritage with exceptional all-day cushioning.

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble 7-Eleven"
products.description: Pay homage to convenience store culture with the Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble 7-Eleven. This striking silhouette leans into an unmistakable color story, featuring layered suede panels in Gym Red, Sport Green, and Total Orange atop a clean Sail upper. Light British Tan accents pay tribute to traditional brown paper bags, while a printed insole depicts stocked convenience store shelves. Built with the iconic, oversized Big Bubble Air unit, it delivers maximum retro comfort and undeniable street appeal.

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Lawson"
products.description: Pay homage to Japan's vibrant convenience store culture with the Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Lawson. This unique colorway draws inspiration from the iconic mini-mart chain, featuring premium Blue Sapphire suede panels set against a clean white mesh upper. Action Red accents peak through the layered design, mirroring the classic storefront aesthetic. Rooted in running heritage, the sneaker is finished with a crisp white polyurethane midsole and the legendary oversized Big Bubble Max Air cushioning in the heel.

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Reverse Solar Red"
products.description: Step back into '90s running heritage with the Nike Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Reverse Solar Red." Reimagining Sergio Lozano’s classic anatomy-inspired design, this pair features dark gradient side panels contrasted by striking Solar Red accents on the lace loops, Swoosh, and tongue. The throwback aesthetic is elevated by an oversized "Big Bubble" Max Air cushioning unit in the sole, delivering the ultimate blend of iconic street style and cushioned comfort.

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Hot Curry"
products.description: Turn up the heat with the Nike Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Hot Curry." Reintroducing Sergio Lozano’s classic anatomy-inspired silhouette, this edition features the iconic greyscale gradient upper crafted from premium mesh and textiles. Striking "Hot Curry" orange accents inject vibrant contrast across the hiking-style lace loops, mini Swoosh, and tongue branding. Underfoot, exaggerated "Big Bubble" visible Air units in the midsole provide authentic '90s running heritage and maximum street-ready comfort.

products.colorway: Big Bubble Smoke Grey Green Abyss
products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Smoke Grey Green Abyss"
products.description: Celebrate the 30th anniversary of an icon with the Nike Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Smoke Grey Green Abyss". This edition features Sergio Lozano's legendary human anatomy-inspired layered upper clad in a sleek gradient of grey hues. Breathable mesh and premium suede panels deliver structural durability, while vibrant Green Abyss teal accents pop on the Swoosh, tongue branding, and inside the signature enlarged "Big Bubble" Max Air units. It is a versatile, streetwear-ready masterpiece combining heritage design with cushioned comfort.

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Bright Crimson"
products.description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Bright Crimson" delivers a moody, high-contrast refresh to the legendary runner for its 30th anniversary. Swapping traditional neon pops for a dark foundation, it features a striking gradient upper composed of Black, Anthracite, and textured grey layers. Intense Bright Crimson accents ignite the mini Swoosh, tongue branding, and the retro-inspired, enlarged "Big Bubble" Max Air unit in the heel. It is a bold, heritage-driven masterpiece that perfectly blends mid-'90s anatomy-inspired design with a modern, aggressive edge.

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Black Sapphire"
products.description: Celebrate the heritage of human anatomy-inspired design with the Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble "Black Sapphire." This premium execution brings back the historically faithful 1995 specifications, complete with an enlarged "Big Bubble" Max Air unit in the heel and forefoot. The signature gradient upper shifts through sleek shades of black, anthracite, and dark smoke grey, allowing the vibrant sapphire blue accents on the branding and reworked Air units to pop with bold chromatic authority.

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Black Grape"
products.description: Step into a new era of cushioned comfort with the Nike Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Black Grape". This premium running sneaker pays homage to human anatomy with its signature layered upper, transitioning smoothly through black and iron grey panels. Anchored by vibrant hits of court purple and dusty cactus, the design spotlights an enlarged, retro inspired visible Air Max unit in the heel for elite impact absorption. Bringing a confident, athletic edge to your lifestyle rotation, this iconic pair ensures you dominate the streets with undeniable heritage style.

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Green Gusto"
products.description: Step into retro running heritage with the Nike Air Max 95 OG Green Gusto. Celebrating the 30th anniversary of the anatomy-inspired silhouette, this special edition swaps traditional midfoot suede layers for a fresh mix of ripstop nylon and smooth summit white and black leather panels. A vibrant Green Gusto overlay delivers high-energy contrast across the side, matching the nylon lace loops and striking Big Bubble Max Air units in the heel. It is a bold, modern twist on a 90s classic.

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Obsidian"
products.description: Experience legendary running history updated for the modern streets with the NIKE Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Obsidian". Celebrating retro athletic style, this iconic model showcases human anatomy inspired wavy side panels in rich shades of navy and obsidian blue. The enlarged, visible "Big Bubble" Air cushioning in the forefoot and heel delivers plush, all day impact absorption. Perfect for sneaker enthusiasts, it blends classic gradient construction with bold, timeless appeal.

products.colorway: Big Bubble Photon Dust Bright Violet
products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Photon Dust Bright Violet"
products.description: Taking inspiration from human anatomy and '90s track aesthetics, the Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Photon Dust Bright Violet delivers a sophisticated color update to an iconic silhouette. The signature wavy side panels feature a tonal gradient of grey suedes and breathable mesh, punctuated by electric Bright Violet accents on the lace loops and mini Swoosh. Underneath, the exaggerated "Big Bubble" Max Air units provide legendary performance cushioning, merging retro structural boldness with a fresh, modern palette.

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Black Bright Ceramic"
products.description: Secure a piece of running history reimagined with the NIKE Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Black Bright Ceramic". This legendary silhouette showcases its iconic human anatomy inspired side panels transitioning smoothly from crisp white to deep charcoal and black. Striking bright ceramic accents puncture the dark palette along the mini Swoosh, tongue branding, and eyelets. Anchored by a rugged black sole unit, it features an enhanced, larger visible Air Max heel unit that delivers retro flair and elite all day cushioning.

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "White Saffron Quartz Black"
products.description: Elevate your rotation with the striking NIKE Air Max 95 OG "White Saffron Quartz Black." This iconic runner showcases its signature human anatomy inspired wavy overlays in a crisp white and vibrant Saffron Quartz gradient. The bold black midsole houses visible Max Air units in the heel and forefoot, providing the legendary cushioning that redefined performance in the '90s. With its distinctive lace loops and multi textured upper, this pair offers a perfect balance of heritage style and high impact visibility.

products.colorway: Big Bubble Photon Dust Purple Dynasty
products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Big Bubble Photon Dust Purple Dynasty"
products.description: Celebrate human anatomy and running history with the NIKE Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Photon Dust Purple Dynasty. This striking silhouette features the iconic gradient wavy side panels, shifting beautifully from clean Photon Dust to a rich, deep Dark Raisin and Sapphire purple. Vibrant teal accents lock down the eyelets, adding an energetic contrast to the layered look. Anchored by a dark, durable midsole housing an oversized Big Bubble Air unit in the heel, it offers maximum impact protection and bold, unforgettable street style.

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Fireberry"
products.description: Ignite your footwear collection with the vibrant energy of the NIKE Air Max 95 OG "Fireberry." Inspired by the human anatomy, this iconic running silhouette features a striking, multi layered upper rendered in bold pink Fireberry hues constructed from a blend of premium mesh and synthetic suede. Black accents along the swoosh branding and sturdy rubber outsole create a sharp contrast. Equipped with visible Max Air units in the forefoot and heel, it delivers plush cushioning and standout retro style for all day wear.

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Sanded Purple"
products.description: The Sanded Purple (IB1667 500) colorway features a gradient upper transitioning from deep Obsidian (dark navy) and Wolf Grey (mid-grey) at the top to lighter tones at the bottom. The standout feature is the unique purple hue, giving the layered panels a rich, dusted finish.

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Blue Spark"
products.description: The Nike Air Max 95—inspired by the human anatomy—returns with "Big Bubble" energy and the beloved 'Blue Spark' colorway. This special edition recreates the bold, chunkier Max Air units from the 1995 prototype, offering a truer-to-OG silhouette and unparalleled bounce.

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Green Shock"
products.description: The Nike Air Max 95 is a definitive sneaker icon, famous for its aggressive silhouette inspired by human anatomy—where the midsole represents the spine, the layered panels represent muscles, and the lace loops are the ribs. This highly sought-after OG edition turns up the voltage with a striking neon accent on a dark, stealthy base.

products.title: Air Max 95 OG "Wolf Grey"
products.description: The Air Max 95 OG "Wolf Grey" returns in its legendary gradient glory, celebrating Sergio Lozano’s anatomy-inspired design. products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Ash Blue” is a February 2021 colorway of the most popular model in Kanye West’s signature shoe collection with adidas. After ramping up production to give us even more exciting colorways of the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 in 2019 and 2020, one of the hardest working teams in footwear showed no signs of slowing down in 2021, as exemplified by the “Ash Blue.” The design features a contrasting beige monofilament stripe on the lateral side of the multi-directional blue-grey woven Primeknit upper. Consistent with new 350 V2 models, the “Ash Blue” is devoid of a traditional heel tab, which enhances the model’s sleek profile. Underfoot, a Boost cushioned midsole provides all-d

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Mono Clay"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 "Mono Clay" is one of three colorways that debuted a new construction of the silhouette in June 2021. The "Mono" series, which includes this "Clay" colorway along with "Mist" and "Ice" versions, features a departure from the model's usual Primeknit woven upper, instead opting for a translucent monofilament mesh material. Below the mesh exterior is a supportive "web" design. The "Mono Clay" colorway features an earthy shade of reddish-orange across the upper, much like the initial "Clay" Yeezy 350 from 2019. The monotone Clay theme continues on the heel pull tab, laces, and translucent rubber sole. The "Mono Clay" Yeezy 350 released exclusively in Asia, while the "M

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Ash Stone"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Ash Stone” debuted in February 2021 as part of Kanye West and adidas’s Spring 2021 footwear collection. The formula for the “Ash Stone” remains unchanged from previous 350 V2 releases, as an earth tone heavy design highlights the look of this popular low-top shoe. Various neutral colors, like brown, black, grey, and white are found within the shoe’s Primeknit design. A contrasting reddish-orange monofilament stripe breaks up the look on the lateral side of the shoe. Adidas’s comfortable Boost cushioning technology is encased within the black ribbed midsole for all-day wearability. Release date: February 20, 2021.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Mono Ice"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Mono Ice” is a June 2021 release by Kanye West and adidas that reimagines the popular lifestyle shoe with a one-piece translucent mesh construction. A completely new look for the Yeezy Boost 350 V2, the “Mono Ice” does away with the 350 V2’s original woven Primeknit design in favor of a new translucent mesh upper that obscures a web cage underneath. Despite the new design, the “Mono Ice” retains the monofilament stripe found on several late-model 350 V2s. The white inner lining and laces contrast the icy look of the shoe. Underfoot, a white translucent ribbed midsole houses adidas’s Boost cushioning technology. Release date: June 18, 2021.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Earth"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Earth” is a North America-exclusive colorway of Kanye West’s highly sought-after silhouette. Released in February 2020, the regional design features a brown Primeknit upper that resembles dirt, hence the "Earth" nickname. The Yeezy 350's traditional stripe appears with a translucent thread in the same brown hue. Adidas opts to equip the shoe with light brown laces and uses the shade again on the back heel tab. A tonal midsole and slightly darker outsole completes the "Earth" Yeezys. Release date: February 22, 2020

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Citrin"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Citrin” is a September 2019 release of the popular Yeezy model. Reminiscent of two prior 350 V2 releases, the “Lundmark” and “Sesame” designs, the “Citrin” edition is built with the same intricate Primeknit weave with transparent side stripes, but this time features tan and pale yellow tints. The citrus-like yellow hue is also found on the monofilament side stripes, as well as the translucent rubber midsole. The outsole receives a reddish tint to the translucent gum rubber to complete the colorway. The “Citrin” design omits the heel tab found on most Yeezy 350 V2 releases. The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Citrin” released in 2019.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Cloud White"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Cloud White” is another clean look for Kanye West’s iconic silhouette. Sporting a predominantly cream white Primeknit upper with streaks of light blue woven into the material, the “Cloud White” colorway evokes the idea of walking on clouds. The large side stripes that are signature to 350 V2 models are present in translucent cream white, while the ribbed rubber midsole that houses Boost foam cushioning matches in the same airy hue. Also released in a reflective variant, this is the standard, non-reflective edition of the “Cloud White” colorway. The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Cloud White” released September 2019.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Cinder"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Cinder” doubles down on the shadowy vibes for a stealthy take on Kanye West’s most popular silhouette with adidas. Though familiar in appearance to the “Black” Yeezy 350 V2, the “Cinder” colorway makes use of an ashy Primeknit composition. A solid black side stripe appears across the upper and provides subtle contrasting against the faded black Primeknit. Void of any outward branding, the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Cinder” features a heel pull tab and tonal midsole. Adidas’s Boost technology is encased within the sole and the full-tread outsole is featured in a brown color shade. Release date: March 2020.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Marsh"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Marsh” turns up the volume on earthy tones for yet another stellar release of Kanye West’s popular low-top silhouette. A tan Primeknit upper is contrasted by brown accenting along the now-signature side stripe that appears on the mid-panel. The khaki hue covers both the cotton laces and the pull tab located on the heel of the shoe. Finishing touches include a gum midsole with encased Boost cushioning and a Sunny Yellow heel pod. Release date: Spring 2020.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Tail Light"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Tail Light” combines elements of different Yeezy 350 V2 designs into one for a new take released in Winter 2020. Once proclaiming “Yeezys for all,” Kanye West has indeed lived up to his word by continuing to release a steady stream of Yeezy Boost 350 V2s. Taking cues from the “Beluga” and “True Form” colorways, the upper is outfitted in grey Primeknit with a the translucent side stripes given an orange backing near the ankle. The bright orange hue extends onto the heel tab of the otherwise all-grey upper. Adidas opts for a translucent grey midsole with Boost cushioning encased within. Release date: February 2020.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Synth"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Synth” (non-reflective) is one of the limited regional-exclusive colorways of the popular sneaker by Kanye West that released during the summer of 2019. This is the “Synth” colorway in its iteration without reflective detailing, which released only in the Asia Pacific, Middle East, and Africa markets. It features a pale reddish-pink tint across the Primeknit upper, translucent monofilament side stripes, and a translucent rubber sole in a hue that matches the upper. The Primeknit is woven in the same intricate pattern of other 2019 releases of the shoe, including the “Static” and “Clay” colorways. This “Synth” Yeezy released in June 2019 in very limited quantiti

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Desert Sage"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Desert Sage” is yet another ultra-wearable colorway of Kanye West’s popular signature silhouette. Both supportive and breathable, the Primeknit upper features a reflective heel-to-toe stripe that shines when exposed to light. The collar utilizes a vibrant melon-like hue and offers contrast against the Desert Sage upper. Unlike many variations of the Yeezy Boost 350 V2, this model omits a heel tab in favor of a streamlined look. Adidas’s Boost technology is encased within the midsole, which dons a semi-translucent bluish tint, and provides exceptional all-day comfort.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Lundmark Non-Reflective"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Lundmark” (non-reflective) is a summer 2019 release of the famous sneaker by Kanye West. This version of the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 features a look reminiscent of the “Static” release of early 2019, but with a creamy white shade mixed with the grey tones across the intricately patterned Primeknit upper. The translucent rubber sole unit also features the creamy tone on the midsole, with a slightly darker clear gum shade for the outsole. Like all 2019 releases of the model, it also features translucent monofilament side stripes. One variation from most releases of the 350 V2 for this “Lundmark” colorway is the absence of the large heel tab loops in favor of a slightl

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Sand Taupe"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Sand Taupe” was released by the footwear giant in collaboration with Kanye West in December 2020. Featuring a predominantly neutral palette of colors, the “Sand Taupe” is high on versatility. A brew of tans, beiges, and browns, the “Sand Taupe” displays all three of the shades on its multi-directional woven Primeknit design beneath the side monofilament stripe. The top of the shoe features a muted hue of orange for a subtle but welcoming pop of color. A semi-translucent ribbed brown midsole houses adidas Boost cushioning for unparalleled comfort. Release date: December 18, 2020.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Black - Static"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Black” (non-reflective) is the all-black colorway for Kanye West’s most popular sneaker with the Three Stripes. This spring 2019 release features a stealthy look in black for its Primeknit upper, translucent side stripe panels, and translucent rubber midsole that houses the full-length Boost foam cushioning. Adding just a touch of contrast to the otherwise all black color scheme is the red stripe in the heel tab, while the laces also include reflective material speckled in. The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Black” released in limited quantities on June 7, 2019 and is now yet another highly coveted edition of the modern sneaker icon.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Glow in the Dark"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Glow” is a glow in the dark colorway of the popular silhouette by Kanye West. The Primeknit upper and sole unit on this Yeezy is covered in a bright green hue with a glow in the dark treatment. The upper also features the translucent side stripes seen on all 2019 releases of the shoe. The limited edition adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Glow” released on May 25, 2019 and instantly became one of the most sought after Yeezys thanks to a design that stands out whether the lights are on or off.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Butter"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Butter" stays true to its nickname by being one of the smoothest sneakers out. Released in summer 2018, the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Butter" has a pale yellow hue on the Primeknit upper. A semi-translucent midsole in the same color is paired with a slightly darker shade on the outsole. The absence of the model's traditional side stripes lends a more minimal look.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Black Red 2017 - 2020"
products.description: This first Yeezy sighting of 2017 was this adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Bred." Anchored by a woven black Primeknit upper and a matching midsole, the shoe features an tonal black look that's offset by red "SPLY-350" messaging in reverse on the side panel. The stripe the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 model often features does not appear, but that doesn't take away from the overall appeal of the shoe. Instead, this iteration of the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 is a reminder that sometimes simple is better. Note: This product page also includes the Yeezy 350 "Bred" restock from December 2020.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Natural"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Natural” is a Fall 2020 release that hones in on Kanye West’s preference for easy-to-wear, earth toned hues. As covetable and comfortable as seemingly every Yeezy Boost 350 V2, the “Natural” edition features a cream colored Primeknit upper with a contrasting tan monofilament side stripe. A seam down the middle of the shoe splits the design. The beige hue that was used on the side stripe appears on the outward facing side, and the previously mentioned cream or “Natural” shade of Primeknit comprises the rest of the look. The yellow semi-translucent ribbed midsole with embedded Boost cushioning completes the look. Release date: October 24, 2020.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Clay"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Clay” is one of three regional exclusive colorways that released in March 2019. This “Clay” Yeezy released only in North America. The colorway features a reddish-orange color across the Primeknit upper with white detailing and matching clay-colored heel tabs. The translucent midsole has a slight gradient treatment in the same clay color. The construction also features the translucent monofilament side stripes seen on the other two versions in the regional Yeezy collection, the “True Form” and “Hyperspace” colorways. The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Clay” released on March 30, 2019.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Olive Green"
products.description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Green” is among the trio of black-based colorways released on November 23, 2016. Like the “Copper” and “Red” versions it released alongside, this "Green" edition is constructed with a black Primeknit upper with a matching black rubber midsole that covers the full-length Boost foam cushioning. Its discerning feature is the olive green stripe that runs from heel to toe. The signature "SPLY-350" message appears throughout the stripe in black script, while green speckles are also added throughout the upper. The trio of November 2016 releases of the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 are now among the model’s most coveted looks.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Hyper Space"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 v2 “Hyperspace” is a special regional release of the popular Kanye West sneaker that released in early 2019. Available exclusively to markets in Asia, the Middle East and Africa, the colorway is the second edition of the Yeezy Boost 350 v2 to features translucent side stripes. The “Hyperspace” Yeezy features a light grey Primeknit upper with translucent stripes in a tan tint. A translucent gum rubber outsole contrasts with the translucent white midsole. The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 v2 “Hyperspace” released on March 16, 2019.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Sulfur"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Sulfur” is yet another standout colorway in Kanye West’s signature shoe collection with adidas. The “Sulfur” design falls into place among the many versatile, if not muted looks that encompass the 350 V2 lineup. The knitted Primeknit upper, heel tab, and laces are dressed in a green-yellow hue. The monofilament side stripe features a contrasting two-toned monochromatic and black design along the mid-panel. A gum rubber outsole constrasts the Sulfur midsole. This versatile silhouette is finished off with adidas’s Boost technology embedded within the midsole, which provides ample amounts of cushioning for all-day comfort.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Asriel/Carbon"
products.description: Step into celebrated comfort with the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Asriel / Carbon". This sneaker features a breathable Primeknit upper in a unique, contrasting black and grey pattern. The responsive full-length Boost cushioning delivers superior energy return, making it the perfect choice for making a bold, sophisticated statement with everyday ease.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Beluga"
products.description: Kanye West sent the sneaker world into a frenzy once again with the Yeezy Beluga, version two of his renowned collaboration with adidas. Staying on brand, the shoe was given the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 title. The inaugural Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Beluga" colorway introduces a slightly modified silhouette and sole. Steel Grey and Beluga colors are interwoven throughout the Primeknit upper, which for the first time sports a vibrant orange stripe (technically in Solar Red) from heel to toe. "SPLY-350" branding appears throughout the Yeezy Beluga’s stripe. The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 was introduced on September 24, 2016.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Copper"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Copper” is one-third of releases of the silhouette from November 23, 2016. The popular sneaker was featured in black colorways with red, green, and copper accents. Available here is the "Copper" colorway, featuring a black Primeknit textile upper, a matching rubber midsole that covers comforting Boost cushioning, and a copper stripe that runs from heel to toe. The signature "SPLY-350" message appears throughout the stripe in black script. Speckles of copper also appear throughout the upper. The November 2016 releases of the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 are now among the model’s most coveted looks.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Israfil"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Israfil” is a Summer 2020 release featuring a unique color combination of muted blue, cream, and orange. With a slew of ultra popular Yeezy Boost 350 V2s already under its belt, adidas kept the momentum going in mid-2020 with this quintessential summer silhouette in a new look. The design features an orange monofilament side stripe on the mid-panel of the light blue-grey and cream Primeknit upper. The sleek appearance is enhanced by the lack of a traditional heel tab, which is an on-and-off-again design element of the Yeezy 350 V2 collection. Providing plenty of comfort and support, adidas’s Boost cushioning technology is encased within the semi-translucent lig

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Yecheil"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Yecheil” is a unique multi-color edition of Kanye West’s popular lifestyle shoe. The late 2019 release features colorful hues woven into the breathable Primeknit upper, which makes the “Yecheil” one of the boldest takes yet on the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 series. Sporting a black Primeknit base, the design takes on a “split” appearance with the outside of the shoe featuring hues of blue, red, pink and yellow while the medial side features a more simplified two-tone knit weave of black and light pink. A solid black stripe runs across the lateral side in translucent monofilament to contrast the intricate coloration. Rounding out the design is a blacked out midsole that

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "True Form"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 v2 "True Form" is one of the three colorways for the silhouette that released regionally in March of 2019. This colorway of the Yeezy 350 was available only in Europe and Russia. The “True Form” Yeezy features a grey Primeknit upper with translucent post-dyed monofilament side stripes. The grey palette is accented with a muted orange shade that can be seen under the clear stripe and translucent midsole, as well as on the rear pull tab. Paired with the “Hyperspace” and “Clay” colorways that also were available in specific markets around the globe, this adidas Yeezy Boost 350 v2 "True Form" released in limited quantities exclusively in Europe and Russia on March 16,

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Linen"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Linen” is a positively fresh look for the most popular silhouette in the adidas Yeezy collection. The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Linen” sports a springtime-ready light pink Primeknit upper with a contrasting light grey post-dye monofilament side stripe. The neutral tone reappears on the collar while tonal laces add to the eye-catching appearance of the shoe. Adidas opts to omit a traditional heel tab to further accentuate the sleek styling. The cream colored ribbed midsole houses full-length Boost cushioning for all-day comfort. Release date: April 18, 2020.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Blue Tint"
products.description: Adidas Yeezy madness was as strong as ever during the Holiday 2017 season, when three colorways of the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 dropped between November and Christmas. Here is the colorway that’s arguably the best of the three, the “Blue Tint” version, featuring an icy light blue upper with the “Zebra” stripe pattern across the Primeknit. The “Blue Tint” Yeezy 350 will no doubt go down as an all-time classic colorway for the Yeezy Boost 350 V2, with a perfect combination of a unique color palette and versatile wearability. Note: this colorway also restocked on August 23, 2023

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Sesame"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 v2 "Sesame" is a clean look for the always popular model from Kanye West and the Three Stripes. The November 2018 release features a light tan hue dubbed “Sesame” across the Primeknit upper in a tonal treatment. The ribbed translucent rubber midsole matches the upper, while the outsole comes in a translucent gum rubber shade. The tonal look in neutral tones without any stripes or text — like what is seen on most other colorways of the Yeezy Boost 350 v2 — results in a versatile and ultra-stylish offering of the silhouette. In other words, the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 v2 "Sesame" is ready to earn a regular spot in your rotation.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Beluga 2.0"
products.description: One of two new Yeezy colorways to arrive in November 2017, the "Beluga 2.0" continues the lineage of the inaugural Yeezy Boost 350 V2. However, the Primeknit upper on this version features a true grey look, as opposed to the Steel Grey hue seen on the first pair. The vibrant orange-ish Beluga stripe from the original is also replaced with a tonal grey that seamlessly blends into the design. Dark Solid Grey woven throughout the Primeknit and reversed "SPLY-350" messaging in Bold Orange offer some needed deviation to the design, completing what's sure to be one of the year's hottest sneakers.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Semi Frozen"
products.description: For the Holiday 2017 season, adidas satisfied public demand for a new Yeezy Boost 350 V2 by releasing the eye-catching "Semi Frozen Yellow" colorway. The eye-catching Semi Frozen Yellow hue is contrasted by grey stripes woven throughout the Primeknit upper. The "SPLY-350" messaging appears in a striking red hue. A gum rubber outsole completes the unusual color combination. The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Semi Frozen Yellow” is one of the most memorable colorways of the silhouette to date thanks to its unique color palette.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Static"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 v2 “Static” released in December 2018, bringing a new look to Kanye West's popular silhouette. The updated Yeezy 350 features a transparent mesh panel in place of the usual side stripe. The panel is woven into the Primeknit upper on each lateral side. The Yeezy 350 "Static" introduced an intricate new Primeknit pattern in white and grey hues. The clean appearance is solidified with a translucent white rubber midsole and outsole that wrap full-length Boost cushioning. The unique design of the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 v2 “Static” provided a refreshing update that will be in-demand for years to come.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Cream White / Triple White"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Triple White" takes the popular Yeezy model in a monochromatic direction. The shoe features a white woven Primeknit upper. The “SPLY-350” messaging, which defined past Yeezy Boost 350 V2 releases, is also done in white so it is camouflaged within the upper. A cream midsole wraps around Boost cushioning to create a pristine version of the silhouette. The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Triple White" first released in 2017, and made a comeback in 2018. The "Triple White" Yeezy is the most-produced colorway to date, and allowed Kanye West to take a step closer to fulfilling his promise that Yeezy sneakers would eventually be available to everyone that wanted a pair.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Oreo"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Oreo” was the final release of the highly popular silhouette by Kanye West in 2016. Similar to the trio of colorways that hit retailers in November of 2016, this Yeezy Boost 350 V2 features a black woven Primeknit upper and a matching rubber midsole that covers full-length Boost cushioning. This “Oreo” edition features a white stripe across the upper from heel to toe, which earned it the comparison to the delicious sandwich cookies. The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Oreo” released in limited quantities in December 2016.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "MX Oat"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “MX Oat” is an intriguing look for the popular lifestyle shoe by Kanye West that features an all-marbled upper. Released in October 2021, the “MX Oat” blends red, blue, orange, and yellow swirls on a beige, oat-colored Primeknit base. The look is a departure from the traditional layered look of the original Yeezy Boost 350 V2. This was the very first "MX" or "Mix" variation of the silhouette to release. Like many 350 V2s, a side monofilament side stripe compliments the colorway. White laces contrast the colorway on the top of the shoe. Underfoot, the ribbed midsole that houses adidas’s Boost cushioning technology appears in a pre-yellowed vibe. Release date: Oct

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "MX Rock"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “MX Rock” is a December 2021 release of the casual lifestyle shoe by Kanye West in a design that features a marbled appearance. The “MX Rock” succeeds the “MX Oat” in bringing a new swirled style to the Yeezy Boost 350 V2, a departure from the traditional layered look of the shoe’s original design. The woven Primeknit upper features swirls of brown and dark grey against a black base. Like many 350 V2s, a side monofilament stripe, this time in black, complements the colorway. Black laces appear on the top of the sock-like shoe. A black painted ribbed midsole housing adidas’s Boost cushioning technology completes the design. Release date: December 30, 2021

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Steel Grey"
products.description: Elevate your sneaker game with the 350 V2 in STEEL GREY. These iconic sneakers offer a sleek and modern design with a versatile steel grey colorway, perfect for any outfit. Experience unmatched comfort and style with every step.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Onyx"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Onyx” is a colorway of Kanye West’s popular lifestyle shoe that mimics the appearance of colorways from the “Black Friday Pack.” The aforementioned collection of 350 V2s was originally released back in November 2016 and featured several black-based colorways with contrasting side panel accenting. The “Onyx” replicates the look with its black Primeknit upper and Onyx-colored side stripe displaying “SPLY-350” branding in black lettering on the lateral side of the shoe. Adidas’s proprietary Boost cushioning is encased within the black midsole.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Salt"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Salt” is a monochromatic mint green colorway of Kanye West’s popular lifestyle shoe that was released in October 2022. Also known as the “Jade Ash,” the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Salt” turns heads with a mint green-colored woven Primeknit upper that matches the hue of the ribbed, Boost-cushioned midsole. A contrasting black stripe on the lateral side of the shoe features “SPLY-350” branding. Tonal laces appear on the upper in spite of the shoe’s sock-like construction. Release date: October 22, 2022

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "MX Dark Salt"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “MX Dark Salt” is a colorway of the popular lifestyle shoe with multiple neutral colors on its design. The colorway is complete with a woven Primeknit upper that features shades of grey, silver, and black in a swirled-like pattern. A side stripe in black offsets the look. In spite of its sock-like construction, the shoe has a traditional lacing setup. The shoe is secured on top of a black ribbed midsole that houses adidas’s signature Boost cushioning technology. Release date: August 21, 2023

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Cored Red Black 2016/2022"
products.description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Red” is among the trio of colorways for the silhouette by Kanye West that released in November 2016. Like the “Copper” and “Green” versions it released with, this "Red" colorway features a black woven Primeknit upper with a matching midsole that covers full-length Boost cushioning. Its discerning detail is the vibrant red stripe that runs from heel to toe. The signature "SPLY-350" message appears across the stripe, while red speckles also appear throughout the upper. All three of the Yeezy 350 V2 colorways of November 2016 released in very limited quantities and are now considered some of the best looks for the silhouette to date.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Bone"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Bone” is a March 2022 release of Kanye West’s popular lifestyle shoe in a monochromatic white-based colorway. The "Bone" Yeezy 350 is a clean and versatile look for West’s most recognizable shoe. A Bone white Primeknit upper is complemented by a tonal monofilament side stripe. A pull tab on the heel assists with easy on/off wearability. Underfoot, a responsive, Boost cushioned midsole provides superior comfort. Release date: March 11, 2022

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 "Zebra 2017-2023"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 v2 “Zebra 2018” is the restocked version of the popular “Zebra” colorway that first released a year earlier. The 2018 “Zebra” Yeezys feature the same color scheme as the initial release overall. But there are a few minor differences, such as a brighter shade of white for the outsole, brighter red for the “350 - SPLY” text on the Primeknit upper, different production dates on the inner size tag, and a different mold for the Boost foam outsole. Signature Yeezy 350 V2 stripes on the mid-panel are featured in translucent cream white, while the airy blue ribbed rubber midsole that houses Boost foam cushioning, another favorite among fans of the Yeezy Boost 350, completes the look of this design. Also released in a standard, non-reflective “Cloud White” colorway, this reflective version is much more limited.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Reflective "Citrin"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Citrin - Reflective” is a limited edition variation of the “Citrin” colorway with reflective details. Earth-toned colorways have been a hallmark in the lineup of Yeezy 350 V2 releases and the “Citrin - Reflective” features a similar vibe with its slightly yellow-hued Primeknit-based upper. The color can be found on the monofilament side stripes, as well as the translucent rubber midsole. Completing the look is a red-tinted semi-translucent outsole that houses the Boost foam material. This more-limited edition of the “Citrin” colorway adds reflective threading to the Primeknit upper for a touch of flash. Release date: September 24th, 2019.

products.title: Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Reflective "Static"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 v2 “Static Reflective” is a more limited edition of the colorway released in winter 2018. At first, this version appears identical to the standard “Static” colorway by Kanye West and adidas, featuring an intricate white and grey pattern across the upper with transparent thread for the side stripes. But hit it with light, and you’ll see that it also incorporates reflective material within the Primeknit. The more flashy adidas Yeezy Boost 350 v2 “Static Reflective” released in limited quantities exclusively on Kanye's official Yeezy Supply web store on December 26, 2018.

products.title: Yeezy 700 V3 "Azael"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 “Azael” is the evolutionary third version of Kanye West’s chunky silhouette that combines vintage performance basketball aesthetics with lifestyle detailing. The Winter 2019 release finds a few noticeable differences from previous Yeezy 700 models and mirrors the futuristic vibes of the adidas Kobe 2’s upper with its newly incorporated bulky RPU overlay cages. This debut colorway of the Yeezy 700 V3 features a white engineered mesh base with the aforementioned cages contrasted by a black nylon tongue and tonal laces. products.title: Yeezy 700 V3 "Fade Carbon"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 “Fade Carbon” is a May 2022 release of Kanye West’s popular retro-modern sneaker in a colorway that features a unique gradient design. The “Fade Carbon” is Kanye’s take on a summer-inspired shoe as its upper is imagined in a sunset-like gradient design. Specifically, the shoe features a bold red look at the heel that transitions into a purple-like hue. The change in color is reminiscent of a sunset and highlighted in the shoe’s semi-translucent TPU cage, as well. Underfoot, a chunky yet streamlined grey sole completes the look. Release date: May 21, 2022

products.title: Yeezy 700 V3 "Fade Salt"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 “Fade Salt” is a neutral-based colorway of the third version of the Yeezy 700. The “Fade Salt” Yeezy 700 V3 continues the Yeezy line’s trend of neutral colors, as the shoe is complete with a blend of black, white, and grey on its engineered mesh woven upper. A glow-in-the-dark TPU overlay “cage” provides stability. In spite of its traditional lacing setup, the Yeezy 700 V3 is built in a sock-like construction with an interior bootie design. The shoe rides on a lightweight EVA foam midsole rendered in vintage-inspired cream finish. Release date: October 8, 2022

products.title: Yeezy 700 V3 "Copper Fade"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 “Copper Fade” is a December 2021 release of the third variation of Kanye West’s popular sneaker in a dark, earth tone colorway. A standout from West and adidas’s Holiday 2021 collection, the “Copper Fade’s” woven Primeknit upper is designed in a gradient, dark-to-light copper appearance. The gradient effect is highlighted in the shoe’s semi-translucent TPU cage, as well. Both the toe box and collar appear dark brown. Underfoot, the chunky yet streamlined navy sole completes the look. Release date: December 10, 2021

products.title: Yeezy 700 V3 "Dark Glow"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 “Dark Glow” is a mostly monochromatic black colorway of the evolutionary shoe by Kanye West and adidas that was released in August 2021. Included in West’s Yeezy Day celebration, the “Dark Glow” is similar to the “Alvah” colorway that adidas debuted in April 2020, save for the newly implemented glow-in-the-dark RPU overlays layered over the “Dark Glow’s” black Primeknit base. Contrasting grey monofilament stripes appear on both sides of the knit upper. Underfoot, adidas replaces the Boost cushioning found in many 700 styles for a lightweight EVA foam composition. Release date: August 2, 2021

products.title: Yeezy 700 V3 "Mono Safflower"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 “Mono Safflower” is a March 2022 release of the third variation of Kanye West’s lifestyle shoe. The colorway is a follow-up to the Yeezy 700 V3 “Safflower,” which like the “Mono Safflower,” features a yellow-based appearance, albeit slightly lighter in hue than this edition. The shoe’s sock-like upper features contrasting dark yellow and grey stripes beneath the TPU overlays that provide support. A black neoprene tongue and collar are arranged in a bootie-like construction for additional support. The shoe rides on a lightweight foam midsole and rubber outsole in a cream finish. Release date: March 18, 2022

products.title: Yeezy 700 V3 "Kyanite"
products.description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 V3 “Kyanite” is a March 2021 colorway of Kanye West’s evolutionary low-top silhouette. Comparing favorably to the “Azareth” colorway of the same model, the “Kyanite” also displays blue streaks in its intricately knitted upper that contrast the white fabric and the semi-translucent, glow-in-the-dark RPU overlays. Like all 700 V3s, the “Kyanite” features an EVA foam midsole that replaces the Boost cushioned version found on early iterations of the Yeezy 700 model. The aforementioned RPU cage has been added to the model for stability. A neoprene bootie-like collar provides additional support to the wearer. Release date: March 27, 2020.
